meta.title_en: A Comparative Timeline of Chinese and Western Medicine

events.foundSite: 伊拉克库尔德斯坦沙尼达尔洞穴
events.title: 沙尼达尔4号“花葬”花粉及其再评估
events.title_en: Shanidar 4 "flower burial" pollen and its reassessment
events.summary: 1960年,索莱茨基在伊拉克库尔德斯坦的沙尼达尔洞穴发现尼安德特人4号骨架,周围有成团花粉,曾被解读为献花,也被引作早期用药植物的线索。2023年的研究认为,花粉更可能来自筑巢的蜜蜂。
events.summary_en: Shanidar 4, a Neanderthal found by Solecki in 1960, lay amid pollen clumps once read as floral offerings, sometimes cited as early medicinal-plant use. A 2023 study attributes the pollen to nesting bees.

events.title: 旧石器晚期龋齿处理证据
events.title_en: Evidence of Late Paleolithic dental treatment
events.summary: 意大利北部旧石器晚期人类遗骸显示对龋齿的干预痕迹，是目前已知较早的牙科操作证据之一。说明史前人群已尝试缓解口腔疼痛。
events.summary_en: Late Paleolithic human remains from northern Italy show traces of intervention on dental caries, among the earlier known evidence of dental procedures. Prehistoric people were already trying to relieve oral pain.
events.foundSite: 意大利北部
events.material: 旧石器晚期人类遗骸上的龋齿干预痕迹
events.material_en: Traces of intervention on dental caries in Late Paleolithic human remains

events.title: 乌克兰中石器时代开颅术证据
events.title_en: Mesolithic trepanation evidence from Ukraine
events.summary: 乌克兰发现约公元前7300–6200年的颅骨开颅痕迹，且有愈合迹象，提示患者术后存活。开颅是旧大陆多种文化中反复出现的外科实践。
events.summary_en: Skulls from Ukraine, dated about 7300–6200 BCE, show trepanation marks and signs of healing, which suggests the person survived the operation. Trepanation was a surgical practice that recurred across many cultures of the Old World.
events.foundSite: 乌克兰
events.material: 颅骨开颅痕迹，有愈合迹象
events.material_en: Trepanation marks on skulls, with signs of healing

events.foundSite: 法国上莱茵省恩西塞姆 Les Octrois 墓地44号墓
events.title: 恩西塞姆新石器时代双孔开颅(术后存活)
events.title_en: Ensisheim Neolithic double trepanation with survival
events.summary: 法国阿尔萨斯恩西塞姆“Les Octrois”多瑙文化墓地44号墓出土一名约50岁男性,颅骨上有两处开颅孔:一处完全愈合,一处部分愈合,说明他在两次手术后都活了下来。1997年由弗莱堡大学团队报道。
events.summary_en: Grave 44 at the Danubian cemetery of Ensisheim "Les Octrois" (Alsace) held a man of about 50 whose skull shows two trepanations, one fully and one partly healed, so he survived both. Reported by Freiburg researchers in 1997.

events.title: 新石器时代砭石疗法
events.title_en: Neolithic bian-stone therapy
events.summary: 中国新石器时代遗址出土砭石，用于刺脓、放血与熨灸相关实践。砭石是后世针具的重要前身，但与成熟经络针刺学说有别。
events.summary_en: Bian stones unearthed at Neolithic sites in China were used in practices related to lancing abscesses, bloodletting, and hot pressing or moxibustion. They are an important forerunner of later needles, but they are not the same as the mature channel-and-needling doctrine.
events.foundSite: 中国新石器时代遗址
events.material: 用于刺脓、放血与熨灸相关实践的砭石
events.material_en: Bian stones used in practices related to lancing abscesses, bloodletting, and hot pressing or moxibustion

events.title: 酒的发明与药酒传统萌芽
events.title_en: The invention of alcohol and the beginnings of medicinal wine
events.summary: 考古与文献传统将酒的出现追溯至史前—新石器晚期；酒后成为中药炮制、药酒与“汤液”传统的重要溶媒。传说成分需谨慎对待。
events.summary_en: Archaeology and the written tradition trace alcohol back to prehistory and the late Neolithic. Wine later became an important solvent for processing Chinese medicines, medicinal wines, and the “decoction” tradition. The legendary parts of this story should be treated cautiously.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 冰人奥茨携带抗真菌/驱虫真菌
events.title_en: Ötzi the Iceman carried antifungal and anthelmintic fungus
events.summary: 阿尔卑斯冰人Ötzi（约前3350–前3105）携带桦多孔菌，该真菌含抗鞭虫树脂并可致泻，或与寄生虫感染相关的自我用药有关。
events.summary_en: Ötzi, the Alpine iceman (about 3350–3105 BCE), carried birch polypore. The fungus contains whipworm-resistant resins and can act as a laxative, and may be linked to self-medication for parasitic infection.
events.foundSite: 阿尔卑斯
events.material: 冰人奥茨随身携带的桦多孔菌
events.material_en: Birch polypore fungus carried by the Alpine iceman Ötzi

events.foundSite: 埃及萨卡拉赫西-拉马斯塔巴墓
events.title: 赫西-拉:“牙医与医师之长”木板
events.title_en: Hesy-Ra, "Chief of Dentists and Physicians"
events.summary: 1860年,马里耶特在萨卡拉发掘第三王朝官员赫西-拉的马斯塔巴墓,墓中有雕刻精美的木板,上面的头衔被解读为“牙医与医师之长”,常被视为已知最早有名字的医者之一。不过这一头衔也有人译作“象牙雕刻匠”,译法存在争议。
events.summary_en: Auguste Mariette excavated the Saqqara mastaba of the 3rd-Dynasty official Hesy-Ra in 1860; its carved wooden panels bear a title read as "Chief of Dentists and Physicians". Some scholars instead read it as "ivory-cutter".
events.contact: 地址: Tahrir Square, Cairo, Egypt

events.title: 伊姆霍特普：埃及医神原型
events.title_en: Imhotep, prototype of an Egyptian god of medicine
events.summary: 约公元前2600年，建筑师兼祭司医师伊姆霍特普被后世尊为埃及医学之神。传统上认为他描述了多种疾病的诊治，但文献证据多为后世追述。
events.summary_en: Around 2600 BCE the architect and priest-physician Imhotep was later revered as a god of Egyptian medicine. Tradition credits him with describing the diagnosis and treatment of many diseases, but the written evidence is mostly retrospective.

events.title: 埃及宫廷眼科与内科医师铭文
events.title_en: Inscriptions naming Egyptian court eye and internal physicians
events.summary: 约公元前2500年埃及铭文记载宫廷眼科医师、腹部医师等专科头衔，反映古埃及医学已有一定专科分工。
events.summary_en: Egyptian inscriptions of about 2500 BCE record court titles such as ophthalmologist and physician of the abdomen, evidence that ancient Egyptian medicine already had a degree of specialization.

events.title: 卡胡恩妇科纸草
events.title_en: Kahun Gynaecological Papyrus
events.summary: 卡胡恩（Kahun/Lahun）妇科纸草约成于前1825年，是现存最早的妇科医学文献之一，涉及妊娠、生育与避孕等内容。
events.summary_en: The Kahun (Lahun) Gynaecological Papyrus was composed about 1825 BCE. It is one of the earliest surviving gynecological texts, covering pregnancy, childbirth, and contraception.

events.summary: 皮特里在法尤姆附近的中王国城镇卡胡恩(拉洪)出土了一份兽医纸草,用工整的草体象形文字记录牛(以牛为主)、鱼、犬等动物疾病的诊断和处方,是现存最早的兽医文献之一,今藏伦敦大学学院皮特里博物馆。
events.summary_en: Excavated by Petrie at the Middle Kingdom town of Kahun (Lahun) near the Fayum, this papyrus gives diagnoses and prescriptions for animals, mainly cattle but also fish and dogs. Held at UCL's Petrie Museum.

events.title: 《汉谟拉比法典》外科责任条款
events.title_en: Surgical liability clauses in the Code of Hammurabi
events.summary: 巴比伦《汉谟拉比法典》（约前1750）含对手术成功/失败的奖惩规定，是已知最早系统化的医事法律责任文本之一。
events.summary_en: The Babylonian Code of Hammurabi (about 1750 BCE) sets rewards and penalties for successful and failed surgery. It is one of the earliest known systematic texts on legal liability in medical practice.

events.title: 阿卡德医学泥板传统
events.title_en: The Akkadian medical-tablet tradition
events.summary: 约公元前1900–1600年阿卡德医学泥板流传，后多以亚述巴尼拔图书馆抄本形式保存，含诊断、咒语与药物处方。
events.summary_en: Akkadian medical tablets circulated about 1900–1600 BCE and were later often preserved as copies from Ashurbanipal’s library. They include diagnoses, incantations, and drug prescriptions.

events.title: 伊尹制汤液（传说）
events.title_en: Yi Yin prepares decoctions (legend)
events.summary: 传统将汤液（煎剂）发明归于商初伊尹。此为传说，反映早期食药与煎煮疗法的文化记忆，精确年代不可考。
events.summary_en: Tradition attributes the invention of decoctions (tangye) to Yi Yin at the start of the Shang. This is a legend. It reflects a cultural memory of early food-medicine and boiling therapy; a precise date cannot be established.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 埃德温·史密斯外科纸草
events.title_en: Edwin Smith Surgical Papyrus
events.summary: 约公元前1600年的埃德温·史密斯纸草记载48例创伤病例，强调观察与预后，巫术成分极少，被视为最早的系统创伤外科文献。
events.summary_en: The Edwin Smith Papyrus, about 1600 BCE, records 48 trauma cases. It emphasizes observation and prognosis and contains very little magic. It is regarded as the earliest systematic trauma-surgery text.
events.material: 记载48例创伤病例的外科纸草

events.title: 埃伯斯纸草药方集
events.title_en: Ebers Papyrus collection of remedies
events.summary: 约公元前1550年的埃伯斯纸草长达约20米，收载近八百余条处方与内科知识，兼含巫术与经验用药，是古埃及本草与内科的重要资料。
events.summary_en: The Ebers Papyrus, about 1550 BCE, is roughly 20 meters long and contains nearly eight hundred prescriptions and internal-medicine material, mixing magic with empirical drugs. It is a major source for ancient Egyptian materia medica and internal medicine.

events.title: 赫斯特医学纸草
events.title_en: Hearst Medical Papyrus
events.summary: 约公元前1450年的赫斯特纸草为又一古埃及医学文本，内容与埃伯斯纸草部分重叠，反映新王国时期医学抄本传统。
events.summary_en: The Hearst Papyrus, about 1450 BCE, is another ancient Egyptian medical text. Its contents partly overlap the Ebers Papyrus and reflect the copying tradition of the New Kingdom.
events.material: 与埃伯斯纸草部分重叠的古埃及医学纸草

events.summary: 约公元前1300年前后的布鲁格施纸草与伦敦医学纸草继续丰富埃及医学文献库，涵盖内科与巫术—医疗混合实践。
events.summary_en: The Brugsch Papyrus and the London Medical Papyrus, from around 1300 BCE, further enlarge the Egyptian medical corpus. They cover internal medicine and mixed magical-medical practice.

events.title: 商代甲骨文疾病记载
events.title_en: Shang oracle-bone records of disease
events.summary: 殷墟甲骨（约前13–前11世纪）大量卜问疾首、疾目、疾腹等，反映疾病认知与巫术—祭祀诊疗并存，是中国最早的疾病文字记录。
events.summary_en: Oracle bones from Yinxu (about the 13th–11th centuries BCE) contain many divinations about illness of the head, eyes, abdomen, and similar complaints. They show disease concepts existing alongside magical and sacrificial treatment, and they are the earliest Chinese written records of illness.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.summary: 这份纸草约在前13至前12世纪用僧侣体抄写,出自底比斯德尔麦地那,是现存最早的肛门直肠疾病专论。1930年由切斯特·比蒂捐赠给大英博物馆,馆藏号 EA 10686。
events.summary_en: Copied in hieratic in the 13th–12th c. BCE, from Deir el-Medina, Thebes, this is the oldest known treatise on anorectal disease. Chester Beatty gave it to the British Museum in 1930 (EA 10686).

events.title: 埃萨吉尔-金-阿普利编订《诊断手册》(Sakikku / SA.GIG)
events.title_en: Esagil-kin-apli and the Diagnostic Handbook (Sakikku)
events.summary: 巴比伦学者埃萨吉尔-金-阿普利据传在前11世纪编订诊断系列《SA.GIG》(Sakikku,意为“所有疾病”)。全书共40块泥板、约3000条,按从头到足的顺序排列病征,其中第26块是癫痫篇。大英博物馆藏有新巴比伦抄本 BM 47753。
events.summary_en: The Babylonian scholar Esagil-kin-apli is credited with editing the diagnostic series SA.GIG (Sakikku, "All Diseases") in the 11th c. BCE: 40 tablets, about 3,000 entries ordered head to foot. Tablet 26, on epilepsy, survives as BM 47753.
events.contact: 邮箱: tickets@britishmuseum.org / 电话: +44 (0)20 7323 8181 / 地址: Great Russell Street, London WC1B 3DG, UK

events.title: 《尚书》药弗瞑眩
events.title_en: The Shangshu line “if the drug does not dizzy, the illness will not be cured”
events.summary: 《尚书·说命》有“若药弗瞑眩，厥疾弗瘳”之语，常被引为早期药力观念的文献证据（文本年代有讨论）。
events.summary_en: The “Charge to Yue” in the Shangshu says that if a drug does not cause dizziness, the illness will not be cured. The line is often cited as early written evidence of ideas about drug potency. The date of the text is debated.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 西周医官分科（食疾疡兽）
events.title_en: Western Zhou medical offices (diet, internal medicine, ulcers, veterinary care)
events.summary: 据《周礼》记载，西周设食医、疾医、疡医、兽医等职，体现早期宫廷医疗的行政分科。成书年代与西周实况需区分。
events.summary_en: According to the Zhouli, the Western Zhou established offices for dietetic physicians, physicians of internal disease, ulcer physicians, and veterinarians, an early administrative division of court medicine. The date of the book and the actual Western Zhou situation should be kept distinct.
sources: 中国政府中医药白皮书
sources_en: Chinese government white paper on traditional Chinese medicine
National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 克尼多斯与科斯医校
events.title_en: Medical schools of Cnidus and Cos
events.summary: 约公元前7世纪起，希腊克尼多斯与科斯等地形成医学教学传统，为希波克拉底学派提供制度与知识背景。
events.summary_en: From about the 7th century BCE, medical teaching traditions formed at Cnidus, Cos, and other Greek sites. They supplied the institutional and intellectual background of the Hippocratic school.

events.title: 医缓诊晋景公“病入膏肓”
events.title_en: Physician Huan diagnoses Duke Jing of Jin: "the disease has entered the gaohuang"
events.summary: 据《左传·成公十年》记载，晋景公患重病，向秦国求医，秦伯派医缓前往。医缓未到，景公梦见病化为两个童子藏于肓之上、膏之下。医缓诊视后称病不可攻、不可达、药不至，无法治疗。这是先秦史书中较早写到具体医生诊断与治疗手段的记载。
events.summary_en: According to the Zuozhuan (Duke Cheng, year 10), Duke Jing of Jin fell gravely ill and sought a physician from Qin; the Earl of Qin sent Physician Huan. Before he arrived, the duke dreamed that the disease became two boys hiding between the gao and huang. Huan judged the illness beyond the reach of attack, needling or drugs and declared it incurable. It is one of the earliest pre-Qin historical records of a named physician's diagnosis and therapeutic means.

events.title: 医和“六气致病”说
events.title_en: Yi He’s theory of the six qi as causes of disease
events.summary: 公元前541年，秦医医和提出阴、阳、风、雨、晦、明“六气”致病说，见于《左传》，是早期病因理论的重要文献节点。
events.summary_en: In 541 BCE the Qin physician Yi He proposed that disease is caused by the six qi: yin, yang, wind, rain, darkness, and brightness. The account is in the Zuozhuan and is an important early text in etiology.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 扁鹊与四诊传统
events.title_en: Bian Que and the four examinations
events.summary: 战国名医扁鹊（秦越人）被后世与望闻问切四诊及脉学传统联系；《史记》载其“六不治”。生平含传说成分，约前5世纪活动。
events.summary_en: The Warring States physician Bian Que (Qin Yueren) was later linked to the four examinations—inspection, listening and smelling, inquiry, and palpation—and to pulse study. The Shiji records his “six cases not to treat.” His biography includes legend; he was active about the 5th century BCE.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: Gan Bozong (Tang period, 618-907)
image.caption: 扁鹊像，明刊《本草蒙筌》木刻
image.caption_en: One of a series of woodcuts of illustrious physicians and legendary founders of Chinese medicine from an edition of Bencao mengquan (Introdu

events.title: 阿斯克勒庇俄斯神庙医疗
events.title_en: Healing at temples of Asclepius
events.summary: 约公元前5世纪起，希腊各地阿斯克勒庇俄斯神庙（Asklepieion）以孵梦疗法、仪式与经验护理并行，是宗教—医疗复合机构的代表。
events.summary_en: From about the 5th century BCE, Asklepieia across the Greek world combined incubation, ritual, and empirical care. They are a type case of a religious-medical institution.

image.caption: 科斯岛阿斯克勒庇俄斯神庙遗址

events.title: 克罗托内的阿尔克迈翁
events.title_en: Alcmaeon of Croton
events.summary: 阿尔克迈翁（约前510–前430）进行早期解剖观察，区分动静脉，主张脑为感觉与理智所在，被誉为希腊理性医学先驱之一。
events.summary_en: Alcmaeon (about 510–430 BCE) made early anatomical observations, distinguished arteries from veins, and held that the brain is the seat of sensation and intellect. He is regarded as one of the pioneers of Greek rational medicine.

events.title: 恩培多克勒四元素说
events.title_en: Empedocles and the four elements
events.summary: 恩培多克勒提出水火气土四元素，后与体液论结合，深刻影响古希腊至中世纪的病理解释框架。
events.summary_en: Empedocles proposed the four elements—water, fire, air, and earth. Combined later with humoral theory, they deeply shaped explanations of disease from ancient Greece through the Middle Ages.

events.title: 希波克拉底出生（约）
events.title_en: Birth of Hippocrates (approximate)
events.summary: 科斯岛的希波克拉底（约前460–前370）被尊为“医学之父”，主张疾病有自然原因，反对纯粹神罚解释。
events.summary_en: Hippocrates of Cos (about 460–370 BCE) is honored as the “father of medicine.” He held that disease has natural causes and rejected purely divine punishment as an explanation.

image.author: Paulus Pontius / After Peter Paul Rubens
image.caption: 希波克拉底像，1638 年铜版画
image.caption_en: Hippocrates

events.title: 希波克拉底传统与誓词
events.title_en: Hippocratic tradition and the Oath
events.summary: 约公元前420年前后，希波克拉底学派强调观察、预后与自然病因；《希波克拉底誓词》成为后世医德文本原型。相关著作汇为《希波克拉底全集》。
events.summary_en: Around 420 BCE the Hippocratic school emphasized observation, prognosis, and natural causes of disease. The Hippocratic Oath became the prototype of later medical ethics. The related writings were gathered as the Hippocratic Corpus.

events.title: 卡里斯托斯的狄奥克勒斯
events.title_en: Diocles of Carystus
events.summary: 狄奥克勒斯（约前375–前295）著生理学与饮食著作，被誉为“第二希波克拉底”，代表希波克拉底后雅典医学。
events.summary_en: Diocles (about 375–295 BCE) wrote on physiology and diet and was called a “second Hippocrates.” He represents Athenian medicine after Hippocrates.

events.foundSite: 希腊埃皮达鲁斯阿斯克勒庇俄斯圣所
events.repository: 埃皮达鲁斯遗址博物馆
events.title: 埃皮达鲁斯“治愈铭文”(Iamata)石碑
events.title_en: Epidaurus Iamata healing stelae
events.summary: 前4世纪,埃皮达鲁斯阿斯克勒庇俄斯圣所的管理者立起四块石灰岩碑,刻有约70则求医者“孵梦”后痊愈的案例,是研究神庙医疗与病患叙事的一手材料。部分石碑今存圣所遗址博物馆。
events.summary_en: In the 4th c. BCE the Asklepieion at Epidaurus erected four limestone stelae recording about seventy cures after incubation, a primary source on temple medicine. Some are now in the site museum.

events.title: 普拉萨戈拉斯区分动静脉搏动
events.title_en: Praxagoras distinguishes arteries, veins, and pulsation
events.summary: 公元前4世纪普拉萨戈拉斯区分静脉与动脉，并认识到动脉搏动，推动脉诊与循环观念萌芽。
events.summary_en: In the 4th century BCE Praxagoras distinguished veins from arteries and recognized arterial pulsation, an early step toward pulse study and ideas of circulation.

events.title: 《五十二病方》传统
events.title_en: The Recipes for Fifty-Two Ailments tradition
events.summary: 马王堆所出《五十二病方》约成书于战国晚期，是现存较早的方剂文献，反映经脉学说定型前的经验方药传统。
events.summary_en: Recipes for Fifty-Two Ailments, recovered from Mawangdui, was compiled about the late Warring States. It is one of the earlier surviving formulary texts and reflects an empirical prescription tradition before channel theory had settled into a fixed form.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.note: 《五十二病方》出土于长沙马王堆三号汉墓（1973），原无书题，因卷前五十二病名目录定名，为现存最早较完整方书之一。

events.title: 希罗菲卢斯亚历山大里亚解剖
events.title_en: Herophilus and Alexandrian dissection
events.summary: 希罗菲卢斯在托勒密王朝支持下进行人体解剖，区分感觉神经与运动神经，研究脑、眼等结构，创立大量解剖术语。
events.summary_en: With Ptolemaic support, Herophilus dissected human bodies, distinguished sensory from motor nerves, studied the brain, the eye, and other structures, and coined a large anatomical vocabulary.

events.title: 埃拉西斯特拉图斯生理学
events.title_en: The physiology of Erasistratus
events.summary: 埃拉西斯特拉图斯研究脑、心与血管系统，区分大脑与小脑，提出较希罗菲卢斯更偏生理学的解释，代表亚历山大里亚医学高峰。
events.summary_en: Erasistratus studied the brain, heart, and vessels, distinguished the cerebrum from the cerebellum, and offered a more physiological account than Herophilus. He represents the high point of Alexandrian medicine.

events.foundSite: 湖北省云梦县老虎墩墓地M64、M74、M116
events.foundSite_en: Tombs M64, M74, M116, Laohudun cemetery, Yunmeng, Hubei
events.repository: 湖北省文物考古研究院、云梦县博物馆（发掘单位）
events.repository_en: Hubei Provincial Institute of Cultural Relics and Archaeology; Yunmeng County Museum
events.yearLabel: 战国晚期至西汉早期（墓地使用期）
events.yearLabel_en: late Warring States to early Western Han
events.title: 云梦老虎墩墓地出土涉医简牍
events.title_en: Laohudun (Yunmeng) slips on malaria, toothache and childbirth
events.summary: 湖北云梦老虎墩墓地已清理秦汉墓113座，其中M64、M74、M116三墓出土竹木简牍622枚，2026年11月18日在北京公布。内容有政务簿籍、日书、女教等，也有关于疟疾、牙痛和生育的内容。目前尚未公布释文，相关内容的具体性质尚不清楚。
events.summary_en: Of the 113 Qin–Han tombs cleared at Laohudun, Yunmeng, Hubei, three (M64, M74, M116) yielded 622 bamboo and wooden slips, announced in Beijing on 18 November 2026. Alongside administrative registers, almanacs and a text on women's education, some slips deal with malaria, toothache and childbirth. No transcription has been published, so the nature of these entries remains unclear.

events.foundSite: 湖北荆州关沮周家台三十号秦墓
events.yearLabel: 约秦代（抄写约秦末至汉初）
events.yearLabel_en: c. Qin dynasty (copied late Qin to early Han)
events.title: 周家台秦简《病方及其他》
events.title_en: Zhoujiatai Qin Slips: Prescriptions and Other Matters
events.summary: 1993年出土于荆州关沮周家台三十号秦墓的简牍含医方内容，原无统一书题，载去黑子、治瘳等方，为秦代方书实物。
events.summary_en: Excavated in 1993 from Tomb 30 at Zhoujiatai, Guanju, Jingzhou, these slips carry prescriptions such as removing moles and treating ailments, with no original unified title.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.foundSite: 湖北省云梦县睡虎地11号墓
events.title: 睡虎地秦简记载对疠病（麻风）的处置
events.title_en: Shuihudi Qin slips record official handling of li (leprosy) cases
events.summary: 1975年12月，湖北云梦睡虎地11号秦墓出土竹简约1155枚，约在前217年入葬，内容以秦律和官府文书为主。据介绍，简文中有秦政府处理麻风等疫病的记录，可用于研究秦代官府对传染病人的识别和处置。该批简并非医书。
events.summary_en: About 1,155 bamboo slips were excavated in December 1975 from Tomb 11 at Shuihudi, Yunmeng, Hubei, deposited c. 217 BCE and consisting mainly of Qin statutes and official documents. They reportedly record how the Qin government dealt with epidemics such as leprosy, which makes them evidence for how the state identified and handled contagious patients. The slips are not a medical text.
events.note: 《封诊式》含现场勘验、活体检验、缢死检验等文书，为现存最早法医检验规范（睡虎地秦墓竹简，文物出版社1978，1990修订）。

events.foundSite: 湖南省龙山县里耶古城1号井
events.foundSite_en: Well 1, Liye Ancient City, Longshan County, Hunan
events.repository_en: Qin Dynasty Bamboo Slips Museum of Liye
events.title: 里耶秦简记录解毒医方
events.title_en: Detoxification formula on the Liye Qin slips
events.summary: 2002年，湖南龙山里耶古城出土秦简三万七千余枚，以迁陵县官府档案为主。何有祖研究了缀合后的简8-1369+8-1937医方，指出它与马王堆帛书《五十二病方》中的解毒方相近，并可与后世“地浆水”解毒方对照，说明秦代地方官署也在传抄实用医方。
events.summary_en: Over 37,000 Qin slips, mainly archives of Qianling County, were unearthed at Liye, Longshan, Hunan, in 2002. He Youzu studied the formula on joined slips 8-1369 and 8-1937, linking it to a detoxification recipe in the Mawangdui Wushi'er bingfang and to the later "earth elixir" (dijiangshui) remedy. This shows practical recipes circulating in Qin local administrative archives.
events.note: 2002年起出土里耶秦简，含散见医方与涉医简，非完整专书。

events.title: 张家山汉简医书入葬
events.title_en: Medical books buried at Zhangjiashan
events.summary: 湖北张家山汉墓（闭于约前186）出土《脉书》《引书》等，与马王堆经脉文献相互印证，呈现西汉早期经脉与导引知识。
events.summary_en: The Zhangjiashan Han tomb in Hubei, closed about 186 BCE, yielded the Maishu (Book of the Mai), the Yinshu (Book of Pulling), and other slips. Together with the Mawangdui channel texts, they show early Western Han knowledge of channels and daoyin.
events.foundSite: 湖北张家山汉墓
events.material_en: Han slips including the Maishu (Book of the Mai) and the Yinshu (Book of Pulling)
events.note: 1983年出土竹简含《脉书》《引书》（原有书题），约抄写于西汉初；《引书》可与马王堆《导引图》互参。

events.title: 马王堆三号墓医书封印
events.title_en: Medical manuscripts sealed in Mawangdui tomb 3
events.summary: 长沙马王堆三号汉墓（前168年下葬）出土《足臂十一脉灸经》《阴阳十一脉灸经》《五十二病方》等帛书简牍，是早期经脉与方药的关键考古证据。
events.summary_en: Mawangdui tomb 3 in Changsha, buried in 168 BCE, yielded silk and bamboo texts including the Cauterization Canon of the Eleven Vessels of the Foot and Forearm, the Cauterization Canon of the Eleven Yin-Yang Vessels, and Recipes for Fifty-Two Ailments. They are key archaeological evidence for early channel theory and formulary medicine.
works_en: Cauterization Canon of the Eleven Vessels of the Foot and Forearm
Cauterization Canon of the Eleven Yin-Yang Vessels
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.foundSite: 长沙马王堆三号汉墓
events.material: 《足臂十一脉灸经》《阴阳十一脉灸经》《五十二病方》等帛书简牍
events.material_en: Silk and bamboo texts including the two Cauterization Canons of the Eleven Vessels and Recipes for Fifty-Two Ailments
events.address: 湖南省长沙市开福区东风路50号
events.address_en: 50 Dongfeng Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan, China

image.author: Huangdan2060
image.caption: 马王堆帛书
image.caption_en: The Mawangdui Silk Texts (Chinese: 馬王堆帛書; pinyin: Mǎwángduī Bóshū) are texts of Chinese philosophical and medical works written on silk and

events.note: 据《中医药古籍初步编目》第一章第1-15条：三号墓出土医药养生类帛书、竹简及《导引图》帛画，多无原题，书名为整理小组拟定；抄写年代约战国至秦，不晚于西汉初。

events.foundSite: 安徽省阜阳市双古堆1号墓
events.title: 阜阳双古堆汉墓《万物》入葬
events.title_en: The Wanwu text buried in the Shuanggudui Han tomb, Fuyang
events.summary: 安徽阜阳双古堆1号墓墓主一般认为是第二代汝阴侯夏侯灶，约前165年封闭，1977年7月发掘。墓中竹简有《苍颉篇》《诗经》《周易》等，其中《万物》存残简约130片，被视为医药类著作，是研究早期本草与物性知识的出土材料。
events.summary_en: Tomb 1 at Shuanggudui, Fuyang, Anhui, attributed to Xiahou Zao, second Marquis of Ruyin, was sealed c. 165 BCE and excavated in July 1977. Among its bamboo texts is the Wanwu ("Ten Thousand Things"), surviving in about 130 fragments and described as a medical treatise, which makes it evidence for early materia medica knowledge.
events.note: 1977年发掘出土《万物》残简，内容近博物志与早期本草。

events.foundSite: 安徽省阜阳市双古堆1号墓
events.title: 阜阳汉简中的行气（呼吸导引）文献
events.title_en: Xingqi breathing-exercise text from Fuyang
events.summary: 双古堆1号汉墓竹简中有一篇讲呼吸练习的文献，整理者称为《行气》，与《万物》同墓出土。它说明西汉初列侯墓藏书中已有行气、导引一类养生技术文本，可与马王堆、张家山的导引材料相互印证。
events.summary_en: The Shuanggudui Tomb 1 slips include a text on breathing exercises, catalogued as Xingqi ("Circulation of energy"), found together with the Wanwu. It shows that breath-cultivation techniques were part of an early Western Han marquis's library, alongside comparable daoyin materials from Mawangdui and Zhangjiashan.

events.foundSite: 湖北省荆州市胡家草场墓地M12
events.foundSite_en: Tomb M12, Hujiacaochang cemetery, Jingzhou, Hubei
events.title: 胡家草场西汉墓出土医方简
events.title_en: Medical prescriptions among the Hujiacaochang M12 Western Han slips
events.summary: 2018年底起，荆州博物馆在湖北荆州胡家草场墓地发掘18座墓。M12出土简牍4546枚，据称是单座墓葬出土简牍数量最多的一次。内容分为岁纪、历日、律令、医杂方、日书、簿籍、遣册等类。整理者根据器物和简文把该墓定在汉文帝时期。
events.summary_en: From late 2018 the Jingzhou Museum excavated 18 tombs at Hujiacaochang, Jingzhou, Hubei. Tomb M12 yielded 4,546 bamboo and wooden slips, reportedly the most from any single grave, covering annals, calendars, statutes, medical and miscellaneous prescriptions, almanacs and inventories. The excavators date the tomb to the reign of Emperor Wen.

events.title: 淳于意“诊籍”
events.title_en: Chunyu Yi’s consultation records
events.summary: 西汉太仓公淳于意约前180–前150年间创用“诊籍”（病案记录），《史记》载其二十五案，是早期中医病案传统的重要证据。
events.summary_en: Chunyu Yi, the Taicang Duke of the Western Han, began keeping “consultation records” (case notes) about 180–150 BCE. The Shiji preserves twenty-five of his cases, important evidence for the early Chinese case-history tradition.
sources_en: Shiji, biography of Bian Que and the Duke of Taicang
National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.summary_add: 《诊籍》(仓公诊籍)为淳于意医案,经司马迁收录于《史记·扁鹊仓公列传》,西汉(前2世纪),现存最早医案记录,共25则;中华书局点校本(1959)可参。

events.title: 老官山（天回）医简与漆人
events.title_en: Laoguanshan (Tianhui) medical slips and lacquer figurine
events.summary: 成都天回镇老官山M3（约前157–前141）出土大量医简与彩绘经络漆人，反映西汉早期多元经脉模型与方书传统。
events.summary_en: Laoguanshan tomb M3 at Tianhui in Chengdu (about 157–141 BCE) yielded a large set of medical slips and a lacquer figurine painted with channels. They reflect the plural channel models and formulary tradition of the early Western Han.
events.foundSite: 成都天回镇老官山M3
events.material_en: Medical slips and a lacquer figurine painted with channels
events.repository_en: Chengdu Institute of Cultural Relics and Archaeology
events.note: 2012年发掘，医简经《天回医简》（文物出版社2022/2023）整理正式定名；2013年发掘通报暂定名（敝昔医论、六十病方等）属同一批简之异名分篇，不另立条。

events.yearLabel: 约战国至西汉(南宋史崧校刊定本流传较广)
events.yearLabel_en: c. Warring States–Western Han (Shi Song's Southern Song edition widely circulated)
events.title: 黄帝内经·灵枢
events.title_en: Huangdi Neijing: Lingshu (Divine Pivot; also Zhenjing / Jiujuan)
events.summary: 《灵枢》又称《针经》《九卷》,旧题黄帝所作,实为战国至西汉医家汇纂,作者佚名。与《素问》合称《内经》,侧重针灸与经络理论。传世以南宋史崧家藏校刊本系统为主,明赵府居敬堂本等亦流传。皇甫谧称《针经》《素问》即《内经》。
events.summary_en: Lingshu, also called Zhenjing or Jiujuan, is attributed to the Yellow Emperor but was compiled by anonymous physicians between the Warring States and Western Han. Paired with Suwen as the Neijing, it focuses on acupuncture and meridian theory. Transmission mainly follows Shi Song's Southern Song edition; Zhao Fu's Juji Tang edition is also notable.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 张骞通西域与药物交流
events.title_en: Zhang Qian’s missions to the Western Regions and the exchange of drugs
events.summary: 张骞两次出使西域（前138、前119），传统认为促进葡萄、苜蓿等物种及药物知识交流，丰富本草来源。
events.summary_en: Zhang Qian’s two missions to the Western Regions (138 and 119 BCE) are traditionally credited with promoting the exchange of species such as grapes and alfalfa, and of drug knowledge, which broadened the sources of the materia medica.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 双包山经络漆人
events.title_en: Shuangbaoshan lacquer figurine with channels
events.summary: 四川绵阳双包山汉墓（约前118）出土黑漆人体模型，绘红色经脉线，是已知较早的三维经络模型之一，或兼养生与医疗含义。
events.summary_en: The Shuangbaoshan Han tomb in Mianyang, Sichuan (about 118 BCE), yielded a black-lacquer human model painted with red channel lines. It is one of the earlier known three-dimensional channel models and may have served both cultivation and medical purposes.
events.foundSite: 四川绵阳双包山汉墓
events.material: 绘有红色经脉线的黑漆人体模型
events.material_en: A black-lacquer human model painted with red channel lines

events.title: 满城汉墓金银针
events.title_en: Gold and silver needles from the Mancheng Han tomb
events.summary: 河北满城中山靖王墓（前113）出土金银针具；其功能或兼及玉衣缝合与医疗，是否等同后世针灸针仍有讨论。
events.summary_en: The tomb of the Prince of Zhongshan at Mancheng, Hebei (113 BCE), yielded gold and silver needles. They may have been used both to sew jade burial suits and for medical purposes. Whether they are the same as later acupuncture needles is still debated.
events.foundSite: 河北满城中山靖王墓
events.foundSite_en: Tomb of the Prince of Zhongshan, Mancheng, Hebei
events.material: 金银针具（是否等同后世针灸针仍有讨论）
events.material_en: Gold and silver needles (whether they are the same as later acupuncture needles is still debated)
events.address: 河北省石家庄市长安区东大街4号
events.address_en: 4 Dong Dajie, Chang'an District, Shijiazhuang, Hebei, China

image.author: Gary Todd from Xinzheng, China
image.caption: 满城汉墓出土金银针
image.caption_en: Mancheng Han Tombs Gallery, Hebei Museum, Shijiazhuang. Complete indexed photo collection at WorldHistoryPics.com.

events.title: 《黄帝内经》理论体系成型
events.title_en: The theoretical system of the Huangdi Neijing takes shape
events.summary: 《黄帝内经》（素问、灵枢）主体约战国至秦汉间迭经编订，奠定阴阳五行、脏腑经络、治未病等中医理论框架；非一人一时之作。
events.summary_en: The main text of the Huangdi Neijing (Suwen and Lingshu) was compiled and revised between the Warring States and the Qin–Han period. It established the framework of yin-yang and the five phases, zang-fu and channels, and treating disease before it arises. It is not the work of one person at one time.
works_en: Huangdi Neijing (Inner Canon of the Yellow Emperor)
sources: 世界记忆名录申报材料
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
Memory of the World nomination materials

image.author: Wang, Bing
image.caption: 《重广补注黄帝内经素问》书页
image.caption_en: The ancient medical text Huangdi nei jing (The inner canon of the Yellow Emperor) was already listed in Yi wen zhi (Treatise on literature)

events.summary_add: 《素问》旧题黄帝,实为战国至西汉医家汇纂,作者佚名;下限不晚于前26年刘向校书,《汉书·艺文志》著录《黄帝内经》十八卷。传世重要版本有明顾从德翻宋本及唐王冰注本系统;《灵枢》另立条目 east-lingshu-zhanguo-xihan。

events.title: 本都米特拉达梯六世与“万应解毒剂”
events.title_en: Mithridates VI and the mithridatium
events.summary: 本都国王米特拉达梯六世怕被人毒杀,长期少量服毒,并配制复方解毒剂 mithridatium。约一个世纪后,塞尔苏斯记下了一个含36味药的配方。此药与后来的底野迦一道,被当作万应灵药沿用到18世纪中叶。
events.summary_en: Fearing poison, Mithridates VI of Pontus took small doses daily and devised a compound antidote; Celsus later recorded a 36-ingredient version. With theriac, it was used as a panacea until the mid-18th c.

events.foundSite: 出土地待考
events.title: 北京大学藏西汉竹书《医书》
events.title_en: Peking University Western Han Bamboo Slips: Medical Text
events.summary: 2009年1月入藏北京大学，由北大出土文献研究所整理，出土地待考，非科学发掘；含医方、病名、诊法类竹简。
events.summary_en: Acquired by Peking University in Jan 2009 and studied by its Institute of Excavated Documents; provenance unknown and not scientifically excavated; includes prescriptions, disease names, and diagnostics.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.foundSite: 内蒙古额济纳旗、甘肃金塔一带汉代烽燧遗址
events.foundSite_en: Han watchtower sites, Ejina Banner (Inner Mongolia) and Jinta (Gansu)
events.repository: 旧简：台北“中央研究院”；新简：甘肃省博物馆
events.repository_en: old slips: Academia Sinica; new slips: Gansu Provincial Museum
events.title: 居延汉简记载戍边灸法
events.title_en: Moxibustion records in the Juyan Han slips
events.summary: 居延汉简出自额济纳、金塔一带汉代烽燧遗址，年代大致从汉武帝时至约公元100年，现存最早纪年简为前90年。研究指出，居延医简主要记载灸背部腧穴的方法，对取穴、单穴施灸和壮数都有明确要求，反映了边塞戍卒的医疗实践。
events.summary_en: The Juyan slips come from Han beacon-tower sites around Ejina and Jinta, dating from Emperor Wu's reign to c. 100 CE; the earliest dated slip is from 90 BCE. A study notes that the Juyan medical slips mainly record moxibustion on points of the back, with explicit rules for point selection, single-point moxibustion and the number of moxa cones, reflecting frontier garrison medicine.
events.note: 居延汉简及居延新简含散见医方与军屯医疗记录，非完整专书。

events.title: 比提尼亚的阿斯克勒皮亚德斯
events.title_en: Asclepiades of Bithynia
events.summary: 阿斯克勒皮亚德斯（约前124–前44）在罗马传播原子论式医学，强调饮食、运动与温和疗法，反对过度放血。
events.summary_en: Asclepiades (about 124–44 BCE) spread an atomistic style of medicine in Rome. He emphasized diet, exercise, and gentle therapy, and he opposed excessive bloodletting.

events.foundSite: 江西南昌海昏侯墓
events.foundSite_en: Tomb of the Marquis of Haihun, Nanchang, Jiangxi
events.title: 海昏侯刘贺墓出土医用金属针
events.title_en: Medical Metal Needles from the Tomb of Liu He, Marquis of Haihun
events.summary: 江西南昌西汉海昏侯刘贺墓出土数枚金属针。研究者根据同墓出土的签牌铭文和传世文献认为，这些针与医经所载“九针”关系密切，是汉代针具的实物证据。
events.summary_en: Several metal needles were unearthed from the Western Han tomb of Liu He, Marquis of Haihun, in Nanchang, Jiangxi. Based on an inscribed signboard from the tomb and transmitted texts, they are closely related to the 'nine needles' of the medical classics.
events.note: 出土简牍5200余枚，含房中、养生、医方类方技书约200枚（《海昏简牍初论》，北京大学出版社2020）。

events.title: 《难经》问世（约）
events.title_en: Appearance of the Nanjing (approximate)
events.summary: 《黄帝八十一难经》约成于西汉，以问难形式阐发《内经》，强调寸口脉诊并记载脏器度量，对脉学影响深远。
events.summary_en: The Huangdi Bashiyi Nanjing was compiled about the Western Han. In a question-and-answer form it develops the Neijing, stresses cunkou pulse diagnosis, and records measurements of the organs. Its influence on pulse study was lasting.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.summary_add: 《难经》(《黄帝八十一难经》)旧题秦越人(扁鹊),伪托可能性大,实佚名,约西汉至东汉成书;版本待考,传世多明清刻本,滑寿《难经本义》注本影响大。

events.title: 武威汉代医简
events.title_en: Wuwei Han medical slips
events.summary: 甘肃武威旱滩坡等地出土东汉医简，载临床方药与针刺内容，补充河西地区汉代医疗实践。
events.summary_en: Eastern Han medical slips unearthed at Hantanpo and related sites in Wuwei, Gansu, record clinical formulas and needling. They supplement the picture of Han medical practice in the Hexi region.
sources_en: studies of the Wuwei medical slips
events.foundSite: 甘肃武威旱滩坡等地
events.foundSite_en: Hantanpo and related sites, Wuwei, Gansu
events.material: 载临床方药与针刺内容的东汉医简
events.material_en: Eastern Han medical slips recording clinical formulas and needling
events.note: 1972年出土，尾题“右治百病方”，存方三十余首。

events.foundSite: 甘肃居延遗址
events.title: 居延汉简医药简
events.title_en: Juyan Han Slips on Medicine
events.summary: 居延汉简及居延新简（1930、1972—74年等出土）散见医方与军屯医疗记录，非完整专书，与既有居延戍边灸法条目互补。
events.summary_en: Juyan Han slips (found 1930, 1972-74 etc.) preserve scattered prescriptions and garrison medical records; not a complete treatise.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌汉长城遗址
events.title: 敦煌汉简医药简
events.title_en: Dunhuang Han Slips on Medicine
events.summary: 敦煌汉简（1907年起及后续发掘）中散见医方，含少量兽医相关简，非完整专书。
events.summary_en: Dunhuang Han slips (from 1907 onward) contain scattered prescriptions and a few veterinary-related slips; not a complete treatise.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌悬泉置遗址
events.title: 悬泉置汉简医方
events.title_en: Xuanquanzhi Han Slips: Prescriptions
events.summary: 1990—1992年甘肃省文物考古研究所发掘敦煌悬泉置遗址，出土3.5万余枚，含医方、吏卒病假与医药供给记录（邮驿文书）。
events.summary_en: Excavated 1990-1992 at Xuanquanzhi, Dunhuang, by the Gansu Institute of Cultural Relics and Archaeology (over 35,000 items); includes prescriptions and records of sick leave and medicine supply.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 瓦罗雏形“病菌”观念
events.title_en: Varro’s prototype of a “germ” idea
events.summary: 罗马学者瓦罗（前116–前27）提出沼泽中不可见微粒可致病的设想，常被视为雏形的传染病因假说。
events.summary_en: The Roman scholar Varro (116–27 BCE) suggested that invisible particles in swamps could cause disease. The suggestion is often treated as a prototype of a contagion hypothesis.

events.foundSite: 居延汉代烽燧遗址
events.title: 居延边塞官吏病假与复职登记
events.title_en: Juyan register of officers' sickness and return to duty
events.summary: 居延汉简中有一枚标签简，文为“阳朔二年正月尽十二月吏病及视事书卷”，即阳朔二年（前23年）全年官吏患病和恢复视事的文书汇编。可见汉代边塞已按制度登记吏卒的疾病与复职，是研究汉代军队卫生管理的实物证据。
events.summary_en: A tag among the Juyan slips reads "Record of sickness and recovery of officers, including resumption of duties for the 1st to the 12th months of the second year of Yangshuo" (23 BCE). It shows that Han frontier garrisons kept systematic registers of personnel illness and return to duty, which is material evidence for Han military health administration.

events.title: 塞尔苏斯《论医学》
events.title_en: Celsus, De Medicina
events.summary: 奥卢斯·科尔内利乌斯·塞尔苏斯约于公元1世纪中叶编成拉丁百科式医学著作《论医学》，系统介绍饮食、药物与外科。
events.summary_en: Around the middle of the 1st century CE, Aulus Cornelius Celsus compiled the Latin encyclopedic medical work De Medicina, systematically presenting diet, drugs, and surgery.

people: 斯克里博尼乌斯·拉尔古斯
events.title: 斯克里博尼乌斯·拉尔古斯《药方集》与电鳐止痛
events.title_en: Scribonius Largus' Compositiones and torpedo-ray therapy
events.summary: 罗马医师斯克里博尼乌斯·拉尔古斯约在公元46–47年撰成《药方集》,建议把活的黑电鳐放在疼痛部位,用来治头痛和痛风,常被视为电刺激疗法最早的记载。书中还强调医者负有道德责任。
events.summary_en: In his Compositiones (c. AD 46–47) the Roman physician Scribonius Largus recommended placing a live black torpedo ray on the painful spot for headache and gout, often cited as the first record of electrotherapy.

events.title: 迪奥斯科里德斯《药物志》
events.title_en: Dioscorides, De Materia Medica
events.summary: 佩达尼乌斯·迪奥斯科里德斯约于公元50–70年写成《药物志》（De Materia Medica），成为此后约1600年欧洲与伊斯兰世界本草标准。
events.summary_en: Pedanius Dioscorides wrote De Materia Medica about 50–70 CE. For about 1,600 years it was the standard herbal of Europe and the Islamic world.

image.author: 佚名
image.caption: 《维也纳迪奥斯科里德斯》植物插图
image.caption_en: Illustration form the Vienna Dioscurides.

events.foundSite: 威尔士卡利恩
events.title: 罗马军团医院 valetudinarium
events.title_en: Roman legionary hospital (valetudinarium)
events.summary: 罗马常设军团要塞内建有专门的医院 valetudinarium,供救治伤病士兵,并兼作医药补给库。威尔士卡利恩(Isca Silurum,第二奥古斯都军团驻地)的遗址保存较好,常被视为后世医院建筑的先声之一。
events.summary_en: Permanent Roman legionary fortresses had a purpose-built hospital, the valetudinarium, for sick and wounded soldiers that also served as a medical depot; Caerleon (Isca Silurum) is a well-preserved example.

events.title: 老普林尼《自然史》
events.title_en: Pliny the Elder, Natural History
events.summary: 老普林尼（23–79）的《自然史》广收动植矿物药用知识，虽驳杂，却是罗马博物与民间医疗的重要汇编。
events.summary_en: The Natural History of Pliny the Elder (23–79) gathers a wide range of medicinal knowledge about animals, plants, and minerals. It is uneven, but it is an important Roman compilation of natural history and popular medicine.

events.foundSite: 庞贝 VI.1.10,执政官大道
events.repository: 那不勒斯国家考古博物馆
events.title: 庞贝“外科医生之家”器械
events.title_en: Instruments from the House of the Surgeon, Pompeii
events.summary: 庞贝执政官大道上的“外科医生之家”(VI.1.10)于1770–1771年发掘,因出土四十余件探针、手术刀等外科器械而得名,其中包括一件窥器。原件今藏那不勒斯国家考古博物馆,是公元79年火山掩埋前罗马外科的实物证据。
events.summary_en: Excavated in 1770–71 on Via Consolare, the House of the Surgeon (VI.1.10) is named for 40+ surgical instruments found there, including probes, scalpels and a speculum, now in the Naples National Archaeological Museum.

events.yearLabel: 约公元1世纪（据刘向、刘歆《七略》）
events.yearLabel_en: c. 1st century CE (based on the Qilüe)
events.title: 《汉书·艺文志》方技略分医经、经方、房中、神仙四类
events.title_en: The "Fangji" section of the Hanshu bibliographic treatise
events.summary: 《汉书·艺文志》以西汉刘向、刘歆父子的《七略》为基础，是现存最早的中国目录。其中方技略把医学相关书籍分为医经、经方、房中、神仙四类，共著录36种、868卷，是了解汉代医学文献规模的基本史料。
events.summary_en: Based on the Qilüe of Liu Xiang and Liu Xin, the Hanshu "Yiwenzhi" is the oldest extant Chinese bibliography. Its Fangji section divides medical works into four classes (yijing, jingfang, fangzhong, shenxian), listing 36 titles in 868 juan, and is a basic source for the scale of Han medical literature.
events.summary_add: 《汉书·艺文志·方技略》由刘向、刘歆校书,班固删要;前26年校书,《汉志》成书于公元1世纪;医经七家、经方十一家等多已亡佚,为早期书目骨架。

events.yearLabel_en: reign of Emperor He of Eastern Han (c. 89–105 CE)
events.title: 涪翁传针术，郭玉任宫廷医官
events.title_en: Fu Weng's acupuncture lineage and court physician Guo Yu
events.summary: 据《后汉书·方术列传》，东汉初有不知来历的老人在涪水边垂钓，人称涪翁，见到病人就用针治疗，往往很快见效。郭玉承其针术，东汉和帝时任宫廷医官，以针术闻名，并留下“贵人难治”的议论，即他给贫贱者治病比给权贵治病更有效。
events.summary_en: According to the Hou Hanshu "Fangshu liezhuan", an old man of unknown origin known as Fu Weng treated the sick with needles to swift effect. Guo Yu inherited this lineage and served as a palace physician under Emperor He, famed for acupuncture and for observing that he cured the poor more readily than the noble.
works_en: Hou Hanshu, biography of Guo Yu

events.title: 《神农本草经》成书（约）
events.title_en: Compilation of the Shennong Bencao Jing (approximate)
events.summary: 《神农本草经》约成于东汉，载药365种，提出君臣佐使、四气五味与三品分类，奠定中药学理论框架；托名神农。
events.summary_en: The Shennong Bencao Jing was compiled about the Eastern Han. It lists 365 drugs and sets out the sovereign-minister-assistant-envoy scheme, the four qi and five flavors, and the three grades. It established the theoretical frame of Chinese pharmacy. It is attributed to Shennong.
works_en: Shennong Bencao Jing (Divine Farmer's Classic of Materia Medica)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: Gan Bozong (Tang period, 618-907)
image.caption: 神农像，明刊《本草蒙筌》木刻
image.caption_en: One of a series of woodcuts of illustrious physicians and legendary founders of Chinese medicine from an edition of Bencao mengquan (Introdu

events.summary_add: 旧题神农,实为汉代佚名医家纂集;原书早佚,后世有孙星衍、顾观光等辑本,陶弘景《本草经集注》保存大量经文;三品分类成型于汉代。

events.title: 以弗所的鲁弗斯
events.title_en: Rufus of Ephesus
events.summary: 鲁弗斯约1–2世纪写作解剖与病名学著作，强调解剖对临床的重要性。
events.summary_en: Around the 1st–2nd centuries Rufus wrote on anatomy and disease names, and he stressed the importance of anatomy for clinical practice.

events.foundSite: 湖南张家界古人堤遗址
events.title: 张家界古人堤医方木牍
events.title_en: Zhangjiajie Guirendi Medical Wooden Tablets
events.summary: 湖南张家界古人堤遗址出土的东汉木牍中有方书残牍，内容为医方残文。
events.summary_en: Wooden tablets from the Guirendi site in Zhangjiajie, Hunan, include fragmentary prescription texts of the Eastern Han.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 以弗所的索拉努斯妇产科学
events.title_en: The gynecology of Soranus of Ephesus
events.summary: 索拉努斯（约98–138）的妇产科学著作代表方法论学派成就，对分娩、婴儿护理有系统论述。
events.summary_en: The gynecological writings of Soranus (about 98–138) represent the Methodic school. They give a systematic account of childbirth and infant care.

events.title: 卡帕多西亚的阿雷泰乌斯
events.title_en: Aretaeus of Cappadocia
events.summary: 阿雷泰乌斯约2世纪以精确临床描述著称，对糖尿病、神经系统疾病等有经典记述。
events.summary_en: Aretaeus, about the 2nd century, is known for precise clinical description. His accounts of diabetes and of diseases of the nervous system became classics.

events.foundSite: 德国宾根市中心
events.title: 宾根罗马医生墓外科器械
events.title_en: Bingen Doctor's Instruments
events.summary: 1925年6月在德国宾根扩建道路时，发现一处公元2世纪的罗马墓地。其中一座医生墓出土骨灰瓮和一件大青铜碗，碗内盛有66件罗马外科器械，现由宾根市立Museum am Strom收藏展示。
events.summary_en: In June 1925, road works in Bingen, Germany, uncovered a 2nd-century Roman cemetery. A physician's grave held an urn and a large bronze bowl containing 66 Roman surgical instruments, now kept at the Museum am Strom, Bingen.

events.foundSite: 湖南长沙五一广场地铁施工区1号窖
events.repository: 长沙市文物考古研究所
events.title: 长沙五一广场东汉简医方
events.title_en: Changsha Wuyi Square Eastern Han Slips: Prescriptions
events.summary: 2010年长沙五一广场地铁施工区1号窖出土近7000枚东汉简牍，由长沙市文物考古研究所发掘，内容含医方、疾病与治护记录。
events.summary_en: Nearly 7,000 Eastern Han slips were excavated in 2010 from Pit 1 at Wuyi Square, Changsha, including prescriptions and records of illness and care.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 周易参同契
events.title_en: Zhouyi Cantong Qi (Token for the Agreement of the Three)
events.summary: 魏伯阳撰,被视为丹经之祖,以易理解释炉火炼丹,与中医养生及金石药关系密切。传世有明《正统道藏》本、清《守山阁丛书》本,朱熹有《周易参同契考异》。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Wei Boyang, regarded as the ancestor of alchemical classics, interpreting furnace alchemy through the Book of Changes with close ties to regimen and mineral drugs. Editions include the Ming Zhengtong Daozang and the Qing Shoushange series; Zhu Xi wrote the Kaoyi collation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
中国哲学书电子化计划(ctext.org)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 安东尼瘟疫(盖伦瘟疫)
events.title_en: Antonine Plague (Plague of Galen)
events.summary: 165年,从近东战役归来的士兵把疫病带入罗马帝国,疫情持续到180年。盖伦记录了发热、腹泻和黑色脓疱等症状,据此多数学者认为病原可能是天花,也有人认为是麻疹。这场大流行重创了帝国的人口与军队。
events.summary_en: Brought back by troops returning from the Near East in 165, the epidemic lasted to 180. Galen's description of fever, diarrhoea and black pustules suggests smallpox (measles is also proposed).

events.title: 盖伦体系主导古代医学
events.title_en: Galen’s system dominates ancient medicine
events.summary: 帕加马的盖伦（129–约216）结合希波克拉底体液论与解剖生理，服务角斗士与罗马皇帝，其著作主导欧亚医学至文艺复兴。
events.summary_en: Galen of Pergamon (129–about 216) combined Hippocratic humoral theory with anatomy and physiology. He served gladiators and Roman emperors, and his writings dominated Eurasian medicine until the Renaissance.
works: On the Usefulness of the Parts
works_en: On the Usefulness of the Parts

image.author: Pierre-Roch Vigneron
image.caption: 盖伦像，19 世纪石版画
image.caption_en: Galen of Pergamon (Claudius Galenus, or in French, Claude Galien), the most famous medical researcher of classical antiquity. Lithograph by

events.title: 华佗麻沸散与五禽戏
events.title_en: Hua Tuo’s mafeisan and the Five-Animal Frolics
events.summary: 华佗（约110–208）传说创麻沸散用于外科并倡导五禽戏导引。其外科麻醉细节难确证，但对后世外科学与养生影响巨大。
events.summary_en: Hua Tuo (about 110–208) is traditionally credited with creating mafeisan for surgery and with promoting the Five-Animal Frolics. The details of his surgical anesthesia are hard to verify, but his influence on later external medicine and cultivation practices was large.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.caption: 《华佗玄门内照图》脏腑图（1273）
image.caption_en: Representation of the trunk and its organs. From the Hua Tuo Xuanmen Neizhao Tu (華陀玄門內照圖, Hua Tuo's Images for Internal Visualisation Accord

events.yearLabel: 汉魏以前古针经系统（辑佚）
events.title: 黄帝明堂经（辑佚）
events.title_en: Huangdi Mingtang Jing (reconstructed)
events.summary: 作者佚名，原书亡佚，皇甫谧等曾加以引用，黄龙祥等有辑校本，属辑佚本而非原刻本，成书年代约在汉魏之前，具体不详。
events.summary_en: Anonymous; the original is lost but was cited by Huangfu Mi and others. Huang Longxiang and others produced reconstructions, which are not original imprints. Composition date is before Han–Wei and uncertain.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 张仲景《伤寒杂病论》
events.title_en: Zhang Zhongjing, Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases
events.summary: 张仲景约于建安末年著《伤寒杂病论》，确立六经辨证与杂病论治，是中医辨证论治体系的奠基之作；原书后析为《伤寒论》《金匮要略》。
events.summary_en: Near the end of the Jian’an era, Zhang Zhongjing wrote the Shanghan Zabing Lun. It established six-channel pattern differentiation and the treatment of miscellaneous diseases, and it is the founding work of Chinese pattern differentiation and treatment. The original was later divided into the Shanghan Lun and the Jingui Yaolue.
works_en: Shanghan Zabing Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases)
Jingui Yaolue (Essential Prescriptions of the Golden Cabinet)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: Gan Bozong (Tang period, 618-907)
image.caption: 张仲景像，明刊木刻
image.caption_en: One of a series of woodcuts of illustrious physicians and legendary founders of Chinese medicine from an edition of Bencao mengquan (Introdu

events.summary_add: 张仲景(张机)《伤寒杂病论》约成于建安年间(约205–219),原书散佚,北宋校正医书局林亿等校定为《伤寒论》《金匮要略》分传;见新条目 east-shanghan-lun-wangshuhe、east-jinkui-yaolue-fanglun。

events.foundSite: 意大利里米尼费拉里广场
events.address: Via Tonini 1, Rimini(遗址在 Piazza Ferrari)
events.address_en: Via Tonini 1, Rimini (site at Piazza Ferrari)
events.yearLabel: 约3世纪中叶(建于2世纪下半叶)
events.title: 里米尼“外科医生之家”150件器械
events.title_en: Domus del Chirurgo, Rimini
events.summary: 1989年,里米尼费拉里广场施工时意外发现一座罗马住宅,判定为一名医生的住所兼诊所。宅中出土约150件青铜和铁制外科器械,有的还装在原来的筒盒、木匣或皮卷中,是已知同类发现里最完整的一批。遗址于2007年对外开放。
events.summary_en: Found by chance in 1989 under Piazza Ferrari, Rimini, this house and surgery of a Roman doctor yielded about 150 bronze and iron instruments, some still in their cases, the richest such set known. Opened to the public in 2007.

events.foundSite: 湖南长沙走马楼街J22号井
events.yearLabel_en: Wu of the Three Kingdoms (3rd c.)
events.title: 走马楼吴简医药资料
events.title_en: Zoumalou Wu Slips: Medical Materials
events.summary: 1996年10月长沙走马楼街J22号井（平和堂商厦工地）出土10万余枚临湘侯国文书，含疾病名、药材与吏民病亡簿，反映孙吴基层医疗。
events.summary_en: Over 100,000 Linxiang marquisate documents were unearthed in Oct 1996 from Well J22 at Zoumalou, Changsha, including disease names, medicinal materials and registers of sickness and death.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 皇甫谧《针灸甲乙经》
events.title_en: Huangfu Mi, the Zhenjiu Jiayi Jing
events.summary: 皇甫谧约256–260年编成《针灸甲乙经》，系统整理腧穴、经络与刺灸法，是早期针灸学集大成之作。
events.summary_en: About 256–260 Huangfu Mi compiled the Zhenjiu Jiayi Jing. It systematically arranges acupoints, channels, and needling and moxibustion, and it is an early summation of acupuncture and moxibustion.
works_en: Zhenjiu Jiayi Jing (Systematic Classic of Acupuncture and Moxibustion)

image.author: Gan Bozong (Tang period, 618-907)
image.caption: 皇甫谧像，明刊木刻
image.caption_en: One of a series of woodcuts of illustrious physicians and legendary founders of Chinese medicine from an edition of Bencao mengquan (Introdu

events.summary_addon: 全称《黄帝三部针灸甲乙经》,据《素问》《针经》《明堂孔穴针灸治要》类编;传本为宋林亿等校正本及明刻本。成书约西晋太康三年(282)前后。

events.title: 王叔和《脉经》
events.title_en: Wang Shuhe, the Pulse Classic
events.summary: 西晋王叔和约3世纪著《脉经》，整理寸口脉法与脉象分类，是现存最早的脉学专著，并整订《伤寒论》传本。
events.summary_en: In the Western Jin, about the 3rd century, Wang Shuhe wrote the Maijing. It organizes the cunkou pulse method and the classification of pulse images. It is the earliest surviving monograph on the pulse, and he also edited a transmitted text of the Shanghan Lun.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine
events.summary_addon: 版本:宋林亿等校定本系统;明刻本多种。现存最早脉学专书,成书约西晋泰始至太康年间(3世纪中叶)。

events.title: 养生要集
events.title_en: Essentials of Nourishing Life (Yangsheng Yaoji)
events.summary: 东晋张湛撰,10卷,是早期养生文献的集大成之作。原书已佚,部分内容保存于日本《医心方》的引文中,可据以辑考魏晋养生理论与方法。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Zhang Zhan of the Eastern Jin in 10 fascicles, this was a major early anthology of life-nourishing practices. The original is lost; parts survive as quotations in the Japanese Ishinpo.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 抱朴子内篇
events.title_en: Baopuzi, Inner Chapters
events.summary: 葛洪撰,20卷,论神仙方药、金丹与养生,保存了大量早期炼丹与药物史料。传世以明《正统道藏》本为据,王明有《抱朴子内篇校释》(中华书局1985年)。
events.summary_en: By Ge Hong, 20 fascicles on immortality remedies, golden elixirs and life nourishing, preserving much early alchemical and pharmacological material. Transmitted via the Ming Zhengtong Daozang; Wang Ming's annotated edition appeared in 1985.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 葛洪《肘后备急方》
events.title_en: Ge Hong, Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies
events.summary: 葛洪约347年成《肘后备急方》，强调简便廉验救急方，其中青蒿治疟记载启发后世青蒿素研发。
events.summary_en: About 347 Ge Hong completed the Zhouhou Beiji Fang. It emphasizes simple, inexpensive, effective emergency formulas. Its record of qinghao for malaria later inspired the development of artemisinin.
works_en: Zhouhou Beiji Fang (Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: Gan Bozong (Tang period, 618-907)
image.caption: 葛洪像，明刊木刻
image.caption_en: One of a series of woodcuts of illustrious physicians and legendary founders of Chinese medicine from an edition of Bencao mengquan (Introdu

events.summary_addon: 亦称《肘后救卒方》;梁陶弘景增补为《肘后百一方》,金杨用道再增。传本有明《正统道藏》本、刘自化刻本;含青蒿治疟等记载。成书约东晋建武至咸和间(4世纪前半)。

events.title: 奥里巴西乌斯医学百科
events.title_en: The medical encyclopedia of Oribasius
events.summary: 奥里巴西乌斯（约325–400）为尤利安皇帝编纂约70卷医学百科，保存大量盖伦与希腊医学摘录。
events.summary_en: Oribasius (about 325–400) compiled a medical encyclopedia of about 70 books for the emperor Julian, preserving large extracts from Galen and Greek medicine.

events.title: 巴西尔在凯撒利亚建医院
events.title_en: Basil founds a hospital at Caesarea
events.summary: 约369年，凯撒利亚的巴西尔建立含病房、医护与工坊的综合慈善机构Basileias，是基督教医院传统的重要早期范例。
events.summary_en: About 369 Basil of Caesarea established the Basileias, a comprehensive charitable institution with wards, care, and workshops. It is an important early example of the Christian hospital tradition.

events.title: 法比奥拉在罗马建医院
events.title_en: Fabiola founds a hospital in Rome
events.summary: 约400年，罗马贵族法比奥拉创办拉丁基督教世界较早的医院，推动西欧医院慈善模式。
events.summary_en: About 400 the Roman noblewoman Fabiola founded one of the earlier hospitals of Latin Christendom and helped spread the charitable hospital model in western Europe.

events.yearLabel_en: c. Eastern Jin to Liu Song (4th–5th c.)
events.title: 小品方
events.title_en: Xiaopin Fang (Short Formulas)
events.summary: 陈延之撰,方书。原书亡佚,今据日本藏残卷与辑佚本得见部分内容,为研究六朝方书的重要材料。年代按传统说法取东晋至刘宋间的大致中点。
events.summary_en: By Chen Yanzhi, a formulary. The original is lost; parts survive in Japanese-held fragments and reconstructed editions, important for studying Six Dynasties formularies. Year is a midpoint of the Eastern Jin–Liu Song range.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 《雷公炮炙论》
events.title_en: Master Lei’s Treatise on Drug Processing
events.summary: 南朝雷斅所著《雷公炮炙论》（约5世纪）专论药材炮制，是中药炮制学早期专书。
events.summary_en: The Leigong Paozhi Lun, written by Lei Xiao of the Southern Dynasties (about the 5th century), is devoted to the processing of medicinal materials. It is an early specialist book of Chinese drug processing.
works_en: Leigong Paozhi Lun (Master Lei's Treatise on Drug Processing)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.summary_addon: 雷敩撰,炮制学专著,约南朝刘宋至南齐(5世纪)。原书亡佚,后世辑本与《证类本草》引文可参;真伪与时代略有争议。

events.title: 刘涓子鬼遗方
events.title_en: Liu Juanzi's Ghost-Bequeathed Formulas (Liu Juanzi Gui Yi Fang)
events.summary: 旧题刘涓子撰,由龚庆宣编次,是现存较早的外科专书。传世本为宋以后刻本,另有《四库全书》本。作者题署带有传说色彩,成书年代据传统说法取南朝齐。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Liu Juanzi and edited by Gong Qingxuan, it is an early surviving surgical monograph. Extant texts are Song-and-later prints and the Siku Quanshu edition; the attribution carries legendary elements.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: Attributed to Southern Qi; possibly Tang–Song
events.title: 褚氏遗书
events.title_en: Master Chu's Posthumous Writings (Chushi Yishu)
events.summary: 旧题褚澄撰,学界怀疑为后人依托。属医论,传世有《四库全书》本等。因真伪有争议,成书年代仅按托名取南齐,可信度较低。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Chu Cheng, but suspected to be a later forgery. A medical-theory text preserved in the Siku Quanshu and other editions. Dating follows the attribution to Southern Qi only; reliability is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 陶弘景《本草经集注》
events.title_en: Tao Hongjing, Collective Commentaries on the Classic of Materia Medica
events.summary: 梁代陶弘景约公元500年前后作《本草经集注》，扩充《神农本草经》并重新分类，成为唐本草前的权威注本。
events.summary_en: Around 500 Tao Hongjing of the Liang wrote the Bencao Jing Jizhu. It expanded the Shennong Bencao Jing and reclassified its drugs, and it was the authoritative commentary before the Tang materia medica.
works_en: Bencao Jing Jizhu (Collective Commentaries on the Classic of Materia Medica)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.summary_addon: 成书于梁天监年间(约502—536);原书大部亡佚,敦煌残卷、《证类本草》等转引及日藏古抄本残卷可参;以《本经》与《名医别录》合注。

events.foundSite: 新疆吐鲁番阿斯塔那古墓群
events.title: 吐鲁番阿斯塔那文书医方
events.title_en: Turfan Astana Documents: Prescriptions
events.summary: 1959—1975年新疆吐鲁番阿斯塔那古墓群13次发掘，出土医方、本草残卷与病历，含《萎蕤丸方》等。
events.summary_en: Thirteen excavations (1959-1975) at the Astana tombs, Turfan, yielded prescriptions, fragmentary materia medica and case records, including the Weirui Pill formula.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 黄帝虾蟆经
events.title_en: Yellow Emperor's Toad Classic (Huangdi Xiama Jing)
events.summary: 作者佚名,又名《黄帝针灸虾蟆忌》,记载逐日人神所在与虾蟆忌针灸法,是针灸择时禁忌专书。以日本内阁文库藏古写本(孤本)为据,《丛书集成》有影印。年代仅知六朝,年份取大致中点。
events.summary_en: Anonymous, also titled Huangdi Zhenjiu Xiama Ji, it records daily body-spirit locations and toad-taboo timing for acupuncture and moxibustion. It survives as a unique old manuscript in Japan's Cabinet Library, reprinted in the Congshu Jicheng. Dated only to the Six Dynasties (year is a midpoint).
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 养性延命录
events.title_en: Records of Nourishing Nature and Prolonging Life (Yangxing Yanming Lu)
events.summary: 陶弘景撰,2卷,汇集先秦至六朝养生服气、导引与饮食禁忌之论。传世以明《正统道藏》本、《道藏精华录》本为据。年份取梁代大致中点。
events.summary_en: By Tao Hongjing in 2 fascicles, collecting pre-Qin to Six Dynasties teachings on qi-ingestion, daoyin and dietary taboos. Transmitted through the Ming Zhengtong Daozang and the Daozang Jinghua Lu. Year is a midpoint of the Liang period.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 阿米达的埃提乌斯医学汇编
events.title_en: The medical compilation of Aetius of Amida
events.summary: 埃提乌斯约于6世纪中叶编成大型医学汇编，分16卷，保存希腊医学外科与妇科内容。
events.summary_en: About the middle of the 6th century Aetius compiled a large medical collection in 16 books, preserving Greek surgical and gynecological material.

events.foundSite: 德国巴伐利亚阿施海姆早期中世纪墓地
events.title: 查士丁尼瘟疫与鼠疫耶尔森菌古DNA
events.title_en: Plague of Justinian and Y. pestis ancient DNA
events.summary: 541年起,查士丁尼瘟疫造成数十万人死亡。2013年,研究者对巴伐利亚阿施海姆早期中世纪墓地的人骨做古DNA分析,确认病原是鼠疫耶尔森菌;2014年发表全基因组,显示它与黑死病分属两次独立的从啮齿动物到人的跨种传播。
events.summary_en: From 541 the Justinianic Plague killed hundreds of thousands. aDNA from the Aschheim cemetery in Bavaria (2013) confirmed Y. pestis; a 2014 genome showed a lineage independent of the Black Death.

events.title: 删繁方
events.title_en: Shanfan Fang (Condensed Formulas)
events.summary: 北齐谢士泰撰，13卷，以脏腑辨证立方，是唐以前的重要方书。原书已佚，内容主要保存于《外台秘要》的引文中，具体成书年份不详，约属北齐时期。
events.summary_en: By Xie Shitai of the Northern Qi, 13 juan, organizing formulas by zang-fu pattern; an important pre-Tang formulary. The original is lost; content survives in Waitai Miyao.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 特拉勒斯的亚历山大以秋水仙治痛风
events.title_en: Alexander of Tralles uses colchicum for gout
events.summary: 6世纪拜占庭医生特拉勒斯的亚历山大在其《治疗学》中推荐名为“Hermodaktylon”的植物治疗足痛风，被认为是首次将含秋水仙碱的秋水仙属植物作为痛风的专门疗法，这一用药传统延续至今。
events.summary_en: Byzantine physician Alexander of Tralles recommended "Hermodaktylon" (colchicum) for podagra, regarded as the first specific use of a colchicine-containing plant for gout.

events.title: 特拉勒斯的亚历山大《医学十二书》
events.title_en: Alexander of Tralles, Twelve Books on Medicine
events.summary: 特拉勒斯的亚历山大(约525–605)是拜占庭名医,圣索菲亚大教堂建筑师安提米乌斯的兄弟。他晚年在罗马写成《医学十二书》,按从头到足的顺序讲内科疾病的病理与治疗,把临床经验和前人理论结合起来,著作一直流传到文艺复兴时期。
events.summary_en: Alexander of Tralles (c. 525–605), brother of Hagia Sophia's architect Anthemius, wrote in Rome the Twelve Books, a head-to-foot treatise on internal disease combining clinical experience with earlier theory.

events.foundSite: 河南洛阳龙门石窟西山药方洞
events.yearLabel: 北齐武平六年（575）始刻，续刻至唐
events.yearLabel_en: Begun 575 (Wuping 6, Northern Qi), continued into the Tang
events.title: 龙门石窟药方洞石刻医方
events.title_en: Longmen Grottoes Prescription Cave Stone-carved Formulas
events.summary: 河南洛阳龙门石窟西山药方洞壁面刻医方140余首，多为民间通俗单验方，为现存最早的石刻医方；清人已著录，20世纪再有调查。
events.summary_en: Over 140 prescriptions are carved on the walls of the Prescription Cave at Longmen, Luoyang; mostly folk single remedies, the earliest surviving stone-carved formulas.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 杨上善《黄帝内经太素》
events.title_en: Yang Shangshan's Huangdi Neijing Taisu
events.summary: 杨上善把《素问》《灵枢》的经文分类重编并加注，成《黄帝内经太素》三十卷。成书年代有隋大业年间和唐初两种说法。该书在中国一度失传，后据日本仁和寺所藏古抄本才得以传世。
events.summary_en: Yang Shangshan reorganised the Suwen and Lingshu by topic with commentary as the 30-fascicle Huangdi Neijing Taisu; its date is placed in the Sui Daye era or early Tang. It was lost in China and survives through a manuscript preserved at Ninna-ji in Japan.

events.title: 巢元方《诸病源候论》
events.title_en: Chao Yuanfang, Treatise on the Origins and Symptoms of Diseases
events.summary: 隋太医巢元方610年奉敕编《诸病源候论》，详论病因症候而不列方药，是病因证候学巨著。
events.summary_en: In 610 Chao Yuanfang, an imperial physician of the Sui, compiled the Zhubing Yuanhou Lun by imperial order. It discusses causes and symptom patterns in detail and does not list formulas. It is a major work of etiology and symptomology.
works_en: Zhubing Yuanhou Lun (Treatise on the Origins and Symptoms of Diseases)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: Chao Yuanfang
image.caption: 《诸病源候论》书页
image.caption_en: Page from the 'Zhubing Yuanhou Lun' ( 諸病源候論) by Chao Yuanfang (Chinese: 巢元方), published during the Yuan Dynasty

events.title: 唐太医署医学校
events.title_en: The Tang Imperial Medical Office as a medical school
events.summary: 624年唐代太医署设医学教育，分科培养医师，是古代中国较完备的官方医学教育机构之一。
events.summary_en: In 624 the Tang Imperial Medical Office set up medical education and trained physicians by specialty. It was one of the more complete official medical schools in ancient China.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌莫高窟藏经洞
events.title: 敦煌写卷《明堂五脏论》
events.title_en: Dunhuang Manuscript: Mingtang Treatise on the Five Viscera
events.summary: 敦煌藏经洞出土残卷，论明堂孔穴与五脏相配，是针灸理论通俗读本。
events.summary_en: Fragment from the Dunhuang Library Cave linking Mingtang acupoints with the five viscera; a popular acupuncture-theory primer.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 埃伊纳的保罗《医学纲要》
events.title_en: Paul of Aegina, Epitome of Medicine
events.summary: 保罗约于7世纪写成7卷本医学百科，外科部分尤为详尽，后被阿布卡西斯等伊斯兰外科家广泛引用。
events.summary_en: About the 7th century Paul wrote a seven-book medical encyclopedia. The surgical part is especially detailed and was widely cited by Islamic surgeons such as Albucasis.

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌莫高窟藏经洞
events.title: 敦煌写卷《五脏论》
events.title_en: Dunhuang Manuscript: Treatise on the Five Viscera (Wuzang Lun)
events.summary: 敦煌藏经洞出土残卷，旧题张仲景（一说伪托增订），论脏腑配属、体窍与病候歌诀，为唐代启蒙性医书。
events.summary_en: A fragmentary manuscript from the Dunhuang Library Cave, traditionally attributed to Zhang Zhongjing (possibly a pseudepigraph); covers organ correspondences and symptom rhymes as an introductory Tang text.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌莫高窟藏经洞
events.title: 敦煌写卷《亡名氏脉经》
events.title_en: Dunhuang Manuscript: Anonymous Pulse Classic
events.summary: 敦煌藏经洞出土，存脉象与持脉法残篇，作者佚名。
events.summary_en: Fragmentary text on pulse images and pulse-taking from the Dunhuang Library Cave; author unknown.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 约六朝至唐宋间定型(托名东汉)
events.yearLabel_en: c. Six Dynasties to Tang–Song (attributed to Eastern Han)
events.title: 中藏经(华氏中藏经)
events.title_en: Zhongzangjing (Hua's Classic of the Central Viscera)
events.summary: 旧题华佗撰,实为后人托名,或谓与邓处中序传有关,约六朝至唐宋间定型(年份取中点)。内容为综合性脏腑辨证。传世有明赵氏居敬堂刻本及《四库全书》本,真伪问题见异议说明。
events.summary_en: Traditionally attributed to Hua Tuo but actually a later pseudepigraph (possibly linked to Deng Chuzhong's preface), taking shape between the Six Dynasties and Tang–Song (year is a midpoint). A comprehensive zang-fu pattern text; extant in Ming Zhao Jujingtang and Siku editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 药性论
events.title_en: Yaoxing Lun (Treatise on Drug Properties)
events.summary: 唐代甄权撰，4卷，以君臣佐使论药物性味与主治，是《证类本草》等后世本草的重要引源。原书已佚，内容散见于后世本草引文，今有尚志钧辑释本传世。
events.summary_en: By Zhen Quan of the Tang, in 4 juan, discussing drug properties and indications by the jun-chen-zuo-shi principle. The original is lost; it is an important source quoted in Zhenglei Bencao, and a modern reconstruction by Shang Zhijun exists.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 古今录验方
events.title_en: Gujin Luyan Fang (Tested Formulas Old and New)
events.summary: 唐初大型方书，50卷，署甄权（一说甄立言）撰，作者归属存在异说。原书已佚，大量内容保存于《外台秘要》《医心方》等书的引文中，今可据此辑考。
events.summary_en: An early-Tang large formulary in 50 juan, attributed to Zhen Quan (some say Zhen Liyan). The original is lost; much survives as quotations in Waitai Miyao and Ishimpo. Authorship is disputed.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 百济新集方、新罗法师方（《医心方》引文）
events.title_en: Baekje Sinjipbang and Silla Beopsa-bang (as quoted in Ishinpō)
events.summary: 朝鲜半岛古医方，原书亡佚，仅见于《医心方》的引文，是研究朝鲜半岛早期医药的珍贵佚文。
events.summary_en: Early Korean-peninsula medical formularies whose originals are lost and survive only as quotations in the Ishinpō, valuable fragments for early Korean medicine.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 孙思邈《千金要方》
events.title_en: Sun Simiao, Essential Prescriptions Worth a Thousand Gold
events.summary: 孙思邈约652年成《备急千金要方》，682年续《千金翼方》；《大医精诚》成为中医医德经典，并强调道地药材。
events.summary_en: About 652 Sun Simiao completed the Beiji Qianjin Yaofang, and in 682 he continued it with the Qianjin Yifang. “On the Absolute Sincerity of Great Physicians” became a classic of Chinese medical ethics, and he also stressed geo-authentic medicinal materials.
works_en: Qianjin Yaofang (Essential Prescriptions Worth a Thousand Gold)
Qianjin Yifang (Supplement to the Prescriptions Worth a Thousand Gold)
On the Absolute Sincerity of Great Physicians
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: Gan Bozong (Tang period, 618-907)
image.caption: 孙思邈像，明刊木刻
image.caption_en: One of a series of woodcuts of illustrious physicians and legendary founders of Chinese medicine from an edition of Bencao mengquan (Introdu

events.title: 《新修本草》（唐本草）
events.title_en: Newly Revised Materia Medica (Tang materia medica)
events.summary: 苏敬等659年奉敕完成《新修本草》，收药844种，是世界上较早由国家颁行的药典性本草。
events.summary_en: In 659 Su Jing and colleagues completed the Xinxiu Bencao by imperial order. It records 844 drugs and is one of the earlier state-issued pharmacopoeial materia medicas.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 千金翼方
events.title_en: Qianjin Yi Fang (Supplement to the Thousand Golden Formulas)
events.summary: 唐孙思邈撰，约成于永淳元年（682）前后，补《备急千金要方》之未备，增收药物、方剂并收录《伤寒论》文。传世有元大德梅溪书院刻本，其祖本出自宋校本系统。
events.summary_en: By Sun Simiao of the Tang, supplementing Beiji Qianjin Yaofang with additional formulas, drug entries and Shanghan material. Editions include the Yuan Dade Meixi Academy print, derived from the Song revised text.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌莫高窟藏经洞
events.title: 敦煌写卷《灸经明堂》（S.5737）
events.title_en: Dunhuang Manuscript: Moxibustion Classic Mingtang (S.5737)
events.summary: 编号S.5737，敦煌藏经洞出土，为明堂灸法残卷。
events.summary_en: S.5737 from the Dunhuang Library Cave; a fragment on Mingtang moxibustion.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 约唐以前，定本或出唐人
events.yearLabel_en: Before or during Tang (final text possibly Tang)
events.title: 颅囟经
events.title_en: Luxin Jing (Fontanel Classic)
events.summary: 旧题师巫撰，一说卫汛，是现存较早的儿科专著，作者与成书年代存在争议。传世有《四库全书》本等，版本仍待详考，真伪与时代有争议。
events.summary_en: Traditionally attributed to Shiwu (some say Wei Xun), an early surviving pediatrics text. Authorship and date are disputed; editions include the Siku Quanshu text and require further study.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 广济方
events.title_en: Guangji Fang (Formulas for Universal Relief)
events.summary: 唐玄宗敕撰，5卷，成于开元年间（723—733），是官颁方书，曾令各州书写张贴于要路以便民用。原书已佚，内容保存于《外台秘要》等书的引文中。
events.summary_en: Compiled by imperial order of Emperor Xuanzong, 5 juan, an official formulary once ordered to be posted along main roads in every prefecture. The original is lost; content survives in Waitai Miyao quotations.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 《食疗本草》
events.title_en: Materia Medica for Diet Therapy
events.summary: 约713–741年孟诜《食疗本草》系统整理食物药用，体现唐代食疗传统。
events.summary_en: About 713–741 Meng Shen’s Shiliao Bencao systematically arranged the medicinal uses of foods, expressing the Tang tradition of diet therapy.
works_en: Shiliao Bencao (Materia Medica for Diet Therapy)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 本草拾遗
events.title_en: Bencao Shiyi (Supplement to the Materia Medica)
events.summary: 唐陈藏器撰，约成于开元二十七年（739）前后，补《新修本草》之遗，增收大量药物。原书已佚，内容大量保存于《证类本草》引文，今有尚志钧辑释本传世。
events.summary_en: By Chen Cangqi of the Tang, supplementing Xinxiu Bencao with many additional drugs. The original is lost; much survives in Zhenglei Bencao quotations, and Shang Zhijun produced a modern reconstruction.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 贡迪沙普尔医学传统迁入巴格达
events.title_en: The Gundeshapur medical tradition moves to Baghdad
events.summary: 萨珊时期贡迪沙普尔医院与医校传统在阿拔斯朝被引入巴格达，Nestorians与布赫蒂舒家族推动希腊—伊朗—印度医学融合。
events.summary_en: The hospital and medical-school tradition of Gundeshapur from the Sasanian period was brought into Baghdad under the Abbasids. Nestorians and the Bukhtishu family helped fuse Greek, Iranian, and Indian medicine.

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌莫高窟藏经洞
events.title: 敦煌写卷《青乌子脉诀》
events.title_en: Dunhuang Manuscript: Qingwuzi's Pulse Verses
events.summary: 旧题青乌子（托名），敦煌藏经洞出土，为七表八里类脉诀歌诀。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Qingwuzi (pseudonymous); a pulse-verse text of the seven-exterior/eight-interior type from the Dunhuang Library Cave.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 月王药诊
events.title_en: Moon King's Pharmacopoeia and Diagnosis (Zla ba'i rgyal po'i sman dpyad)
events.summary: 现存较早的藏医经典之一，一般认为由毗卢遮那与汉族医僧摩诃衍等编译综合而成，以藏文传本及后世刻抄系统流传，反映早期藏医对多元医学来源的吸收。
events.summary_en: One of the earliest surviving Tibetan medical classics, generally held to be a compilation by Vairocana together with Chinese monk-physicians such as Mahayana. It circulated in Tibetan manuscripts and later prints and reflects early Tibetan medicine's synthesis of several traditions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 王焘《外台秘要》
events.title_en: Wang Tao, Arcane Essentials from the Imperial Library
events.summary: 王焘752年编成《外台秘要》，广辑唐以前方书，保存大量已佚文献，是方书文献学宝库。
events.summary_en: In 752 Wang Tao compiled the Waitai Miyao. It widely gathers pre-Tang formula books and preserves a large amount of literature that was later lost. It is a treasury for the study of formula texts.
works_en: Waitai Miyao (Arcane Essentials from the Imperial Library)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 鉴真东渡传医学
events.title_en: Jianzhen travels east and transmits medicine
events.summary: 鉴真和尚东渡日本，携带并传授医药知识，促进中日医学交流。
events.summary_en: The monk Jianzhen crossed to Japan, carrying and teaching medical knowledge and promoting medical exchange between China and Japan.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
