image.caption: 鉴真和上坐像，唐招提寺
image.caption_en: Priest Ganjin (Jianzhen) , period, Hollow dry lacquer, height 82cm, about ACE763, in Tōshōdai-ji, NARA, Japan

events.title: 王冰次注《黄帝内经素问》
events.title_en: Wang Bing’s edition and commentary on the Suwen
events.summary: 唐王冰约762年重次注释《素问》，补入七篇大论，定型后世通行本《素问》结构。
events.summary_en: About 762 the Tang scholar Wang Bing re-edited and commented on the Suwen. He added the seven great discourses and fixed the structure of the Suwen text that later circulated.
works_en: Commentary on the Suwen of the Huangdi Neijing
sources_en: historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine

events.title: 太清石壁记
events.title_en: Taiqing Shibi Ji (Records of the Taiqing Stone Wall)
events.summary: 题楚泽先生撰，3卷，记载造丹诸法与服食禁忌，反映唐代服石炼丹之风，与金石药应用相关。作者真实身份不详，今存明《正统道藏》本。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Chuze Xiansheng, 3 juan, recording alchemical methods and dietary taboos and reflecting the Tang vogue for mineral elixirs. It survives in the Ming Zhengtong Daozang.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 黄帝九鼎神丹经诀
events.title_en: Huangdi Jiuding Shendan Jing Jue (Yellow Emperor's Nine-Tripod Divine Elixir Manual)
events.summary: 作者佚名，20卷，为早期外丹术文献的集成之作，与中医金石药的应用有关，具体成书年代难以确指，约属唐代。今存明《正统道藏》本流传。
events.summary_en: Anonymous, 20 juan, a compendium of early external alchemy relevant to the medicinal use of minerals; preserved in the Ming Zhengtong Daozang.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 素问六气玄珠密语
events.title_en: Suwen Liuqi Xuanzhu Miyu (Secret Words of the Mysterious Pearl on the Six Qi)
events.summary: 旧题王冰撰，17卷，专论五运六气，是运气学说的重要文本。题署王冰属托名，实际成书年代与作者待考，今存明《正统道藏》本及清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Traditionally attributed to Wang Bing, 17 juan, on the five movements and six qi; an important text of yunqi theory. The attribution to Wang Bing is pseudepigraphic. Preserved in the Ming Daozang and Qing editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 巴格达早期比马里斯坦
events.title_en: An early bimaristan in Baghdad
events.summary: 约8世纪末至9世纪初，哈里发哈伦·拉希德时期巴格达建立早期综合医院（比马里斯坦），结合诊疗、教学与研究。
events.summary_en: From the late 8th century into the early 9th, in the time of Caliph Harun al-Rashid, an early general hospital (bimaristan) was established in Baghdad, combining treatment, teaching, and study.

events.title: 石药尔雅
events.title_en: Shiyao Erya (Lexicon of Mineral Drugs)
events.summary: 唐元和元年（806）梅彪撰，2卷，载丹药、石药的隐名异称与炼制方法，是早期药物异名辞典，对研究唐代炼丹术与药物术语有参考价值，今存明《正统道藏》本。
events.summary_en: By Mei Biao of the Tang, 2 juan, recording the cryptic names and refining methods of elixirs and mineral drugs; an early dictionary of drug synonyms. Preserved in the Ming Zhengtong Daozang.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 大同类聚方
events.title_en: Daidō Ruijūhō
events.summary: 出云广贞等奉敕编，是日本早期官修和药方书，原书亡佚，仅见后世记载，属存目性质。
events.summary_en: A Japanese imperially commissioned compilation of native formulas by Izumo no Hirosada and others; the original is lost and known only from later references.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 圣加仑修道院平面图中的药圃
events.title_en: Physic garden on the Plan of St Gall
events.summary: 约9世纪绘制的圣加仑修道院理想平面图，设有医务室、医生住所，并在其旁规划16畦药草园，另有18畦菜园，体现加洛林时代修道院医学自给药材、照护病僧的制度设计。原件藏瑞士圣加仑修道院图书馆。
events.summary_en: The 9th-century Plan of St Gall places a 16-bed medicinal herb garden beside the infirmary and physician's house, embodying Carolingian monastic medicine.

events.title: 传信方
events.title_en: Chuanxin Fang (Reliable Transmitted Formulas)
events.summary: 唐代刘禹锡所辑验方集，2卷，收录士人亲验有效之方，反映唐代文人涉医、传方验方之风。原书已佚，部分内容见于《证类本草》《医心方》等书引文，今有辑佚本传世。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Liu Yuxi of the Tang, this 2-juan collection of tested formulas reflects literati engagement with medicine. The original is lost; fragments survive in quotations in later works such as Zhenglei Bencao and Ishimpo, and modern reconstructions exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 仙授理伤续断秘方
events.title_en: Xianshou Lishang Xuduan Mifang (Immortal-Taught Secret Formulas for Bone Setting)
events.summary: 署蔺道人撰，约成于唐会昌年间（841–845），是现存较早的伤科专著，论骨折脱位的整复手法与用药。传世有明刻本及《三三医书》本，作者生平不详。
events.summary_en: Attributed to the Daoist Lin, written around the Huichang era, one of the earliest surviving traumatology monographs on reduction of fractures and dislocations. Preserved in Ming editions and the San San Yishu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 《理伤续断方》
events.title_en: Formulas for Treating Injuries and Restoring Continuity
events.summary: 约841–845年蔺道人《理伤续断方》专论骨折伤科，是中医骨伤科重要早期专书。
events.summary_en: About 841–845 Lin Daoren’s Lishang Xuduan Fang specialized in fractures and traumatology. It is an important early specialist book of Chinese traumatology.
works_en: Lishang Xuduan Fang (Formulas for Treating Injuries and Restoring Continuity)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 侯奈因·伊本·伊斯哈格翻译运动
events.title_en: The translation movement of Hunayn ibn Ishaq
events.summary: 侯奈因（约830–873）等将大量盖伦与希腊医学著作译为叙利亚语与阿拉伯语，奠定伊斯兰医学文献基础。
events.summary_en: Hunayn (about 830–873) and others translated a large body of Galen and Greek medicine into Syriac and Arabic, laying the textual foundation of Islamic medicine.

events.title: 萨勒诺医学校兴起
events.title_en: Rise of the medical school of Salerno
events.summary: 约9世纪围绕本笃会医院发展的萨勒诺医学校，10–12世纪达于鼎盛，融合希腊、拉丁、阿拉伯与犹太医学，是西欧最早的医学校之一。
events.summary_en: The medical school of Salerno grew up around a Benedictine hospital about the 9th century and reached its height in the 10th–12th centuries. It fused Greek, Latin, Arabic, and Jewish medicine and was one of the earliest medical schools in western Europe.

image.caption: 萨勒诺医学校细密画
image.caption_en:
La Scuola Medica Salernitana così come appare in una miniatura del Canone di Avicenna.
L'immagine rappresenta la storia leggendaria di Rober

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌莫高窟藏经洞
events.title: 敦煌藏文医学卷子
events.title_en: Dunhuang Tibetan Medical Manuscripts
events.summary: 敦煌藏经洞出土藏文医药写卷，含《火灸疗法》《藏医杂疗方》等，反映汉藏医学交流；另见民族医药专表。
events.summary_en: Tibetan-language medical manuscripts from the Dunhuang Library Cave, including Moxibustion Therapy and Miscellaneous Tibetan Prescriptions, reflecting Sino-Tibetan medical exchange.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 经效产宝
events.title_en: Jingxiao Chanbao (Treasure of Proven Obstetrics)
events.summary: 唐大中年间昝殷撰，是现存较早的产科专著，载妊娠、产后诸病的证治与方药。传世版本见于《当归草堂医学丛书》，日本亦有古抄本系统流传。
events.summary_en: By Zan Yin of the Tang, an early surviving obstetrics monograph on pregnancy and postpartum disorders. Editions include the Danggui Caotang medical series; Japanese old manuscripts also exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 金迪论药物等级
events.title_en: Al-Kindi on the degrees of drugs
events.summary: 哲学家金迪著《论等级》（De Gradibus），尝试量化药物效力，影响中世纪药理学讨论。
events.summary_en: The philosopher al-Kindi wrote De Gradibus, an attempt to quantify drug potency that influenced medieval pharmacological discussion.

events.title: 图伦王朝开罗医院（瓦克夫资助）
events.title_en: The Tulunid hospital in Cairo, funded by a waqf
events.summary: 艾哈迈德·伊本·图伦在开罗建立医院并以瓦克夫（宗教基金）资助，使医院财务制度更可持续，是伊斯兰医院发展的里程碑。
events.summary_en: Ahmad ibn Tulun founded a hospital in Cairo and endowed it with a waqf, making hospital finance more sustainable. It was a milestone in the development of Islamic hospitals.

events.title: 食医心镜
events.title_en: Shiyi Xinjing (Mirror of the Dietitian's Mind)
events.summary: 唐末昝殷撰，3卷，以食物为主治的食疗方书。原书已佚，部分内容保存于《医方类聚》等书的引文中，今有辑佚本，反映唐代食疗学的发展。
events.summary_en: By Zan Yin, late Tang, 3 juan, a dietetic formulary. The original is lost; fragments survive in Yifang Leiju and modern reconstructions exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 黄帝明堂灸经
events.title_en: Huangdi Mingtang Jiu Jing (Yellow Emperor's Mingtang Moxibustion Classic)
events.summary: 作者佚名，3卷，载正人形、背人形灸法图与小儿灸法，是今存较早的灸法图经之一。元至大四年（1311）窦桂芳《针灸四书》收有此本，另有明刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Anonymous, 3 juan, with moxibustion charts for front and back body figures and pediatric moxibustion; one of the earliest surviving moxibustion illustrated classics. Included in Dou Guifang's Zhenjiu Sishu (1311) and Ming editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 拉齐区分天花与麻疹
events.title_en: Al-Razi distinguishes smallpox from measles
events.summary: 拉齐（Rhazes，约865–925）在《全书》等著作中清晰区分天花与麻疹，并开创儿科专论传统，是临床观察的典范。
events.summary_en: Al-Razi (Rhazes, about 865–925) clearly distinguished smallpox from measles in the Comprehensive Book and other works, and he opened a tradition of specialist pediatric writing. The distinction is a model of clinical observation.

image.caption: 拉齐《医学集成》阿拉伯文抄本
image.caption_en:
Text.

Asian Collection
Keywords: Rhazes

events.foundSite: 甘肃敦煌莫高窟藏经洞
events.title: 敦煌写卷《人神流注》（P.3247）
events.title_en: Dunhuang Manuscript: Flow of the Human Spirits (P.3247)
events.summary: 编号P.3247，敦煌藏经洞出土，载逐日人神所在与针灸禁忌。
events.summary_en: P.3247 from the Dunhuang Library Cave; records the daily location of the human spirits and acupuncture/moxibustion taboos.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 《巴尔德医书》
events.title_en: Bald's Leechbook
events.summary: 古英语医书《巴尔德医书》唯一抄本藏伦敦大英图书馆 Royal 12 D XVII，据字体断为10世纪中叶；书中称部分药方由耶路撒冷牧首埃利亚斯提供给阿尔弗雷德大王，是盎格鲁-撒克逊医学最重要的文献之一。
events.summary_en: Preserved uniquely in British Library Royal 12 D XVII (mid-10th c.), the Old English Leechbook is linked to King Alfred via remedies sent by Patriarch Elias of Jerusalem.

events.title: 海药本草
events.title_en: Haiyao Bencao (Materia Medica of Overseas Drugs)
events.summary: 五代李珣撰，6卷，记载海外引进香药124种，反映中外医药交流。原书已佚，尚志钧有辑校本（人民卫生出版社，1997），可见其内容大要。
events.summary_en: By Li Xun of the Five Dynasties, 6 juan, recording 124 imported aromatic drugs and reflecting exchange between China and other lands. The original is lost; Shang Zhijun's reconstruction was published in 1997.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-supplied bibliography)

events.title: 《开宝本草》
events.title_en: Kaibao Materia Medica
events.summary: 宋初973年官修《开宝重定本草》，继承唐本草并增补，开启宋代官修本草传统。
events.summary_en: In 973, early in the Song, the state compiled the Kaibao Revised Materia Medica. It inherited the Tang materia medica and added to it, opening the Song tradition of official materia medica.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 巴格达阿杜德医院
events.title_en: The Adudi Hospital in Baghdad
events.summary: 约980年建立的阿杜德（ʿAḍudī）医院规模宏大，设专科与教学，代表阿拔斯晚期医院高峰，1258年蒙古攻陷巴格达后毁。
events.summary_en: The Adudi Hospital, founded about 980, was very large, with specialties and teaching. It represents the late Abbasid peak of the hospital. It was destroyed after the Mongol capture of Baghdad in 1258.

events.title: 马朱西《王书》
events.title_en: Al-Majusi, The Complete Book of the Medical Art
events.summary: 阿里·伊本·阿巴斯·马朱西（Haly Abbas）著《医学全书》（Liber Regius），结构清晰，经拉丁译本影响萨勒诺与欧洲课程。
events.summary_en: Ali ibn al-Abbas al-Majusi (Haly Abbas) wrote The Complete Book of the Medical Art (Liber Regius). Its clear structure, through Latin translation, influenced the curriculum at Salerno and in Europe.

events.title: 医心方
events.title_en: Ishinpō (Essentials of Medicine)
events.summary: 丹波康赖撰，引用隋唐以前大量中国医书，永观二年（984）进献圆融天皇，共三十卷，是日本现存最古的医书，半井家本被指定为国宝。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Tamba no Yasuyori and presented to Emperor En'yū in 984; thirty volumes drawing on many pre-Tang Chinese medical books, it is Japan's oldest surviving medical text, with the Nakarai-family copy designated a National Treasure.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
东京国立博物馆藏品目录
文化遗产在线(日本文化厅)
sources_en: Cultural Heritage Online (Agency for Cultural Affairs)

events.title: 《太平圣惠方》
events.title_en: Taiping Holy Prescriptions
events.summary: 王怀隐等992年奉敕编成《太平圣惠方》，大型官修方书，反映北宋初方药水平。
events.summary_en: In 992 Wang Huaiyin and colleagues compiled the Taiping Shenghui Fang by imperial order. It is a large official formulary and reflects the level of formulas and drugs in the early Northern Song.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 扎赫拉维《医学宝鉴》外科
events.title_en: Al-Zahrawi’s surgery in the Kitab al-Tasrif
events.summary: 扎赫拉威（Albucasis，约936–1013）的《医学宝鉴》（Al-Tasrif）详述手术器械与术式，将外科提升至医学核心地位，深刻影响欧洲外科。
events.summary_en: The Kitab al-Tasrif of al-Zahrawi (Albucasis, about 936–1013) describes surgical instruments and procedures in detail, raised surgery to a central place in medicine, and deeply influenced European surgery.

image.author: Abulcasis, also known as Abu'l Qasim al-Zahrawi
image.caption: 扎赫拉维《医学宝鉴》外科器械图
image.caption_en: Illustration of medieval Muslim surgical instruments taken from al-Zahrawi's Kitab al-Tasrif. Fifteenth century copy of an eleventh century

events.title: 阿马尔·摩苏里空心针吸除白内障
events.title_en: Ammar al-Mawsili's hollow-needle cataract aspiration
events.summary: 约1010年，伊拉克眼科医生阿马尔·摩苏里在《眼病选要》中记载以空心针经巩膜吸出白内障的手术，被视为最早的白内障吸除术尝试。
events.summary_en: In his Choice of Eye Diseases (c. 1010) Ammar al-Mawsili described extracting cataracts by suction with a hollow needle.

events.title: 伊本·西那《医典》
events.title_en: Ibn Sina, The Canon of Medicine
events.summary: 伊本·西那（阿维森纳，980–1037）约于1025年前后完成《医典》，综合盖伦与临床经验，成为伊斯兰与欧洲大学标准教材至18世纪。
events.summary_en: Ibn Sina (Avicenna, 980–1037) completed The Canon of Medicine around 1025. It synthesized Galen and clinical experience and was a standard textbook in Islamic and European universities until the 18th century.

image.caption: 伊本·西那《医典》16 世纪抄本卷首
image.caption_en: The opening decoration and invocation to Allah from a 16th century manuscript of Avicenna's Canon

events.yearLabel: 原著约11世纪；新疆传习明清至近代
events.yearLabel_en: original c. 11th c.; Xinjiang transmission Ming–modern
events.title: 医典（阿维森纳《Canon》）维吾尔医传承本
events.title_en: Canon of Medicine (Avicenna), Uyghur transmission
events.summary: 伊本·西那《医典》经阿拉伯—波斯—突厥语系统传入新疆，成为维吾尔医的重要理论来源，以写本形式由医家传习，非汉籍单行本。
events.summary_en: Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine reached Xinjiang through the Arabic–Persian–Turkic tradition and became a key theoretical source for Uyghur medicine, transmitted by physicians in manuscript form rather than as a Chinese-language book.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 王惟一针灸铜人
events.title_en: Wang Weiyi’s acupuncture bronze figure
events.summary: 王惟一1026年著《铜人腧穴针灸图经》，次年铸针灸铜人，供教学考试，是针灸标准化的里程碑。
events.summary_en: In 1026 Wang Weiyi wrote the Illustrated Canon of Acupoints on the Bronze Figure, and the next year he cast an acupuncture bronze figure for teaching and examination. It was a milestone in the standardization of acupuncture.
works_en: Illustrated Canon of Acupoints on the Bronze Figure
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.caption_en:
Bronze figure for acupuncture; anon

Wellcome Images

events.title: 天圣《医疾令》规定医官修习书
events.title_en: Tiansheng Medical Statute sets the curriculum
events.summary: 天圣七年（1029），北宋颁布《医疾令》，部分沿用唐开元二十五年（737）令文，规定医科学生习读《甲乙经》《脉经》《本草》，兼习《伤寒论》等方书；针科学生习读《素问》《黄帝针经》《明堂》等书。
events.summary_en: In 1029 the Northern Song promulgated the Tiansheng Medical Statute, partly inherited from the Tang statute of 737, prescribing the texts that medical and acupuncture students had to study.

sources: 真柳诚论文（日本医史学杂志）
events.title: 太医局为八十余名诸科生讲授《素问》《难经》
events.title_en: Imperial Medical Bureau lectures to 80+ students
events.summary: 北宋初期，医官培养由隶属太常寺的太医局负责。庆历四年（1044）有记载称，太医局用《素问》《难经》等书为诸科生徒八十余人讲说，所用两书很可能就是天圣五年（1027）的校刊本。
events.summary_en: In 1044 the Imperial Medical Bureau under the Court of Imperial Sacrifices lectured over 80 students on the Suwen and Nanjing, probably using the 1027 collated editions.

events.title: 博济方
events.title_en: Boji Fang
events.summary: 宋代王衮撰，原书已佚，清代据《四库全书》辑本为五卷，商务印书馆1959年排印。
events.summary_en: By Wang Gun of the Song; the original is lost, and the Siku Quanshu reconstruction in five fascicles was typeset by the Commercial Press in 1959.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 《欧希范五脏图》《存真图》
events.title_en: Ou Xifan’s Charts of the Five Viscera and the Cunzhen Tu
events.summary: 北宋出现基于刑尸观察的《欧希范五脏图》与杨介《存真图》，是中国古代解剖学的重要图像文献。
events.summary_en: In the Northern Song, Ou Xifan’s Charts of the Five Viscera and Yang Jie’s Cunzhen Tu, based on observation of executed bodies, became important illustrated documents of anatomy in ancient China.
works_en: Ou Xifan's Charts of the Five Viscera
Cunzhen Tu (Charts for Preserving the True)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 方脉书（辽）
events.title_en: Fangmai Shu (Liao)
events.summary: 辽代耶律庶成将汉文医籍译为契丹文，原书已佚，仅见于《辽史》著录，反映北方民族医学传播。
events.summary_en: Yelü Shucheng of the Liao rendered Chinese medical texts into Khitan; the original is lost and known only from the Liaoshi, reflecting medical transmission among northern peoples.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 校正医书局
events.title_en: Bureau for Editing Medical Books
events.summary: 1057年北宋设校正医书局，系统校刻《伤寒论》《千金方》等经典，深刻影响医书传本与医学教育。
events.summary_en: In 1057 the Northern Song established the Bureau for Editing Medical Books. It systematically collated and printed the Shanghan Lun, the Qianjin Fang, and other classics, deeply affecting transmitted texts and medical education.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine

sources: 真柳诚论文（日本医史学杂志）
events.title: 太医局定员一百二十人，考试加试本草
events.title_en: Medical Bureau quota of 120 and pharmacology exam
events.summary: 嘉祐五年（1060），太常寺奏请把太医局学生定员限为120人。此前考试从《难经》《素问》《病源候论》《圣惠方》中出十题，此后增出本草二三题，完全不通本草者不予录取。
events.summary_en: From 1060 the bureau capped enrolment at 120 and added materia medica questions to its examinations, rejecting candidates with no knowledge of the subject.

events.title: 伊本·布特兰《健康全书》
events.title_en: Ibn Butlan's Taqwim al-Sihha (Tacuinum sanitatis)
events.summary: 巴格达基督徒医生伊本·布特兰（卒于1068）以表格形式撰《健康全书》，论饮食、空气、运动等养生要素；13世纪译为拉丁文《Tacuinum sanitatis》，14世纪后在意大利衍生大量插图抄本，如法国国家图书馆 Latin 6977。
events.summary_en: Baghdad physician Ibn Butlan (d. 1068) wrote the tabular health manual Taqwim al-Sihha, translated into Latin in the 13th century as Tacuinum sanitatis.

events.title: 嘉祐本草
events.title_en: Jiayou Bencao
events.summary: 北宋掌禹锡等奉敕在《开宝本草》基础上补注而成，属校正医书局时期的官修本草。原书已佚，内容并入《证类本草》而得以流传。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Zhang Yuxi and others by imperial order as a supplement to the Kaibao Bencao. The original is lost; its content survives in the Zhenglei Bencao.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 本草图经
events.title_en: Bencao Tujing (Illustrated Materia Medica)
events.summary: 北宋苏颂等编撰的药物图谱，图文并重。原书已佚，图文大部分保存于《证类本草》。
events.summary_en: An illustrated materia medica by Su Song and colleagues. The original is lost; most of its text and images survive in the Zhenglei Bencao.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 祖本东汉;编次魏晋;北宋治平二年(1065)前后校正
events.yearLabel_en: Original Eastern Han; arranged in Wei-Jin; collated c. 1065 (Northern Song)
events.title: 伤寒论
events.title_en: Treatise on Cold Damage (Shanghan Lun)
events.summary: 《伤寒论》为张仲景所撰,祖本出自东汉,经西晋王叔和编次,北宋林亿等校正医书局于治平二年前后校正刊行。传世以北宋治平本系统为主,明赵开美《仲景全书》翻刻本影响最大,以六经辨证为核心。
events.summary_en: Authored by Zhang Zhongjing in the Eastern Han, arranged by Wang Shuhe in Wei-Jin and collated by Lin Yi and others at the Northern Song Bureau for Revising Medical Books around 1065. The Zhiping edition tradition and Zhao Kaimei's Ming reprint are most influential; its core is six-channel pattern differentiation.
works_en: Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
《中医药古籍初步编目》附录乙[14]
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 祖本东汉;北宋治平二年(1065)前后校定
events.yearLabel_en: Original Eastern Han; collated c. 1065 (Northern Song)
events.title: 金匮要略方论
events.title_en: Synopsis of the Golden Chamber (Jingui Yaolue Fanglun)
events.summary: 《金匮要略方论》为张仲景《伤寒杂病论》杂病部分的传本。北宋王洙在馆阁得蠹简,经林亿等校定,与《伤寒论》分别传世;明赵开美本等流传,内容以杂病辨治与方剂为主。
events.summary_en: The miscellaneous-disease portion of Zhang Zhongjing's Shanghan Zabing Lun. Wang Zhu found a worm-eaten bamboo copy in the Northern Song imperial library; Lin Yi and colleagues collated it, and it circulated separately from the Shanghan Lun, notably in Zhao Kaimei's Ming edition.
works_en: Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 金匮玉函经
events.title_en: Jingui Yuhan Jing
events.summary: 东汉张仲景原著，北宋校正医书局校定，为《伤寒论》的另一传本系统，可校宋本异同。清康熙陈世杰起秀堂刻本流传较广。
events.summary_en: Originally by Zhang Zhongjing; revised by the Northern Song Bureau for Revising Medical Texts. An alternative transmission of the Shanghan Lun useful for collation; the Qing Kangxi Chen Shijie printing circulated widely.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 非洲人康斯坦丁翻译阿拉伯医书
events.title_en: Constantine the African translates Arabic medical books
events.summary: 康斯坦丁（卒约1087）将大量阿拉伯医学著作译为拉丁文并引入萨勒诺，使盖伦—伊斯兰医学进入拉丁欧洲课程。
events.summary_en: Constantine (died about 1087) translated a large body of Arabic medicine into Latin and brought it to Salerno, so that Galenic-Islamic medicine entered the Latin European curriculum.

events.title: 太医局卖药所
events.title_en: The Imperial Medical Bureau’s drug-selling office
events.summary: 1076年官办太医局设卖药所（后发展为和剂局），推行官药与成药，体现国家医药供应制度化。
events.summary_en: In 1076 the official Imperial Medical Bureau set up a drug-selling office, later developed into the Imperial Pharmacy. It promoted official drugs and prepared medicines and shows the institutionalization of state drug supply.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

sources: 真柳诚论文（日本医史学杂志）
events.title: 太医局独立，设三科九科
events.title_en: Medical Bureau made independent with nine specialties
events.summary: 熙宁九年（1076），太医局脱离太常寺独立，按方脉科、针科、疡科三科招生，每科定员100人，又细分为九科：大方脉、小方脉、风科、产科、针兼灸、口齿兼咽喉、眼科、疮肿兼折伤、金镞兼书禁。小方脉科的设立也标志着儿科教育走向制度化。
events.summary_en: In 1076 the bureau became independent, with three departments of 100 students each, subdivided into nine specialties including paediatrics and obstetrics.

events.title: 唐慎微《证类本草》
events.title_en: Tang Shenwei, Classified Materia Medica
events.summary: 唐慎微约1082年成《经史证类备急本草》，集宋以前本草大成，李时珍《纲目》多本于此。
events.summary_en: About 1082 Tang Shenwei completed the Classified Materia Medica from Historical Classics for Emergencies. It summed up the pre-Song materia medica, and Li Shizhen’s Compendium drew heavily on it.
works_en: Classified Materia Medica from Historical Classics for Emergencies
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.caption: 《经史证类大观本草》书页
image.caption_en: Texte chinois de la pharmacopée, écrit sans aucune ponctuation

sources: 真柳诚论文（日本医史学杂志）
events.title: 礼部奏请向地方派遣医学教官
events.title_en: Medical instructors dispatched to the provinces
events.summary: 元丰六年（1083），礼部奏请向地方派遣教官，按人口多少确定医生名额，用《难经》《素问》《伤寒论》《病源候论》《圣惠方》进行教学和考试，把官方医学教育推行到京城以外。
events.summary_en: In 1083 the Ministry of Rites proposed sending medical instructors to localities, with quotas proportional to population and teaching based on the standard medical classics.

events.title: 养老奉亲书
events.title_en: Yanglao Fengqin Shu
events.summary: 北宋陈直撰，现存最早的老年医学专著，重饮食调养。
events.summary_en: By Chen Zhi of the Northern Song; the earliest surviving monograph on geriatrics, emphasizing dietary regulation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒微旨论
events.title_en: Shanghan Weizhi Lun
events.summary: 北宋韩祗和撰，主张伤寒用药须随时节调整，今存《四库全书》本等。
events.summary_en: By Han Zhihe of the Northern Song; argues that cold-damage treatment should follow the season. Extant in the Siku Quanshu and other editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

sources: 真柳诚论文（日本医史学杂志）
events.title: 国子监刊行小字本医书
events.title_en: Cheap small-character editions of medical classics
events.summary: 元祐三年（1088），朝廷刊行小字本《伤寒论》《圣惠方》等三种书；绍圣三年（1096）又刊行《千金翼方》《金匮要略》《脉经》《嘉祐本草》《图经本草》五种。这些廉价医书的普及，目的在于提高民间医生和外州军的医疗水平。
events.summary_en: Inexpensive small-print editions issued in 1088 and 1096 spread official medical texts to commoner physicians and provincial garrisons.

events.title: 苏沈良方
events.title_en: Su Shen Liangfang
events.summary: 后人将沈括《良方》与苏轼《苏学士方》合编而成，载医话与验方。
events.summary_en: A later compilation combining Shen Kuo's Liangfang and Su Shi's Su Xueshi Fang, recording medical notes and tested formulas.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 史载之方
events.title_en: Shi Zaizhi Fang
events.summary: 宋代史堪撰，重脉证方论，现存宋刻残本，清光绪间收入《十万卷楼丛书》。
events.summary_en: By Shi Kan of the Song, stressing pulse, pattern and formula discussion; a fragmentary Song edition survives and it was included in the Shiwan Juanlou Congshu in the Guangxu era.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 特罗图拉与萨勒诺妇科传统
events.title_en: Trotula and the Salernitan gynecological tradition
events.summary: 托名或相关的《特罗图拉》文集约于11–12世纪在萨勒诺形成，是中世纪欧洲重要的妇科与妇女健康文献。
events.summary_en: The Trotula ensemble, attributed or related to Trotula, took shape at Salerno in the 11th–12th centuries. It is an important medieval European text on gynecology and women’s health.

image.author: Miscellanea medica XVIII
image.caption: 特罗图拉像，14 世纪抄本
image.caption_en: Pen and wash drawing showing a standing female healer, perhaps of Trotula, clothed in red and green with a white headdress, holding up a uri

events.yearLabel: 约北宋元符前后（11世纪末）
events.yearLabel_en: c. Yuanfu era, Northern Song (late 11th c.)
events.title: 伤寒总病论
events.title_en: Shanghan Zongbing Lun
events.summary: 北宋庞安时撰，论伤寒与时行温病并辨寒温。今传《四库全书》本及清刻本。
events.summary_en: By Pang Anshi of the Northern Song on cold damage and seasonal warm disease. Transmitted in the Siku Quanshu and Qing printings.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

sources: 真柳诚论文（日本医史学杂志）
events.title: 国子监新设医学（三百人）
events.title_en: Imperial Academy School of Medicine founded
events.summary: 崇宁二年（1103），朝廷在国子监下新设医学，与太学、律学、武学并列，定员300人，专门培养高级医官，并规定了方脉、针、疡三科的考试用书。大观四年（1110）医学并入太医局，改称太医学。
events.summary_en: In 1103 a 300-student School of Medicine was created under the Imperial Academy alongside the other schools; it merged into the Medical Bureau in 1110.

events.title: 类证活人书
events.title_en: Leizheng Huoren Shu
events.summary: 北宋朱肱撰，以问答形式研究《伤寒论》并按证类列方，有宋刻本系统和明清翻刻本。
events.summary_en: By Zhu Gong of the Northern Song; studies the Shanghan Lun in question-and-answer form with formulas arranged by pattern. Song-based and Ming–Qing reprints exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 与《类证活人书》异名系统
events.yearLabel_en: Alternate-title tradition of the Leizheng Huoren Shu
events.title: 南阳活人书
events.title_en: Nanyang Huoren Shu
events.summary: 一般认为与《类证活人书》为同书异名或递修关系，版本相同，书目另列以供检索。
events.summary_en: Generally regarded as the same work as the Leizheng Huoren Shu under another title or as a revision of it, sharing its textual tradition; listed separately for lookup.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 钱乙《小儿药证直诀》
events.title_en: Qian Yi, Key to Diagnosis and Treatment of Children’s Diseases
events.summary: 钱乙儿科经验由其弟子阎孝忠约1114年整理为《小儿药证直诀》，创立小儿五脏辨证，被誉为儿科之圣。
events.summary_en: Qian Yi’s pediatric experience was arranged about 1114 by his disciple Yan Xiaozhong as the Xiao’er Yaozheng Zhijue. It established five-zang pattern differentiation for children, and Qian Yi is honored as a sage of pediatrics.
works_en: Xiao'er Yaozheng Zhijue (Key to Therapeutics and Patterns in Children)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

sources: 真柳诚论文（日本医史学杂志）
events.title: 州县设立医学
events.title_en: Prefectural and county medical schools
events.summary: 此前的医官培养集中在首都开封。政和五年（1115），朝廷奏准在各州县也设立医学，制度大体仿照中央。
events.summary_en: In 1115 medical schools were extended to prefectures and counties, with regulations broadly modelled on those of the capital.

events.title: 寇宗奭《本草衍义》
events.title_en: Kou Zongshi, Extension of the Materia Medica
events.summary: 寇宗奭约1116年著《本草衍义》，强调鉴别与药性辨析，补充《证类本草》。
events.summary_en: About 1116 Kou Zongshi wrote the Bencao Yanyi. It stresses identification and the analysis of drug properties and supplements the Classified Materia Medica.
works_en: Bencao Yanyi (Extension of the Materia Medica)

events.title: 《圣济总录》
events.title_en: Comprehensive Recording of Sage-like Benefaction
events.summary: 政和年间官修《圣济总录》（约1117），超200卷，是宋代最大型医学全书之一。
events.summary_en: The Shengji Zonglu, an official compilation of the Zhenghe era (about 1117), runs to more than 200 volumes and is one of the largest medical compendia of the Song.
works_en: Shengji Zonglu (Comprehensive Recording of Sage-like Benefaction)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 全生指迷方
events.title_en: Quansheng Zhimi Fang
events.summary: 北宋王贶撰方书，重辨证与脉候，今存《四库全书》本等。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Wang Kuang of the Northern Song stressing pattern and pulse differentiation; extant in the Siku Quanshu and other editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 小儿药证直诀（宋书明刊）
events.title_en: Key to Therapeutics of Children's Diseases (Ming reprint)
events.summary: 北宋钱乙原著《小儿药证直诀》，经阎孝忠整理，宣和元年（1119）刊行；本条记录其明代翻刻本系统。年份取原书刊行年，明刻具体年份不详，可信度中等。
events.summary_en: Qian Yi's Northern Song pediatric classic, edited by Yan Xiaozhong and first printed in 1119; this entry records its Ming reprint tradition. The year given is the original printing, and Ming reprint dates are unspecified.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 伦敦圣巴塞洛缪医院创办
events.title_en: Founding of St Bartholomew’s Hospital, London
events.summary: 1123年宫廷弄臣拉赫尔创办圣巴塞洛缪医院，是英格兰持续运作最久的医院之一，早期亦收治精神患者。
events.summary_en: In 1123 the courtier Rahere founded St Bartholomew’s Hospital. It is one of the longest continuously operating hospitals in England, and in its early years it also received patients with mental illness.

events.title: 千金宝要
events.title_en: Qianjin Baoyao
events.summary: 宋代郭思节录孙思邈方而成，曾刻石于华州，今存拓本。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Guo Si of the Song by excerpting Sun Simiao's formulas; once carved in stone at Huazhou, with rubbings surviving.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 约南宋初（一题《保幼大全》）
events.yearLabel_en: c. early Southern Song (also titled Baoyou Daquan)
events.title: 小儿卫生总微论方
events.title_en: Xiaoer Weisheng Zongwei Lunfang
events.summary: 宋人佚名所撰儿科方论，一题《保幼大全》，有宋刻本系统和明刻本。
events.summary_en: An anonymous Song pediatric work, also titled Baoyou Daquan; Song-based and Ming editions exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 产育宝庆集
events.title_en: Chanyu Baoqing Ji
events.summary: 北宋末至南宋初产科著作，收入《当归草堂医学丛书》。
events.summary_en: An obstetrics work of the late Northern to early Southern Song, included in the Danggui Caotang Yixue Congshu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 许叔微伤寒著作
events.title_en: Xu Shuwei’s writings on cold damage
events.summary: 许叔微南宋初年著《伤寒百证歌》等，推动《伤寒论》歌赋化与临床普及。
events.summary_en: In the early Southern Song, Xu Shuwei wrote Songs of a Hundred Cold-Damage Patterns and other works, helping to turn the Shanghan Lun into verse and to spread it in clinical practice.
works_en: Songs of a Hundred Cold-Damage Patterns

events.title: 普济本事方
events.title_en: Puji Benshi Fang
events.summary: 南宋许叔微撰方书，载其亲身验方与医案。有宋元明刻本及《四库全书》本。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Xu Shuwei of the Southern Song recording his tested formulas and cases. Song–Ming printings and the Siku Quanshu text exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 鸡峰普济方
events.title_en: Jifeng Puji Fang
events.summary: 南宋张锐撰方书，今存清刻本及《四库全书》本。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Zhang Rui of the Southern Song, extant in Qing printings and the Siku Quanshu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伊本·祖赫尔（阿文佐亚）
events.title_en: Ibn Zuhr (Avenzoar)
events.summary: 伊本·祖赫尔（Avenzoar，约1090–1162）强调实验观察与外科，是阿维罗伊之师，代表安达卢斯临床医学高峰。
events.summary_en: Ibn Zuhr (Avenzoar, about 1090–1162) emphasized experimental observation and surgery. He was Averroes’s teacher and represents a high point of clinical medicine in al-Andalus.

events.title: 伤寒百证歌、伤寒发微论
events.title_en: Shanghan Baizheng Ge and Shanghan Fawei Lun
events.summary: 南宋许叔微的伤寒歌诀与论著，多附于《仲景全书》刻本，单行本系统待考。
events.summary_en: Cold-damage verses and a treatise by Xu Shuwei of the Southern Song, mostly transmitted as appendices to Zhongjing Quanshu printings; stand-alone editions remain to be traced.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 成无己《注解伤寒论》
events.title_en: Cheng Wuji's Annotated Shanghan lun
events.summary: 金代聊摄人成无己依据《内经》《难经》，对《伤寒论》作了全面注释，是现存最早的《伤寒论》全注本。一般认为此书成于金皇统四年（1144）。他另著有《伤寒明理论》。
events.summary_en: Cheng Wuji of the Jin dynasty annotated the Shanghan lun comprehensively on the basis of the Neijing and Nanjing; it is the earliest surviving full commentary and is generally dated to 1144.

events.title: 扁鹊心书
events.title_en: Bianque Xinshu
events.summary: 题扁鹊撰，实为南宋窦材所著，重灸法与扶阳，有清刻本，属托名之作。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Bian Que but actually by Dou Cai of the Southern Song; stresses moxibustion and yang support. Qing printings exist; the attribution is pseudepigraphic.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 希尔德加德《自然学》与《病因与疗法》
events.title_en: Hildegard of Bingen's Physica and Causae et curae
events.summary: 莱茵兰本笃会女修道院长宾根的希尔德加德（1098–1179）的医学著述分为两部：《自然学》系统记载植物、动物、矿物的疗效，《病因与疗法》将人体论与宇宙论结合为实用医疗指南。具体成书年份为学界推定。
events.summary_en: Hildegard's medical corpus comprises Physica, cataloguing healing properties of plants, animals and minerals, and Causae et curae, a cosmologically framed practical guide.

events.title: 幼幼新书
events.title_en: Youyou Xinshu
events.summary: 南宋刘昉等编的大型儿科著作，集宋以前儿科文献，日本藏宋本，国内有影刊与点校本。
events.summary_en: A large pediatric compilation by Liu Fang and colleagues of the Southern Song; a Song edition is held in Japan, with facsimile and punctuated editions in China.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 卫济宝书
events.title_en: Weiji Baoshu
events.summary: 宋代东轩居士撰，论痈疽辨治，是最早记载“癌”字的文献之一，现存为清辑本。
events.summary_en: By Dongxuan Jushi of the Song on carbuncles and abscesses; among the earliest sources recording the character for cancer. The extant text is a Qing reconstruction.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 约公元8世纪末初成；12世纪定型
events.yearLabel_en: c. late 8th c. first compiled; finalized in the 12th c.
events.title: 四部医典
events.title_en: Four Tantras (rGyud bzhi, Si Bu Yi Dian)
events.summary: 藏医根本经典，传统认为由宇妥·宁玛·云丹贡布编著，12世纪经宇妥·萨玛·云丹贡布修订定型，分根本、论说、秘诀、后续四部。藏文木刻本有扎塘版、达丹版、布达拉宫（雪）版、德格版等，17世纪起有蒙文译本。
events.summary_en: The foundational classic of Tibetan medicine, traditionally attributed to Yutok Nyingma Yonten Gonpo and revised into its final form in the 12th century by Yutok Sarma Yonten Gonpo. Its four parts are the Root, Explanatory, Instructional and Subsequent Tantras. Tibetan woodblock editions include Zhol, Dadan, Potala and Derge; Mongolian translations date from the 17th century.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
中国哲学书电子化计划(ctext)相关条目

events.title: 《太平惠民和剂局方》
events.title_en: Formulary of the Taiping Imperial Pharmacy
events.summary: 1151年定本《太平惠民和剂局方》推广官药成方，影响东亚配方传统，亦因“局方滥用”遭金元医家批评。
events.summary_en: The 1151 standard text of the Taiping Huimin Heji Jufang spread official prepared formulas. It influenced the East Asian formula tradition and was also criticized by Jin-Yuan physicians for overuse of the pharmacy’s formulas.
works_en: Taiping Huimin Heji Jufang (Formulary of the Taiping Imperial Pharmacy)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 子午流注针经
events.title_en: Ziwu Liuzhu Zhenjing
events.summary: 金代何若愚撰、阎明广注，论按时取穴的子午流注法，见于《针灸四书》。
events.summary_en: By He Ruoyu with annotations by Yan Mingguang of the Jin; discusses time-based point selection, found in the Zhenjiu Sishu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 大马士革努里医院
events.title_en: The Nuri Hospital in Damascus
events.summary: 努尔丁约于1154–1160年创办大马士革努里医院，兼作医校，患者免费获药与食，病历管理先进，建筑部分存留至今。
events.summary_en: About 1154–1160 Nur al-Din founded the Nuri Hospital in Damascus. It also served as a medical school. Patients received drugs and food free of charge, case records were advanced, and part of the building survives.

events.title: 阿维罗伊医学与哲学
events.title_en: Averroes on medicine and philosophy
events.summary: 伊本·鲁世德（Averroes，1126–1198）注释亚里士多德并撰写医学著作，影响拉丁经院医学哲学讨论。
events.summary_en: Ibn Rushd (Averroes, 1126–1198) commented on Aristotle and wrote medical works. He influenced Latin scholastic discussion of medical philosophy.

events.title: 罗杰《外科学》
events.title_en: Roger of Salerno, Surgery
events.summary: 萨勒诺的罗杰约于1170年写成《外科学》（Chirurgia），成为中世纪拉丁外科教学的基础文本。
events.summary_en: About 1170 Roger of Salerno wrote the Chirurgia, which became a basic text of medieval Latin surgical teaching.

events.title: 克雷莫纳的杰拉德在托莱多译《医典》
events.title_en: Gerard of Cremona translates Avicenna's Canon in Toledo
events.summary: 意大利学者克雷莫纳的杰拉德（约1114–1187）在托莱多利用当地阿拉伯藏书，将包括伊本·西那《医典》在内的数十部著作译为拉丁文，据称达76部，为欧洲大学医学提供了核心教材。
events.summary_en: Working in Toledo, Gerard of Cremona (c. 1114–1187), the most prolific Arabic–Latin translator, rendered Avicenna's Canon among some 76 works.

events.title: 陈言《三因极一病证方论》
events.title_en: Chen Yan's Treatise on the Three Categories of Causes
events.summary: 南宋莆田人陈言（字无择）撰《三因极一病证方论》十八卷，把病因归纳为内因、外因、不内外因三类，后世病因学多沿用这一框架。成书年代按通行说法定为1174年。
events.summary_en: Chen Yan (courtesy name Wuzhe) of Putian compiled the 18-fascicle Sanyin jiyi bingzheng fanglun, classifying causes of disease as internal, external and neither; it is conventionally dated to 1174.

events.title: 刘完素寒凉学派
events.title_en: Liu Wansu and the cold-and-cool school
events.summary: 金代刘完素（约1110–1200）倡火热病机与寒凉清热，开河间学派，为金元四大家之一。
events.summary_en: Liu Wansu of the Jin (about 1110–1200) advocated fire-heat pathology and cold-cool clearing of heat. He opened the Hejian school and is one of the Four Great Masters of the Jin and Yuan.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 伤寒补亡论
events.title_en: Shanghan Buwang Lun
events.summary: 南宋郭雍撰，补充《伤寒论》缺佚内容，今存《四库全书》本等。
events.summary_en: By Guo Yong of the Southern Song; supplements material missing from the Shanghan Lun. Extant in the Siku Quanshu and other editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 卫生家宝产科备要
events.title_en: Weisheng Jiabao Chanke Beiyao
events.summary: 宋代朱端章编，集宋以前产育文献，有宋刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Zhu Duanzhang of the Song, gathering earlier obstetric literature; a Song printing survives.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 素问玄机原病式
events.title_en: Suwen Xuanji Yuanbing Shi
events.summary: 金代刘完素撰，以运气与火热论阐发《素问》病机十九条，为寒凉派代表著作，收入《河间六书》。
events.summary_en: By Liu Wansu of the Jin; explains the nineteen pathomechanisms of the Suwen through qi-transformation and fire-heat theory. A representative text of the cold-cooling school, included in the Hejian Liushu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 素问病机气宜保命集
events.title_en: Suwen Bingji Qiyi Baoming Ji
events.summary: 题刘完素撰（一说张元素，存异），以运气与病机论治杂病，作者归属有异说，收入《河间六书》。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Liu Wansu (some say Zhang Yuansu); treats miscellaneous disorders through qi-transformation and pathomechanism. Authorship is disputed; included in the Hejian Liushu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医说
events.title_en: Yishuo
events.summary: 宋代张杲撰，记载医史典故、名医传记与医案，为早期医史笔记体著作，存宋刻残本和明嘉靖刻本。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Gao of the Song, recording medical history, physicians' biographies and cases; an early notebook-style medical history. A fragmentary Song edition and a Ming Jiajing printing survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 迈蒙尼德《论哮喘》
events.title_en: Maimonides' Treatise on Asthma
events.summary: 犹太哲学家、宫廷医生迈蒙尼德在开罗为一位患哮喘的贵族撰《论哮喘》，从饮食、环境、预防到治疗系统论述，体现其逻辑化的疾病防治思路；他另有《医学格言》等十余部医著。
events.summary_en: Maimonides' Treatise on Asthma, written for a noble patient, shows his systematic approach to prevention, diagnosis and treatment.

events.title: 宣明论方
events.title_en: Xuanming Lunfang
events.summary: 金代刘完素撰方书，按病证分门列方，收入《河间六书》，今存明刻本。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Liu Wansu of the Jin arranged by disease category; included in the Hejian Liushu and extant in Ming printings.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒直格
events.title_en: Shanghan Zhige
events.summary: 题金代刘完素撰，论伤寒证治，收入《河间六书》，具体成书年不详。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Liu Wansu of the Jin on cold-damage patterns and treatment; included in the Hejian Liushu. Exact composition date unknown.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 集验背疽方
events.title_en: Jiyan Beiju Fang
events.summary: 宋代李迅撰背疽专论，为宋代外科专著之一。
events.summary_en: A monograph on dorsal carbuncles by Li Xun of the Song, one of the Song surgical monographs.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 《太医局诸科程文格》
events.title_en: Examination Answers and Standards of the Imperial Medical Bureau
events.summary: 宋人何大任辑《太医局诸科程文格》，收录太医局各科考试的范文和标准，是研究宋代医学考试制度现存最直接的文献。
events.summary_en: Compiled by He Daren of the Song, the Taiyiju zhuke chengwen ge collects model answers and standards for the Imperial Medical Bureau examinations, the most direct surviving source on Song medical examinations.

events.title: 珍珠囊
events.title_en: Zhenzhu Nang
events.summary: 题金代张元素撰（一说李杲），论药物性味归经与引经报使，作者归属有异说，见于《济生拔萃》等丛书。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Zhang Yuansu of the Jin (some say Li Gao); discusses drug properties, channel tropism and guiding agents. Authorship is disputed; found in collections such as the Jisheng Bacui.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 张从正攻下学派
events.title_en: Zhang Congzheng and the attack-and-purge school
events.summary: 张从正（约1150–1228）主张攻邪安正，善用汗吐下，称攻下派，为金元四大家之一。
events.summary_en: Zhang Congzheng (about 1150–1228) held that one should attack pathogenic factors in order to restore the upright qi. He was skilled with sweating, vomiting, and purging. He is called the attack-and-purge master and is one of the Four Great Masters of the Jin and Yuan.
works_en: Rumen Shiqin (Confucians' Duties to Their Parents)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 蒙彼利埃医学大学规章
events.title_en: Statutes of the University of Medicine at Montpellier
events.summary: 蒙彼利埃医学教学12世纪已兴，1220年获正式大学规章，与萨勒诺、巴黎并列为中世纪欧洲医学重镇。
events.summary_en: Medical teaching at Montpellier was already active in the 12th century. In 1220 it received formal university statutes and stood with Salerno and Paris as a major center of medieval European medicine.

events.yearLabel: 金兴定至正大间（约1220前后）
events.title: 儒门事亲
events.title_en: Rumen Shiqin
events.summary: 金代张从正撰、麻知几等整理，系统论述汗吐下三法，为攻下派代表著作，有明嘉靖刻本等。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Congzheng of the Jin, compiled with Ma Zhiji and others; systematically expounds the sweating, vomiting and purging methods. A representative text of the attacking school; Ming Jiajing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 女科百问
events.title_en: Nuke Baiwen
events.summary: 南宋齐仲甫撰妇科著作，以问答论述妇产诸证，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A gynecology work in question-and-answer form by Qi Zhongfu of the Southern Song; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 备急灸法
events.title_en: Beiji Jiufa
events.summary: 南宋闻人耆年撰灸法专书，记载急症灸治，国内早佚，据日藏本影刊。
events.summary_en: A moxibustion text by Wenren Qinian of the Southern Song on emergency treatment; lost early in China and reproduced from a Japanese-held copy.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 针灸资生经
events.title_en: Zhenjiu Zisheng Jing
events.summary: 宋代王执中撰，以病症统穴位，载针灸验案与禁忌，为宋代针灸临床代表作，存元刻本。
events.summary_en: By Wang Zhizhong of the Song; organizes points by symptom and records clinical results and taboos. A representative Song clinical acupuncture text; a Yuan printing survives.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 内外伤辨惑论
events.title_en: Neiwai Shang Bianhuo Lun
events.summary: 金元李杲（东垣）撰，辨析内伤与外感，是脾胃学说的重要著作，收入《东垣十书》。
events.summary_en: By Li Gao (Dongyuan); distinguishes internal damage from external contraction and is a key text of the spleen–stomach doctrine. Included in the Dongyuan Shishu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 陈自明《妇人大全良方》
events.title_en: Chen Ziming, Complete Good Formulas for Women
events.summary: 陈自明1237年著《妇人大全良方》，系统总结宋以前妇科，是中医妇科里程碑；后又有《外科精要》。
events.summary_en: In 1237 Chen Ziming wrote the Furen Daquan Liangfang, a systematic summation of pre-Song gynecology and a milestone in Chinese gynecology. He later also wrote Essentials of External Medicine.
works_en: Furen Daquan Liangfang (Complete Good Formulas for Women)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 李东垣补土学派
events.title_en: Li Dongyuan and the earth-supplementing school
events.summary: 李杲（东垣，约1180–1251）著《脾胃论》，倡内伤脾胃学说与甘温除热，开创补土派。
events.summary_en: Li Gao (Dongyuan, about 1180–1251) wrote the Treatise on the Spleen and Stomach. He advocated the doctrine of internal damage to the spleen and stomach and the sweet-warm method of clearing heat, and he founded the earth-supplementing school.
works_en: Piwei Lun (Treatise on the Spleen and Stomach)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 察病指南
events.title_en: Chabing Zhinan
events.summary: 南宋施发撰诊法著作，载脉图三十三种，国内早佚，后由日本抄本回流并影印出版。
events.summary_en: A diagnostic work by Shi Fa of the Southern Song with 33 pulse diagrams; lost early in China and later reintroduced from Japanese manuscripts.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伊本·纳菲斯肺循环学说
events.title_en: Ibn al-Nafis on the pulmonary circulation
events.summary: 伊本·纳菲斯提出右心室与左心室分隔，描述肺循环与冠状循环，挑战盖伦多孔中隔说，早于欧洲同类认识数百年。
events.summary_en: Ibn al-Nafis argued that the right and left ventricles are separated, and he described the pulmonary circulation and the coronary circulation. He challenged Galen’s porous septum centuries before comparable European accounts.

The opening page of one of Ibn al-Nafis's medical works. This is probably a copy made in India during the 17th or 18th century.

events.title: 宋慈《洗冤集录》
events.title_en: Song Ci, Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified
events.summary: 宋慈1247年著《洗冤集录》，是世界最早系统法医学专著之一，详述尸检与伤害鉴定。
events.summary_en: In 1247 Song Ci wrote the Xiyuan Jilu, one of the world’s earliest systematic works of forensic medicine. It describes autopsy and the assessment of injuries in detail.
works_en: Xiyuan Jilu (Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.caption: 《洗冤录集证》（1843）骨骼图
image.caption_en: Nomenclature of human bones in Song Ci: ‘Collected records on washing away of unjust imputations’ (Sòng Cí: Xǐ-yuān lù jí-zhèng, 1843 editio

events.title: 伊本·拜塔尔本草
events.title_en: Ibn al-Baytar’s materia medica
events.summary: 伊本·拜塔尔约1248年完成大型本草与药学著作，广收地中海与东方药物，是中世纪药学集大成者之一。
events.summary_en: About 1248 Ibn al-Baytar completed a large work of materia medica and pharmacy. It gathers Mediterranean and eastern drugs and is one of the medieval summations of pharmacy.

events.foundSite: 内蒙古额济纳旗黑水城遗址
events.title: 黑水城出土医方与《神仙方论》类文书
events.title_en: Khara-Khoto Medical Prescriptions and Immortality-Recipe Texts
events.summary: 1908—1909年科兹洛夫考察队在内蒙古额济纳旗黑水城遗址掘获；1983—1984年内蒙古文物考古研究所再掘。含医方、药名，兼有西夏文医籍。
events.summary_en: Excavated 1908-1909 by the Kozlov expedition at Khara-Khoto, Ejina Banner, and again in 1983-1984; includes prescriptions, drug names and Tangut-language medical texts.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Texts (user-provided)

events.title: 云岐子论经络迎随补泻法
events.title_en: Yunqizi on Channel Meeting-and-Following Tonification and Drainage
events.summary: 题张璧（云岐子）撰，论经络迎随补泻针法，见于《济生拔萃》等丛书。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Zhang Bi (Yunqizi); discusses meeting-and-following tonification and drainage techniques, found in collections such as the Jisheng Bacui.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 金元间赋文，明以后通行
events.yearLabel_en: Jin–Yuan verse; widely circulated after the Ming
events.title: 珍珠囊补遗药性赋
events.title_en: Zhenzhunang Buyi Yaoxing Fu
events.summary: 旧题李杲，实为后人增益，是以赋体概括药性的本草歌赋，明清刻本极多。
events.summary_en: Traditionally attributed to Li Gao but augmented by later hands; a rhymed-prose materia medica with very many Ming and Qing editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 脾胃论
events.title_en: Piwei Lun
events.summary: 李杲晚年撰，系统阐述“内伤脾胃，百病由生”的学说，为补土派核心著作。
events.summary_en: Written late in Li Gao's life; sets out the doctrine that damage to the spleen and stomach gives rise to many diseases. The core text of the Earth-supplementing school.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 阴证略例
events.title_en: Yinzheng Lueli
events.summary: 元代王好古撰，论伤寒阴证辨治并附医案，今存明刻本。
events.summary_en: By Wang Haogu of the Yuan; discusses identification and treatment of yin patterns in cold damage, with cases. Ming printings are extant.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 严氏济生方
events.title_en: Yanshi Jisheng Fang
events.summary: 南宋严用和撰方书，论内科杂病与脏腑辨证。有元刻本及日本影元本。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Yan Yonghe of the Southern Song on internal disorders and visceral patterns. A Yuan printing and a Japanese facsimile exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 塔代奥·阿尔德罗蒂与博洛尼亚大学医学
events.title_en: Taddeo Alderotti and the Bologna medical school
events.summary: 佛罗伦萨人塔代奥·阿尔德罗蒂（卒1295前后）在博洛尼亚建立学术声望卓著的医学学派，推动经院式医学教育；蒙迪诺等人即出自其门下，1292年获医学学位。
events.summary_en: Taddeo Alderotti built a prestigious medical school at Bologna; Mondino de' Liuzzi graduated from it in 1292.

events.title: 兰室秘藏
events.title_en: Lanshi Micang
events.summary: 李杲撰，由门人整理，分门论述内、妇、五官诸证并载方，收入《东垣十书》。
events.summary_en: By Li Gao, compiled by disciples; treats internal, gynecological and sensory-organ disorders by category with formulas. Included in the Dongyuan Shishu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 此事难知
events.title_en: Cishi Nanzhi
events.summary: 元代王好古撰医论，记述其师李杲的学术心得，收入《东垣十书》。
events.summary_en: Medical essays by Wang Haogu of the Yuan recording Li Gao's insights; included in the Dongyuan Shishu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 针经指南
events.title_en: Zhenjing Zhinan
events.summary: 元初窦默（窦汉卿）撰针灸著作，见于《针灸四书》。
events.summary_en: An acupuncture text by Dou Mo (Dou Hanqing) of the early Yuan, found in the Zhenjiu Sishu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 标幽赋
events.title_en: Biaoyou Fu
events.summary: 元初窦默撰的针灸歌赋，多附见于针灸类书籍。
events.summary_en: A rhymed acupuncture ode by Dou Mo of the early Yuan, usually appended to acupuncture works.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 外科精要（陈自明；薛己注）
events.title_en: Essentials of External Medicine (with Xue Ji's annotations)
events.summary: 南宋陈自明原著《外科精要》，明代薛己为之作注，明刻本流传。本条取原书景定四年（1263）为年份，薛注本具体刊行时间待考，可信度中等。
events.summary_en: Chen Ziming's Southern Song surgical text Waike Jingyao, annotated by Xue Ji in the Ming. The year given is the original 1263 date; the annotated edition's printing date is unspecified, so confidence is medium.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 博尔戈尼奥尼《外科学》与干燥伤口愈合
events.title_en: Theodoric Borgognoni's Cyrurgia
events.summary: 博洛尼亚外科医生、主教泰奥多里科·博尔戈尼奥尼著四卷本《外科学》，系统论述外科各领域，反对伤口“可赞之脓”说，主张清洁干燥促进愈合。成书年份为通常记载。
events.summary_en: Bishop-surgeon Theodoric Borgognoni wrote the four-volume Cyrurgia and argued against laudable pus in wound healing.
people: 泰奥多里科·博尔戈尼奥尼

events.title: 御药院方
events.title_en: Yuyaoyuan Fang
events.summary: 元代许国祯等编，辑录宫廷御药院用方，国内无完本，据日藏元本影印。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Xu Guozhen and others from Imperial Dispensary formulas; no complete copy remained in China and it was reproduced from a Yuan copy held in Japan.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 卫生宝鉴
events.title_en: Weisheng Baojian
events.summary: 元代罗天益撰，承李杲之学，兼论内科杂病、方药并载医案，有元刻本和明刻本。
events.summary_en: By Luo Tianyi of the Yuan, a disciple of Li Gao; covers internal disorders, formulas and cases. Yuan and Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医垒元戎
events.title_en: Yilei Yuanrong
events.summary: 元代王好古撰方书，今存明刻本。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Wang Haogu of the Yuan; extant in Ming printings.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 风科集验名方
events.title_en: Fengke Jiyan Mingfang
events.summary: 元代赵素等编风科方书，有元刻本和明刻本。
events.summary_en: A formulary on wind disorders compiled by Zhao Su and others of the Yuan; Yuan and Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 开罗曼苏里医院
events.title_en: The Mansuri Hospital in Cairo
events.summary: 1284年开罗曼苏里医院落成，规模巨大、分科齐全，是马穆鲁克时期伊斯兰医院的典范。
events.summary_en: The Mansuri Hospital in Cairo was completed in 1284. It was huge and fully divided into specialties, a model Islamic hospital of the Mamluk period.

events.title: 凸透镜眼镜矫正远视
events.title_en: Convex spectacles for farsightedness
events.summary: 约13世纪末意大利出现凸透镜眼镜治疗远视，是光学辅助医疗的重要发明。
events.summary_en: In the late 13th century convex-lens spectacles for farsightedness appeared in Italy, an important invention in optical aids to medicine.

events.title: 佛罗伦萨新圣母医院
events.title_en: Santa Maria Nuova in Florence
events.summary: 1288年佛罗伦萨新圣母医院创办，以纯医疗功能著称，成为文艺复兴城市医院样板。
events.summary_en: Santa Maria Nuova in Florence was founded in 1288. It was known for a purely medical function and became a model Renaissance civic hospital.

events.title: 汤液本草
events.title_en: Tangye Bencao
events.summary: 元代王好古撰，承张元素、李杲药学，论药物气味升降与归经，今存明刻本。
events.summary_en: By Wang Haogu of the Yuan; builds on Zhang Yuansu and Li Gao's pharmacology, treating drug qi, flavor and channel entry. Extant in Ming printings.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 活幼心书
events.title_en: Huoyou Xinshu
events.summary: 元代曾世荣撰儿科著作，总结幼科证治经验，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A pediatric work by Zeng Shirong of the Yuan summarizing clinical experience; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 《回回药方》
events.title_en: Huihui yaofang (Muslim Formulary)
events.summary: 《回回药方》是元代汇编的伊斯兰医学方书，很可能是蒙元官方使用的方书。现存三卷中载有517种用阿拉伯文或波斯文命名并附汉字音译的药物，现存部分约占原书的15%，为明代刊本。具体成书年份不明。
events.summary_en: The Huihui yaofang is an Islamic medical formulary compiled under the Yuan, probably used officially by the Mongol administration. The surviving three chapters list 517 drugs with Arabic or Persian names and Chinese transliterations; about 15% of the work survives, in a Ming edition.
events.summary_add: 现存为明红格抄本残卷，著者待考，汉文译述；是研究回回医药及阿拉伯—波斯医学在元明中国传播的重要文献，宋岘有《回回药方考释》。

events.title: 亨利·德·蒙德维尔的外科著作
events.title_en: Henri de Mondeville's Chirurgie
events.summary: 法国王室外科医生亨利·德·蒙德维尔曾在博洛尼亚学习，与蒙迪诺同窗，后撰未完成的《外科学》，称其伤口处理技术来自战场实践经验，继承博尔戈尼奥尼的干燥愈合主张。
events.summary_en: Henri de Mondeville, fellow student of Mondino at Bologna, wrote an unfinished Chirurgie, claiming battlefield experience in wound management.

events.title: 寿亲养老新书
events.title_en: Shouqin Yanglao Xinshu
events.summary: 元代邹铉增补陈直《养老奉亲书》而成，汇集宋元养生养老诸法。
events.summary_en: Zou Xuan of the Yuan expanded Chen Zhi's Yanglao Fengqin Shu, gathering Song–Yuan methods of health cultivation and elder care.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 蒙迪诺《解剖学》与公开解剖
events.title_en: Mondino’s Anathomia and public dissection
events.summary: 博洛尼亚的蒙迪诺约于1315年公开解剖人体，1316年著《解剖学》，恢复系统性人体解剖教学，影响文艺复兴解剖。
events.summary_en: About 1315 Mondino de’ Luzzi of Bologna publicly dissected a human body, and in 1316 he wrote the Anathomia. He restored systematic teaching of human anatomy and influenced Renaissance anatomy.

image.caption: 蒙迪诺《解剖学》书页
image.caption_en: Page from 'De omnibus humani corporis interioribus membris Anathomia' ("Anatomy of all interior parts of the human body"), a text first publ

events.title: 永类钤方
events.title_en: Yonglei Qianfang
events.summary: 元代李仲南撰方书，含骨伤内容，有元刻残本和明刻本。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Li Zhongnan of the Yuan that includes bone-injury material; a fragmentary Yuan edition and Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 元天历至至正间（约1326前后）
events.title: 瑞竹堂经验方
events.title_en: Ruizhutang Jingyan Fang
events.summary: 元代萨谦斋（萨德弥实）编方书，有明刻本，日本据元本影刊。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Sa Qianzhai (Sa Demishi) of the Yuan; Ming printings exist and a Yuan edition was reproduced in Japan.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 忽思慧《饮膳正要》
events.title_en: Hu Sihui's Yinshan zhengyao (Proper Essentials of Food and Drink)
events.summary: 元代饮膳太医忽思慧撰成《饮膳正要》，汇集宫廷食疗方、饮食宜忌与养生法，是现存较早的系统营养与食疗专著。
events.summary_en: Hu Sihui, dietary physician at the Yuan court, completed the Yinshan zhengyao, gathering court food-therapy recipes, dietary rules and regimen advice. It is one of the earliest surviving systematic works on nutrition and diet therapy.
events.summary_add: 蒙古族作者忽思慧所著，属蒙元宫廷营养食疗，汉文撰述，已见于宋金元章节；本条同时见民族医药专表，作者为蒙古族身份，补入民族医药视角。

events.title: 外科精义
events.title_en: Waike Jingyi
events.summary: 元代齐德之撰外科专书，论疮疡诊治，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: An external-medicine work by Qi Dezhi of the Yuan on sores and ulcers; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 危亦林《世医得效方》
events.title_en: Wei Yilin's Shiyi dexiao fang
events.summary: 元代危亦林据家传五世医术编成《世医得效方》，骨伤部分记载悬吊复位法治疗脊柱骨折，并用草乌等药物作全身麻醉。
events.summary_en: Wei Yilin of the Yuan dynasty compiled the Shiyi dexiao fang from five generations of family practice. Its bone-setting section describes suspension reduction for spinal fractures and general anaesthesia with drugs such as aconite.

events.title: 朱丹溪滋阴学派
events.title_en: Zhu Danxi and the yin-nourishing school
events.summary: 朱震亨（丹溪，1281–1358）倡“阳常有余，阴常不足”，开创滋阴派，完成金元四大家格局。
events.summary_en: Zhu Zhenheng (Danxi, 1281–1358) taught that “yang is often in excess and yin is often insufficient.” He founded the yin-nourishing school and completed the pattern of the Four Great Masters of the Jin and Yuan.
works_en: Gezhi Yulun (Further Discourses on Extending Knowledge)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 《敖氏伤寒金镜录》舌诊图
events.title_en: Ao’s Golden Mirror of Cold Damage, with tongue charts
events.summary: 约1341年《敖氏伤寒金镜录》载舌象图谱，推动舌诊可视化与教学。
events.summary_en: About 1341 Ao’s Golden Mirror of Cold Damage included charts of the tongue, which helped make tongue diagnosis visible and teachable.
works_en: Ao's Golden Mirror of Cold Damage
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 滑寿《十四经发挥》
events.title_en: Hua Shou's Shisi jing fahui (Elucidation of the Fourteen Channels)
events.summary: 滑寿把任、督二脉与十二经并称“十四经”，逐经考订循行与腧穴，对后世经络腧穴学影响深远。
events.summary_en: Hua Shou grouped the Ren and Du vessels with the twelve regular channels as the 'fourteen channels', checking each pathway and its points. The book shaped later channel and acupoint studies.

events.title: 格致余论
events.title_en: Gezhi Yulun
events.summary: 元代朱震亨（丹溪）撰医论集，提出“阳常有余，阴常不足”，为滋阴学派代表著作。
events.summary_en: Essays by Zhu Zhenheng (Danxi) advancing the view that yang is often in excess and yin often deficient; representative of the yin-nourishing school.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 巴黎医学院黑死病咨询报告
events.title_en: Paris medical faculty's plague Compendium
events.summary: 黑死病（1347–1351）席卷欧洲之际，巴黎大学医学院应法王之请于1348年发布《瘟疫纲要》，将病因归于1345年3月20日土星、木星、火星在宝瓶座的“三星合”导致空气腐败，代表中世纪学院医学的权威解释。
events.summary_en: In 1348 the Paris medical faculty attributed the Black Death to a triple planetary conjunction in Aquarius on 20 March 1345 that corrupted the air.

events.title: 局方发挥
events.title_en: Jufang Fahui
events.summary: 元代朱震亨撰，针对《太平惠民和剂局方》偏用温燥提出批评，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: By Zhu Zhenheng of the Yuan; criticizes the Taiping Huimin Heji Jufang for favoring warm, drying drugs. Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医学要解集注遗篇
events.title_en: Y học yếu giải tập chú di biên (Chu Văn An)
events.summary: 朱文安（Chu Van An）撰，越南写本残传，属医经注释类，是现存较早的越南医学文献之一。
events.summary_en: By Chu Văn An; surviving in incomplete Vietnamese manuscripts, a commentary-type text regarded as one of the earlier surviving Vietnamese medical works.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.yearLabel: 元至正二十一年（1361）；明刻传播
events.yearLabel_en: Yuan Zhizheng 21 (1361); spread through Ming prints
events.title: 难经本义
events.title_en: Original Meaning of the Classic of Difficulties (Nanjing Benyi)
events.summary: 滑寿撰，成书于元至正二十一年（1361），明代刻本广为流传，是影响最大的《难经》注本之一。本编作为明代传本择要列入，成书年份取元代。
events.summary_en: By Hua Shou, completed in 1361 (Yuan) and widely circulated through Ming prints, one of the most influential Nanjing commentaries; listed for its Ming transmission, dated by its Yuan composition.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 居伊·德·肖利亚克《大外科学》
events.title_en: Guy de Chauliac, Great Surgery
events.summary: 教皇医师居伊·德·肖利亚克约于1363年完成《大外科学》，综合阿拉伯与拉丁外科，主导晚期中世纪外科实践。
events.summary_en: About 1363 Guy de Chauliac, physician to the pope, completed the Great Surgery. It synthesized Arabic and Latin surgery and dominated late medieval surgical practice.

events.title: 明代以太医院为核心的医政体系
events.title_en: Ming medical administration centered on the Imperial Academy of Medicine
events.summary: 明朝中央集权高度强化，医政管理随之系统化，形成以太医院为中心的体系。太医院总管医疗政令，也负责培养医生，明清两代的太医院制度对后来的官方医学教育和宫廷医疗影响很大。
events.summary_en: Under Ming centralized rule, medical administration became a systematic structure centered on the Imperial Academy of Medicine (Taiyiyuan), which issued medical policy and trained physicians.

events.title: 新安医家入值太医院
events.title_en: Xin'an physicians serving as imperial medical officials
events.summary: 明清时期，徽州新安医学有一批医家进入太医院任职，形成新安御医群体。这个群体对中医学发展有积极影响，是地域医学流派与宫廷医学互动的代表。
events.summary_en: In the Ming and Qing a group of physicians from the Xin'an (Huizhou) tradition served as imperial medical officials, a group that positively influenced the development of Chinese medicine.

events.title: 约翰·阿德恩肛瘘手术
events.title_en: John of Arderne’s operation for anal fistula
events.summary: 英格兰外科医生约翰·阿德恩约14世纪以肛瘘手术闻名，留下详细手术记录，代表中世纪外科专业化。
events.summary_en: The English surgeon John of Arderne, about the 14th century, was famous for operating on anal fistula and left detailed operative records. He represents the professionalization of medieval surgery.

events.yearLabel: 元至正间成书；明洪武间刊行系统
events.yearLabel_en: Composed Zhizheng era (Yuan); printed Hongwu era (Ming)
events.title: 原机启微
events.title_en: Yuanji Qiwei
events.summary: 元明之际倪维德撰眼科专著，明代刊行，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: An ophthalmology monograph by Ni Weide spanning the Yuan–Ming transition; printed in the Ming, Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: c. latter half of the 14th c.
events.title: 南药国语赋、南药神效等
events.title_en: Nam dược quốc ngữ phú and Nam dược thần hiệu
events.summary: 慧静（Tuệ Tĩnh）所撰，以越南国语（喃字）歌赋体介绍南药，有写本与后印本流传，是越南本土药物学的代表。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Tuệ Tĩnh; texts in Nôm verse form introducing Vietnamese ('southern') drugs, circulated in manuscripts and later prints, and representative of indigenous Vietnamese materia medica.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 拉古萨三十日隔离令（检疫起源）
events.title_en: Ragusa's 30-day trentino (origin of quarantine)
events.summary: 1377年7月27日，拉古萨（今杜布罗夫尼克）大议会通过法令，要求来自疫区者隔离30天方可入城；此后各城市效仿并延长为40天，“quarantine”一词由此而来。
events.summary_en: On 27 July 1377 Ragusa's Great Council imposed a 30-day separation for arrivals from plague areas, later extended elsewhere to 40 days (quarantino).

events.title: 伤寒治例
events.title_en: Shanghan Zhili
events.summary: 明代刘纯撰伤寒著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A cold-damage work by Liu Chun of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: Late Yuan-early Ming, c. Hongwu era
events.title: 医经溯洄集
events.title_en: Collected Studies Tracing the Medical Classics (Yijing Suhui Ji)
events.summary: 王履撰，成于元末明初，约在洪武间，以明刻本和《医统正脉》本传世，讨论病机和经典疑义，对伤寒、温病学术讨论有影响。年份取明初近似值。
events.summary_en: By Wang Lü, late Yuan to early Ming, transmitted in Ming prints and the Yitong Zhengmai series; discusses pathogenesis and doubtful points in the classics. Year is an early-Ming approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title_en: Yijing Xiaoxue

events.summary: 题朱震亨撰、戴思恭校补，为丹溪学派医论，有明刻本。

events.title: 金匮方论衍义
events.title_en: Elaboration on the Formulas of the Jingui (Jingui Fanglun Yanyi)
events.summary: 赵以德（元末明初）撰，约成于明初，以清抄本传世，是较早注释《金匮要略》的著作。年份取1400年近似，版本仍待细考。
events.summary_en: By Zhao Yide (late Yuan-early Ming), early Ming, transmitted through Qing manuscripts; an early commentary on the Jingui Yaolue. Year approximated to 1400; editions need further study.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 医方大成（明翻刻）
events.title_en: Great Compendium of Medical Formulae (Yifang Dacheng, Ming reprint)
events.summary: 原为元代孙允贤所撰方书，明代有翻刻本流传。书目将其列入明代方书，年代取元明之际大致推定，原书成书年份与明刻具体时间均待核实，故可信度较低。
events.summary_en: Originally a Yuan-dynasty formulary by Sun Yunxian, it circulated in Ming reprints and is catalogued here under Ming formularies. The date is a rough placeholder between the Yuan and Ming, and both the original and reprint dates need verification.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel: 明洪武至永乐间原辑；弘治刊行
events.title: 外科集验方
events.title_en: Empirically Tested Formulae for External Medicine (Waike Jiyan Fang)
events.summary: 明代周文采辑，据书目记载原辑于洪武至永乐间，弘治年间刊行，为外科验方汇集。成书与刊行年份说法不一，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Zhou Wencai, reportedly gathered between the Hongwu and Yongle eras and printed in the Hongzhi era, this is a collection of tested surgical formulae. The dates are not firmly established and the year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 巴塞罗那圣十字医院成立
events.title_en: Hospital de la Santa Creu, Barcelona
events.summary: 1401年，巴塞罗那主教座堂与百人议会协议合并城中数所医院，建立统一的圣十字医院，国王马丁一世出席奠基；其延续为今日的圣十字与圣保罗医院，旧址现存哥特式建筑。
events.summary_en: In 1401 Barcelona's Cathedral and Consell de Cent merged several hospitals into the Hospital de la Santa Creu, ancestor of today's Sant Pau.

events.title: 乾坤生意
events.title_en: Vital Principles of Heaven and Earth (Qiankun Shengyi)
events.summary: 朱橚撰，明初成书，以明刻本残本传世，与《普济方》关系密切，主体归方书类，此处为涉及针灸内容的交叉条目。
events.summary_en: By Zhu Su, early Ming, surviving in incomplete Ming prints and closely related to the Puji Fang; primarily a formulary, listed here for its acupuncture-related content.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.yearLabel_en: Early Ming (Dai died 1405; book appeared later)
events.title: 推求师意
events.title_en: Tuiqiu Shiyi
events.summary: 明初戴思恭撰医论，承丹溪之学，有明刻本及《四库全书》本。
events.summary_en: Medical essays by Dai Sigong of the early Ming carrying on the Danxi tradition; Ming printings and the Siku Quanshu text exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 《普济方》成书
events.title_en: Completion of the Puji Fang
events.summary: 明永乐年间《普济方》成书，卷帙浩繁，是中国古代最大型方书之一。
events.summary_en: The Puji Fang was completed in the Yongle reign of the Ming. It is enormous in bulk and is one of the largest formula books of ancient China.
sources_en: historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine

events.title: 朱橚《救荒本草》
events.title_en: Zhu Su's Jiuhuang bencao (Famine Relief Herbal)
events.summary: 明周定王朱橚组织栽种观察野生植物，收录可供荒年充饥的植物四百余种并附图，开创以救荒为目的的本草著作。
events.summary_en: Zhu Su, Prince Ding of Zhou, had wild plants grown and observed, and recorded more than 400 species that could be eaten in famine years, each with an illustration. It began a line of herbals written for famine relief.

events.title: 救荒本草
events.title_en: Famine Relief Materia Medica (Jiuhuang Bencao)
events.summary: 朱橚撰，永乐四年（1406），记载灾荒时可食的野生植物并附图，以明嘉靖翻刻本等传世，是我国较早的救荒植物专著。
events.summary_en: By Zhu Su, 1406; records edible wild plants for famine relief with illustrations, transmitted through later Ming prints such as the Jiajing reprint; an early Chinese work on famine plants.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.yearLabel_en: Presented and printed Yongle–Zhengtong era, Ming

events.title_en: Weisheng Yijian Fang
events.summary: 明代胡濙撰方书，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A formulary by Hu Ying of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 神应经
events.title_en: Shenying Jing
events.summary: 明代陈会撰、刘瑾补辑，针灸著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: An acupuncture work by Chen Hui with additions by Liu Jin of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 乡药集成方
events.title_en: Hyangyak jipseongbang (Collected Prescriptions of Native Korean Materia Medica)
events.summary: 权采、俞孝通等奉敕编，朝鲜刻本，整理朝鲜本土药材（乡药）与方剂，体现中国医药的朝鲜化，在朝鲜前期持续刊行。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Kwon Chae, Yu Hyo-tong and others by royal order and printed in Joseon; it organizes native Korean medicinals and formulas and exemplifies the 'Koreanization' of Chinese medicine, continuing to be reprinted in early Joseon.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
韩国学术期刊引文数据库(KCI)

events.title: 名方类证医书大全
events.title_en: Great Compendium of Famous Formulae by Pattern (Mingfang Leizheng Yishu Daquan)
events.summary: 明代熊宗立编，约成书于正统三年（1438）前后，按病证分类汇集名方并附医书要旨，为明代方书类大型汇编。传世有熊氏种德堂刻本等。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Xiong Zongli around 1438 (Zhengtong 3), this large Ming collection organises famous formulae by pattern and adds essential medical teachings. Editions from Xiong's Zhongdetang press and others survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 徐氏针灸大全
events.title_en: Master Xu's Compendium of Acupuncture and Moxibustion (Xushi Zhenjiu Daquan)
events.summary: 徐凤撰，约成于正统四年（1439）前后，以明刻本传世，又称《针灸大全》，对后世针灸歌赋和手法流传有较大影响。
events.summary_en: By Xu Feng, c. 1439, transmitted in Ming prints, also called Zhenjiu Daquan; an influential source of acupuncture verses and techniques.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 妇人良方补遗大全
events.title_en: Supplemented Great Compendium of Good Formulae for Women (Furen Liangfang Buyi Daquan)
events.summary: 以陈自明《妇人大全良方》为基础，明代熊宗立补订，正统年间刊行，增补妇产科方论。传世有明熊氏种德堂刻本等，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Building on Chen Ziming's Song gynecological compendium, Xiong Zongli supplemented it with further theory and formulae in the Zhengtong era. Ming prints including those of Xiong's Zhongdetang survive; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 秘传证治要诀及类方
events.title_en: Secret Transmission of Essential Diagnosis and Treatment with Classified Formulae (Michuan Zhengzhi Yaojue ji Leifang)
events.summary: 明代戴思恭撰，成书于正统八年（1443），十二卷，是朱丹溪弟子总结的临证心得，分门别类，切于实用。传世有明刻本及商务印书馆《丛书集成》本。
events.summary_en: Written by Dai Sigong in 1443 (Zhengtong 8), this twelve-volume work records the clinical experience of Zhu Danxi's disciple, arranged by category for practical use. Ming prints and the Commercial Press Congshu Jicheng edition survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 伤寒琐言
events.title_en: Shanghan Suoyan
events.summary: 明代陶华撰伤寒著作，收入《伤寒六书》，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A cold-damage work by Tao Hua of the Ming, included in the Shanghan Liushu; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 伤寒全生集
events.title_en: Collected Methods for Preserving Life in Cold Damage (Shanghan Quansheng Ji)
events.summary: 陶华撰，明中叶成书，以明刻本传世，是陶华伤寒著作之一，系统论述伤寒辨治。年份取与其他陶华著作同期的1445年前后，仅为近似。
events.summary_en: By Tao Hua, mid-Ming, transmitted in Ming prints; one of his Shanghan works. Year approximated to c. 1445 alongside his other works.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 伤寒明理续论
events.title_en: Sequel to the Treatise Clarifying Principles of Cold Damage (Shanghan Mingli Xulun)
events.summary: 陶华撰，约在正统至景泰间成书，收入《伤寒六书》，是对成无己《伤寒明理论》的续作。年份为大致值。
events.summary_en: By Tao Hua, c. Zhengtong-Jingtai, included in the Shanghan Liu Shu; a continuation of Cheng Wuji's Shanghan Mingli Lun. Year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.yearLabel_en: Written down c. Zhengtong-Jingtai (14th-15th c.); later copied and printed
events.title: 滇南本草
events.title_en: Yunnan Materia Medica (Diannan Bencao)
events.summary: 兰茂撰，约明正统至景泰间写定，后世有抄本、刻本和石印本流传，属云南地方本草，早期抄本系统与版本关系尚待细考。年份取大致中点。
events.summary_en: By Lan Mao, written down c. Zhengtong-Jingtai, then transmitted in manuscripts, prints and lithographs; a regional Yunnan materia medica whose early manuscript lines need further study. Year is an approximate midpoint.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 奇效良方
events.title_en: Qixiao Liangfang
events.summary: 明代董宿辑、方贤续补，方书，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A formulary compiled by Dong Su and supplemented by Fang Xian of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 类编经验医方
events.title_en: Classified Collection of Empirically Tested Formulae (Leibian Jingyan Yifang)
events.summary: 明代刘仕贤辑，成书于成化年间，将经验医方分类编次，属方书类著作。今存明刻本，具体成书年份不详，年份取成化中期大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“方书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Liu Shixian during the Chenghua era, this formulary arranges empirically tested prescriptions by category. A Ming print survives; the exact year is unknown and the date given is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel: 朝鲜世宗至成宗；成化十三年（1477）活字印行
events.title: 医方类聚
events.title_en: Classified Collection of Medical Prescriptions (Uibang yuchwi)
events.summary: 金礼蒙等奉敕编纂的朝鲜大型方书类聚，全书365卷（现存266卷），引书一百五十余种，1477年以活字印行，是朝鲜医学中保存中国古医籍佚文最丰富的巨著之一。
events.summary_en: A giant Joseon compilation of classified prescriptions edited by Kim Ye-mong and others by royal order; originally 365 volumes (266 survive), citing over 150 sources, and printed with movable type in 1477. It preserves many fragments of lost Chinese medical works.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
PubMed: 医方类聚引用研究

events.yearLabel: 元末明初编成；明成化十七年（1481）程充校本
events.yearLabel_en: Compiled late Yuan–early Ming; Cheng Chong's edition of 1481 (Chenghua 17)
events.title: 丹溪心法
events.title_en: Danxi Xinfa
events.summary: 以朱震亨学术为本，由门人整理，明成化年间程充校订本流传最广，为丹溪学派综合性著作。
events.summary_en: Based on Zhu Zhenheng's teachings and compiled by disciples; Cheng Chong's Chenghua-era revision is the most widely transmitted. A comprehensive work of the Danxi school.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title_en: Yilin Jiyao

events.summary_en: A materia medica by Wang Lun of the Ming; Ming printings exist.

events.title: 《医学汇编》（Fasciculus medicinae）威尼斯刊印
events.title_en: Fasciculus medicinae printed in Venice
events.summary: 托名约翰内斯·德·凯瑟姆（可能为维也纳医学教授汉斯·冯·基希海姆）的医学文集约1400年已流传，1491年由格雷戈里兄弟在威尼斯刊印，配有解剖、验尿等插图，是早期印刷插图医书的代表；美国国家医学图书馆藏有摇篮本。
events.summary_en: The Fasciculus medicinae attributed to Johannes de Ketham, circulating by 1400, was printed in Venice by the de Gregoriis brothers; NLM holds incunable copies.

events.title: 帕拉塞尔苏斯出生
events.title_en: Birth of Paracelsus
events.summary: 帕拉塞尔苏斯1493年出生于瑞士，后以医化学挑战古代权威，象征文艺复兴医学的反叛气质。
events.summary_en: Paracelsus was born in Switzerland in 1493. He later challenged ancient authority with iatrochemistry and came to symbolize the rebellious temper of Renaissance medicine.
