events.yearLabel_en: Revised from Tang–Song; Ming editions circulated
events.title: 秘传眼科龙木论
events.title_en: Mizhuan Yanke Longmu Lun
events.summary: 题龙树（龙木）所传的眼科著作，实为托名递修之作，明万历刻本等通行。
events.summary_en: An ophthalmology work attributed to Nāgārjuna (Longmu); in fact a pseudepigraphic text revised over generations. Ming Wanli and other printings circulated.

events.yearLabel: 明刻本系统；明中叶近似
events.title: 太素脉秘诀
events.title_en: Secret Verses of the Taisu Pulse (Taisu Mai Mijue)
events.summary: 旧题张太素撰，经明人增益，以明刻本系统传世。真伪待考，书中太素脉法多附会，年份为明中叶大致值。
events.summary_en: Traditionally attributed to Zhang Taisu, augmented by Ming writers and transmitted in a Ming print tradition; authenticity unresolved and dating is a rough mid-Ming figure.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.yearLabel_en: Southern Song original; reprinted in the Ming
events.title: 崔嘉彦脉诀（明刊本系统）
events.title_en: Cui Jiayan's Pulse Verses (Ming Print Tradition)
events.summary: 南宋崔嘉彦原著，明代多次翻刻，以明刻本系统传世，属宋书明刊类诊法著作。年份取明中叶翻刻的大致值。
events.summary_en: Original by Cui Jiayan of the Southern Song, reprinted repeatedly in the Ming and transmitted via Ming prints. Year is a mid-Ming approximation for the reprints.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.yearLabel_en: Ming manuscript and print tradition; editions to be verified
events.title: 按摩经（明本）
events.title_en: Massage Classic (Ming Edition Tradition)
events.summary: 作者佚名或旧题，明抄刻系统，版本待考，属推拿按摩文献。作者、年代与版本均不明确，年份取明中叶近似，仅作线索性条目。
events.summary_en: Anonymous or by old title, a Ming manuscript and print tradition with unclear editions; a tuina and massage text. Author, date and edition are uncertain; the year is a rough mid-Ming figure and the entry is only a lead.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 铜人针灸经（明翻刻系统）
events.title_en: Bronze Figure Acupuncture Classic (Ming Reprint Tradition)
events.summary: 宋天圣年间王惟一系统的《铜人腧穴针灸图经》，明代有翻刻本，属宋书明刊。年份取明中叶翻刻的大致值，与现有王惟一铜人条目相关。
events.summary_en: The Song Tiansheng-era Bronze Figure acupuncture text of Wang Weiyi's tradition, reprinted in the Ming; a Song text in Ming print. Year is an approximation for the Ming reprints and relates to the existing Wang Weiyi entry.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 药性赋（明刊本）
events.title_en: Rhapsody on Drug Properties (Ming Print)
events.summary: 旧题李杲，为明人通行本，金元赋文。明代书坊刻本很多，作者属托名性质，年份取明中叶刊行的大致值。
events.summary_en: Traditionally attributed to Li Gao and circulated in Ming popular editions as a Jin-Yuan verse text; many Ming commercial prints exist and the attribution is nominal. Year is a mid-Ming approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 银海精微
events.title_en: Essence of the Silver Sea (Yinhai Jingwei)
events.summary: 旧题唐代孙思邈撰，实为宋代以后人托名，明刻本通行，为中医眼科名著。书目标明系伪托，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“五官科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Traditionally attributed to Sun Simiao but actually a later pseudepigraph from the Song or after, this ophthalmology text circulated widely in Ming prints. The year given is approximate and confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 眼科龙木总论
events.title_en: General Treatise of Dragon Wood Ophthalmology (Yanke Longmu Zonglun)
events.summary: 与《龙木论》同一系统的眼科著作，唐宋以来递修，明代有刻本。成书年份与作者均不详，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“五官科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: An ophthalmology work in the Longmu lineage, revised from the Tang–Song period onward and printed in the Ming. Authorship and date are unknown, so the year is approximate and confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel: 旧题明初；刊行多在明中后期
events.title: 修龄要指
events.title_en: Essential Guide to Longevity Cultivation (Xiuling Yaozhi)
events.summary: 旧题明初冷谦撰，刊行多在明代中后期，收于《夷门广牍》等丛书，论导引、服食与四时养生。作者时代略有争议，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“养生”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Leng Qian of the early Ming but mostly printed in the mid-to-late Ming, including in the Yimen Guangdu, it discusses daoyin, diet and seasonal regimen. The author's era is somewhat disputed and the date approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 东垣十书（明刊本）
events.title_en: Ten Books of Dongyuan (Ming editions)
events.summary: 金元李杲等著作，明代书坊翻刻极多，形成《东垣十书》明刊本系统。属金元医书明刊，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“综合与丛书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: A collection of works by Li Gao and other Jin–Yuan physicians that was reprinted extensively by Ming bookshops. It is catalogued as a Ming print of Jin–Yuan works, so the year is approximate and confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 河间六书（明刊本）
events.title_en: Six Books of Hejian (Ming editions)
events.summary: 金代刘完素等著作合编，明代有刻本流传，形成《河间六书》明刊本系统。属金元医书明刊，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“综合与丛书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: A collection of works by Liu Wansu and others from the Jin dynasty, printed in the Ming as the Hejian Liushu. It is a Ming print of Jin–Yuan texts, so the year is approximate and confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel: 约明清以前伊斯兰医学传统传入新疆
events.yearLabel_en: before Ming–Qing; Islamic medical tradition in Xinjiang
events.title: 哈孜·巴依塔尔等阿拉伯—波斯医籍（维吾尔医）
events.title_en: Hazm Bayatar and Arabic–Persian medical texts in Uyghur medicine
events.summary: 维吾尔医使用察合台文、波斯文写本传抄的阿拉伯—波斯医籍系统，经中亚传入新疆，1949年前以写本为主，汉译多在当代。
events.summary_en: A tradition of Arabic–Persian medical works copied in Chagatai and Persian manuscripts, transmitted to Xinjiang via Central Asia; pre-1949 transmission was mainly by manuscript, with Chinese translations mostly modern.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 图注脉诀
events.title_en: Illustrated Annotated Pulse Verses (Tuzhu Maijue)
events.summary: 张世贤撰，正德间成书，以明刻本传世，为配图注释的脉诀读物。年份取正德中期大致值。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Shixian, Zhengde era, transmitted in Ming prints; an illustrated annotated edition of pulse verses. Year approximated to mid-Zhengde.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.yearLabel: 明正德间成书；嘉靖薛己注本
events.yearLabel_en: Zhengde era, Ming; Xue Ji's Jiajing annotated edition
events.title: 明医杂著
events.title_en: Mingyi Zazhu
events.summary: 明代王纶撰医论、内科杂著，经薛己注释后广为流传，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: Medical essays and internal-medicine notes by Wang Lun of the Ming, widely circulated after Xue Ji's annotation; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 图注八十一难经
events.title_en: Illustrated Annotations on the Eighty-One Difficulties (Tuzhu Bashiyi Nanjing)
events.summary: 张世贤撰，约成于正德五年（1510）前后，以明刻本传世，为配图注释《难经》的通俗读本。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Shixian, c. 1510, transmitted in Ming prints; an illustrated and annotated popular edition of the Nanjing.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 校正图注脉诀
events.title_en: Corrected Illustrated Annotated Pulse Verses (Jiaozheng Tuzhu Maijue)
events.summary: 张世贤撰，正德五年（1510），以明刻本传世，是《图注脉诀》的校正版。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Shixian, 1510, transmitted in Ming prints; a corrected edition of his Tuzhu Maijue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 医学正传
events.title_en: Yixue Zhengchuan
events.summary: 明代虞抟撰综合性医书，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A comprehensive medical work by Yu Tuan of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医方捷径
events.title_en: Shortcut to Medical Formulae (Yifang Jiejing)
events.summary: 明代钱原濬等辑，成书于正德年间，为方书类著作，以简明实用为特点汇集常用医方。今存明刻本，具体年份不详，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“方书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Qian Yuanjun and others during the Zhengde era, this formulary gathers commonly used prescriptions in a concise, practical form. A Ming print survives; the exact year is unknown and the date given is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 伦敦皇家内科医师学院特许状
events.title_en: Royal charter of the College of Physicians of London
events.summary: 1518年伦敦内科医师学院获王室特许状，成为英国医师专业自律与资格认定的重要机构。
events.summary_en: In 1518 the College of Physicians of London received a royal charter. It became an important institution for professional self-regulation and qualification of physicians in England.

events.yearLabel: 元编明续；汪机续注于明正德嘉靖间
events.yearLabel_en: Yuan compilation, continued by Wang Ji in Zhengde-Jiajing (Ming)
events.title: 素问钞
events.title_en: Excerpts of the Suwen (Suwen Chao)
events.summary: 滑寿原编，汪机续注，元编明续，在正德、嘉靖间成书，以明刻本传世。该书类编《素问》，对后世分类研究《内经》有影响。年份取明中叶大致值。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Hua Shou and annotated further by Wang Ji in the Zhengde-Jiajing era; transmitted through Ming prints as a topical rearrangement of the Suwen. Year is an approximate mid-Ming figure.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 韩氏医通
events.title_en: Hanshi Yitong
events.summary: 明代韩懋撰医论与诊法著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A work on medical theory and diagnosis by Han Mao of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 帕拉塞尔苏斯化学医学
events.title_en: Paracelsus and chemical medicine
events.summary: 帕拉塞尔苏斯（1493–1541）公开抵制盖伦与阿维森纳权威，倡导矿物与化学药物，开创医化学传统。
events.summary_en: Paracelsus (1493–1541) publicly rejected the authority of Galen and Avicenna, advocated mineral and chemical drugs, and opened the iatrochemical tradition.

events.title: 口齿类要
events.title_en: Kouchi Leiyao
events.summary: 明代薛己撰口齿科著作，收入《薛氏医案》。
events.summary_en: An oral and dental work by Xue Ji of the Ming, included in the Xueshi Yi'an.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 立斋外科发挥
events.title_en: Lizhai Waike Fahui
events.summary: 明代薛己撰外科著作，收入《薛氏医案》。
events.summary_en: A surgical work by Xue Ji of the Ming, included in the Xueshi Yi'an.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 正体类要
events.title_en: Zhengti Leiyao
events.summary: 明代薛己撰伤科著作，收入《薛氏医案》。
events.summary_en: A trauma-medicine work by Xue Ji of the Ming, included in the Xueshi Yi'an.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 针灸聚英
events.title_en: Zhenjiu Juying
events.summary: 明代高武撰针灸著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: An acupuncture work by Gao Wu of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 读素问钞
events.title_en: Reading the Suwen Excerpts (Du Suwen Chao)
events.summary: 汪机撰，成于嘉靖前后，以明刻本传世，是在滑寿《素问钞》基础上读注发挥之作。年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: By Wang Ji, completed around the Jiajing era and transmitted in Ming prints; a reading commentary built on Hua Shou's Suwen Chao. Year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 运气易览
events.title_en: Easy Guide to Five Phases and Six Qi (Yunqi Yilan)
events.summary: 汪机撰，约成于嘉靖前后，以明刻本传世，介绍五运六气学说，属医经中的运气专论。年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: By Wang Ji, c. the Jiajing era and transmitted in Ming prints; a primer on five phases and six qi. Year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 医学原理
events.title_en: Principles of Medicine (Yixue Yuanli)
events.summary: 汪机撰，约成于嘉靖前后，以明刻本传世，为阐述医学基本原理、病机和治则的综合性理论著作。年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: By Wang Ji, c. the Jiajing era, transmitted in Ming prints; a theoretical work on basic principles, pathogenesis and therapeutic rules. Year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 针灸问对
events.title_en: Questions and Answers on Acupuncture and Moxibustion (Zhenjiu Wenda)
events.summary: 汪机撰，嘉靖九年（1530），以明刻本传世，用问答形式讨论针灸理论与操作，在针灸文献史上有一定影响。
events.summary_en: By Wang Ji, 1530, transmitted in Ming prints; discusses acupuncture and moxibustion theory and technique in question-and-answer form.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 本草约言
events.title_en: Concise Words on Materia Medica (Bencao Yueyan)
events.summary: 薛己撰，嘉靖间成书，以明刻本传世，与《薛氏医案》相关，属本草约编。年份取嘉靖中期大致值。
events.summary_en: By Xue Ji, Jiajing era, transmitted in Ming prints and related to the Xue Shi Yi'an collection; a concise materia medica. Year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 石山医案（理论篇）
events.title_en: Stone Mountain Case Records, Theoretical Chapters (Shishan Yi'an)
events.summary: 汪机撰，嘉靖间成书，以明刻本传世。本条仅取理论部分，主体医案另入医案类。年份取嘉靖初年大致值。
events.summary_en: By Wang Ji, Jiajing era, transmitted in Ming prints; only the theoretical chapters are listed here while the case records belong elsewhere. Year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 外科理例
events.title_en: Principles and Cases in External Medicine (Waike Li Li)
events.summary: 明代汪机撰，成书于嘉靖十年（1531），汇集外科理论与病例，主张内外结合治疗疮疡。今存明刻本。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“外科伤科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Written by Wang Ji in 1531 (Jiajing 10), this work compiles surgical theory and cases, advocating combined internal and external treatment of sores. A Ming print survives.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 石山医案
events.title_en: Case Records of Shishan (Shishan Yi'an)
events.summary: 汪机门人陈桷编，约成书于嘉靖十年（1531）前后，记录汪机临证医案，体现新安医学特色。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“医案医话”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Edited by Wang Ji's disciple Chen Jue around 1531 (Jiajing 10), this book records Wang Ji's clinical cases and reflects the Xin'an medical tradition. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel_en: Original 1237; Xue Ji's annotation c. 16th c.
events.title: 妇人良方补遗大全（相关传本）
events.title_en: Furen Liangfang Buyi Daquan (related editions)
events.summary: 为陈自明《妇人大全良方》经明代薛己校注后的传本系统，另见于明清多种刻本。
events.summary_en: The transmission of Chen Ziming's gynecological work as annotated by Xue Ji of the Ming; found in several Ming and Qing printings.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 明嘉靖十六年（1537）前后；崇祯重订本通行
events.yearLabel_en: c. Jiajing 16 (1537); Chongzhen revised edition most widely used
events.title: 明医指掌
events.title_en: Mingyi Zhizhang
events.summary: 明代皇甫中撰综合性医书，崇祯年间重订本通行，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A comprehensive work by Huangfu Zhong of the Ming; the Chongzhen revised edition was the most widely used. Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title_en: Zhenjiu Jieyao
events.summary: 明代高武撰针灸著作，有明刻本。

events.summary: 明代鲁伯嗣撰儿科著作，嘉靖间刊行较广，成书或更早。
events.summary_en: A pediatric work by Lu Bosi of the Ming, widely printed in the Jiajing era; composition may be earlier.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 内科摘要
events.title_en: Neike Zhaiyao
events.summary: 明代薛己撰内科著作，收入《薛氏医案》。
events.summary_en: An internal-medicine work by Xue Ji of the Ming, included in the Xueshi Yi'an.

events.title: 苍生司命
events.title_en: Cangsheng Siming
events.summary: 题虞抟撰（一说后人编），版本与作者关系待考，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Yu Tuan (some say compiled by later hands); the relationship between text and author remains to be examined. Ming printings exist.

events.yearLabel: 明嘉靖至万历间陆续刊行；万历合刊本
events.yearLabel_en: Printed in stages from Jiajing to Wanli; combined Wanli edition
events.title: 薛氏医案
events.title_en: Xueshi Yi'an
events.summary: 明代薛己等著作的合刊丛书，含内外妇儿等多科，有明万历刻本。
events.summary_en: A combined series of works by Xue Ji and others covering internal, surgical, gynecological and pediatric medicine; a Wanli printing exists.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 女科撮要
events.title_en: Nuke Cuoyao
events.summary: 明代薛己撰妇科著作，收入《薛氏医案》。
events.summary_en: A gynecology work by Xue Ji of the Ming, included in the Xueshi Yi'an.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 校注妇人良方
events.title_en: Annotated Good Formulae for Women (Jiaozhu Furen Liangfang)
events.summary: 宋代陈自明原著《妇人大全良方》，明代薛己为之校注，嘉靖年间薛注本流行。该本在原书基础上补入薛己的评注与医案，传世有明刻本及《薛氏医案》本。
events.summary_en: Based on Chen Ziming's Song-dynasty Furen Daquan Liangfang, this edition was annotated by Xue Ji and circulated in the Jiajing era, adding Xue's commentary and cases. Ming prints and the Xueshi Yi'an edition survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 幼科类萃
events.title_en: Classified Essentials of Pediatrics (Youke Leicui)
events.summary: 明代王銮撰，成书于嘉靖年间，分类汇集小儿病证的诊治方法，属儿科著作。今存明刻本，具体年份不详，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“儿科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Wang Luan during the Jiajing era, this pediatric work classifies the diagnosis and treatment of children's diseases. A Ming print survives; the exact year is unknown and the date given is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 博爱心鉴
events.title_en: Mirror of the Benevolent Heart (Boai Xinjian)
events.summary: 明代魏直撰，成书于嘉靖年间，论述痘疹的发病规律与治法，是明代痘疹学的重要著作。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“儿科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Written by Wei Zhi during the Jiajing era, this book discusses the course and treatment of smallpox and is an important Ming work on pox. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 痘治理辨
events.title_en: Principles and Differentiation in Pox Treatment (Douzhi Li Bian)
events.summary: 明代汪机撰，成书于嘉靖年间，辨析痘病的病理与治疗原则，属儿科痘疹类著作。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“儿科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Written by Wang Ji during the Jiajing era, this work analyses the pathology and treatment principles of smallpox. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 外科枢要
events.title_en: Essentials of External Medicine (Waike Shuyao)
events.summary: 明代薛己撰，成书于嘉靖年间，论外科疮疡的辨证与治法，强调内治与整体调理。传世有《薛氏医案》本，越南亦有翻刻，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Written by Xue Ji during the Jiajing era, this surgical work covers sores and ulcers with emphasis on internal treatment and holistic regulation. It survives in the Xueshi Yi'an edition, with Vietnamese reprints; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 维萨里《人体的构造》
events.title_en: Vesalius, De humani corporis fabrica
events.summary: 安德烈亚斯·维萨里1543年出版《人体的构造》，基于亲自解剖纠正盖伦错误，奠定现代人体解剖学。
events.summary_en: In 1543 Andreas Vesalius published De humani corporis fabrica. Based on his own dissections, it corrected errors in Galen and established modern human anatomy.

image.author: user:Rubén Grassi
image.caption: 《人体的构造》第 190 页木刻
image.caption_en: Vesalius' Fabrica contains many detailed drawings of human dissections, some of them in allegorical poses.

events.title: 帕雷革新火器伤处理
events.title_en: Paré reforms the treatment of gunshot wounds
events.summary: 军医安布鲁瓦兹·帕雷弃用沸油处理枪伤，改用温和敷料与结扎止血，其外科著作影响全欧。
events.summary_en: The military surgeon Ambroise Paré abandoned boiling oil for gunshot wounds and turned to gentle dressings and ligature to stop bleeding. His surgical writings influenced all of Europe.

image.caption: 帕雷像
image.caption_en:
Portrait of Ambroise Pare

Rare Books
Keywords: Surgery; Ambroise Paré; Surgical Instruments; General Surgery; Wounds and Injuries

events.title: 弗拉卡斯托罗传染种子说
events.title_en: Fracastoro’s theory of seeds of contagion
events.summary: 吉罗拉莫·弗拉卡斯托罗1546年提出疫病由可传递的“种子”样实体引起，是近代传染理论的重要先声。
events.summary_en: In 1546 Girolamo Fracastoro proposed that epidemics are caused by transmissible seed-like entities. It was an important forerunner of modern contagion theory.

events.yearLabel: 明嘉靖己酉（1549）成书；万历十九年（1591）博古堂等刊
events.yearLabel_en: Composed 1549 (Jiajing jiyou); printed 1591 (Wanli 19) by Bogutang and others
events.title: 名医类案
events.title_en: Mingyi Leian (Classified Cases of Famous Physicians)
events.summary: 明代江瓘编，子江应宿增补，清代魏之琇等重校。按病证类编嘉靖以前名医治验，约二百余门，是中国第一部大型分类医案专著。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Jiang Guan, expanded by his son Jiang Yingsu and re-collated by Wei Zhixiu of the Qing. It arranges pre-Jiajing physicians' cases by disease in over two hundred sections and is the first large classified case collection in China.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 万氏家传痘疹心法
events.title_en: Wanshi Jiachuan Douzhen Xinfa
events.summary: 明代万全撰儿科与痘疹著作，收入《万密斋医学全书》，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A pediatric and smallpox work by Wan Quan of the Ming, included in the Wan Mizhai Yixue Quanshu; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 摄生众妙方
events.title_en: Wonderful Formulae for Life Preservation (Shesheng Zhongmiao Fang)
events.summary: 明代张时彻撰，成书于嘉靖二十九年（1550），收录养生保健与各科临证方药，属明代私人辑录的方书。今存明刻本。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“方书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Zhang Shiche in 1550 (Jiajing 29), this private formulary collects health-preservation and clinical prescriptions across specialties. A Ming print survives.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 急救良方
events.title_en: Good Formulae for Emergencies (Jijiu Liangfang)
events.summary: 明代张时彻撰，成书于嘉靖年间，辑录常见急症的简便救治良方，便于民间取用。今存明刻本，确切年份不详，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“方书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Zhang Shiche during the Jiajing era, this collection gathers simple, practical remedies for common emergencies. A Ming print survives; the exact year is unknown and the date given is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 痘疹心法
events.title_en: Heart Methods for Pox and Measles (Douzhen Xinfa)
events.summary: 明代万全撰，成书于明代中叶，属儿科痘疹类著作，与《痘疹世医心法》内容相近。具体成书年份与版本关系待考，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“儿科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Written by Wan Quan in the mid-Ming, this pediatric pox-and-measles work overlaps in content with the Douzhen Shiyi Xinfa. Its exact date and edition relationship need further study, so confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel: 元托名；明嘉靖刻本通行
events.title: 疮疡经验全书
events.title_en: Complete Book of Empirical Experience on Sores and Ulcers (Chuangyang Jingyan Quanshu)
events.summary: 旧题宋代窦汉卿撰，实为明人增益托名，嘉靖刻本通行，论述疮疡诊治。书目标明托名递修，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“外科伤科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Traditionally attributed to Dou Hanqing but actually expanded under his name by Ming editors, this work on sores and ulcers circulated in Jiajing prints. Authorship is pseudepigraphic and the year approximate, so confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 跌损妙方
events.title_en: Wonderful Formulae for Traumatic Injuries (Diesun Miaofang)
events.summary: 题异远真人撰，书目注明约在明嘉靖年间，有明抄本与清刻本流传，为伤科方书。作者与年代均存疑，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“外科伤科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Attributed to a figure styled Yiyuan Zhenren, this traumatology formulary is placed around the Jiajing era, with Ming manuscripts and Qing prints. Authorship and date are doubtful, so the year is approximate and confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 明目至宝
events.title_en: Supreme Treasure for Bright Eyes (Mingmu Zhibao)
events.summary: 佚名撰，明刻本系统，为眼科著作。书目注明版本待考，成书年份与作者均不详，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“五官科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Anonymous ophthalmology work in the Ming printing tradition. Its edition history is unverified, and neither author nor date is known, so the year is approximate and confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 解围元薮
events.title_en: Source Book for Resolving Leprosy (Jiewei Yuansou)
events.summary: 明代沈之问撰，成书于嘉靖二十九年（1550），四卷，是现存最早的麻风病专著。传世有清刻本及1936年《中国医学大成》本。
events.summary_en: Written by Shen Zhiwen in 1550 (Jiajing 29), this four-volume work is the earliest surviving monograph on leprosy. Qing prints and the 1936 Zhongguo Yixue Dacheng edition survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 塞尔维特描述肺循环
events.title_en: Servetus describes the pulmonary circulation
events.summary: 米格尔·塞尔维特1553年在神学著作中描述血液经肺循环，同年因异端罪名被处死，其生理见解影响有限但具历史意义。
events.summary_en: In 1553 Michael Servetus described the passage of blood through the lungs in a theological work. The same year he was executed for heresy. His physiological insight had limited influence, but it is historically significant.

events.title: 保婴撮要
events.title_en: Baoying Cuoyao
events.summary: 明代薛铠撰、薛己补，儿科著作，收入《薛氏医案》。
events.summary_en: A pediatric work by Xue Kai with additions by Xue Ji of the Ming, included in the Xueshi Yi'an.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 古今医统大全
events.title_en: Gujin Yitong Daquan
events.summary: 明代徐春甫撰综合性医学丛书式著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A comprehensive compendium by Xu Chunfu of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 疠疡机要
events.title_en: Liyang Jiyao
events.summary: 明代薛己撰外科与麻风著作，收入《薛氏医案》。
events.summary_en: A surgical and leprosy work by Xue Ji of the Ming, included in the Xueshi Yi'an.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医方集宜
events.title_en: Collection of Suitable Medical Formulae (Yifang Jiyi)
events.summary: 明代丁凤撰，约成书于嘉靖三十五年（1556）前后，辑录各科适宜临床的医方，属方书类著作。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“方书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Ding Feng around 1556 (Jiajing 35), this formulary collects prescriptions suited to clinical use across specialties. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 科伦布详述肺循环
events.title_en: Colombo describes the pulmonary circulation in more detail
events.summary: 雷阿尔多·科伦布1559年更详细描述肺循环，为哈维系统理论提供解剖学前提。
events.summary_en: In 1559 Realdo Colombo described the pulmonary circulation in greater detail, providing an anatomical premise for Harvey’s systematic theory.

events.title: 人痘接种术（明代）
events.title_en: Variolation in the Ming
events.summary: 明中后期中国出现人痘接种；有学者考证最早文献可至1522年，隆庆年间（1567–1572）记载较丰。后经阿拉伯、土耳其传入欧洲。
events.summary_en: In the middle and later Ming, variolation appeared in China. Some scholars trace the earliest text to 1522, while records are richer in the Longqing reign (1567–1572). The practice later reached Europe by way of the Arab world and Turkey.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
Zheng Shanfu, study of the 1522 date

events.title: 保婴全书
events.title_en: Complete Book of Infant Protection (Baoying Quanshu)
events.summary: 明代薛己等撰，成书于嘉靖至万历年间，汇集婴幼儿护养与常见病证治疗，属儿科著作，与《保婴撮要》系统相关。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Xue Ji and others between the Jiajing and Wanli eras, this pediatric work covers infant care and common diseases and is related to the Baoying Cuoyao tradition. Ming prints survive; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 奥尔塔《印度药物谈》
events.title_en: Garcia de Orta, Colloquies on the Simples and Drugs of India
events.summary: 加西亚·德·奥尔塔1563年在果阿出版印度药物与热带病论著，开创欧洲热带医学文献传统。
events.summary_en: In 1563 Garcia de Orta published in Goa a treatise on Indian drugs and tropical disease, opening a European literature of tropical medicine.

events.title: 李时珍《濒湖脉学》
events.title_en: Li Shizhen, Lakeside Pulse Studies
events.summary: 李时珍1564年著《濒湖脉学》，以歌赋总结27脉，成为脉学入门经典。
events.summary_en: In 1564 Li Shizhen wrote the Binhu Maixue. In verse it sums up 27 pulses and became a standard introduction to pulse study.

image.author: 佚名
image.caption: 李时珍像
image.caption_en: Li Shizhen portrait

events.title: 本草蒙筌
events.title_en: Bencao Mengquan
events.summary: 明代陈嘉谟撰本草入门著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: An introductory materia medica by Chen Jiamo of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 约明嘉靖四十五年（1566）前后
events.title: 齐苏书
events.title_en: Qisu Shu (Yi-script medical book)
events.summary: 彝文医书，作者佚名，记载多系于明代，写本系统流传，被视为早期彝文医药文献的代表，其年代与定名仍有讨论。
events.summary_en: An anonymous medical text in the Yi script, mostly dated to the Ming and transmitted in manuscripts; regarded as representative of early Yi medical literature, though its dating and title remain debated.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 一体堂宅仁医会
events.title_en: Yititang Zhairen Medical Society
events.summary: 1568年一体堂宅仁医会创办，是明代医师结社交流的早期例证。
events.summary_en: The Yititang Zhairen Medical Society was founded in 1568, an early example of Ming physicians organizing themselves for exchange.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 澳门出现西式医院
events.title_en: A Western-style hospital appears in Macao
events.summary: 1569年前后澳门出现西式医院，标志西医机构进入中国沿海，开启近代中西医相遇的空间。
events.summary_en: Around 1569 a Western-style hospital appeared in Macao. It marks the arrival of Western medical institutions on the Chinese coast and opens a space in which modern Chinese and Western medicine met.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 古今医鉴
events.title_en: Mirror of Ancient and Modern Medicine (Gujin Yijian)
events.summary: 明代龚信辑，其子龚廷贤续编，成书于嘉靖至万历间，汇集历代医论、脉法与各科方药，兼具综合性医书与方书性质。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Gong Xin and continued by Gong Tingxian between the Jiajing and Wanli eras, this work brings together medical theory, pulse diagnosis and prescriptions, functioning as both a general compendium and a formulary. Ming prints survive; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 痘疹世医心法
events.title_en: Heart Methods of a Medical Family for Pox and Measles (Douzhen Shiyi Xinfa)
events.summary: 明代万全撰，成书于嘉靖至万历年间，总结万氏世医治疗痘疹的心得与方药，属儿科痘疹专著。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“儿科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Written by Wan Quan between the Jiajing and Wanli eras, this monograph distils the family's experience in treating smallpox and measles. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel: 明隆庆间（约1567—1572）原辑；清代补刊系统
events.yearLabel_en: Originally compiled in the Longqing era, Ming (c. 1567-1572); supplemented in Qing editions
events.title: 经络全书
events.title_en: Jingluo Quanshu (Complete Book of the Channels and Collaterals)
events.summary: 沈子禄原辑，徐师鲁补，是论述经络学说的著作，原辑成于明隆庆间，清代有补刊本流传，反映明清经络学说的传承，具体版本系统尚待考订。
events.summary_en: Originally compiled by Shen Zilu and supplemented by Xu Shilu, this work on channel theory dates to the Longqing era of the Ming and circulated in supplemented Qing editions; the edition lineage still awaits verification.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 启迪集
events.title_en: Keitekishū
events.summary: 曲直濑道三撰，日本刻本，是以明代医学为基础的临床全书，奠定后世日本后世派医学的基础。
events.summary_en: By Manase Dōsan, a Japanese printed clinical compendium based on Ming medicine that laid foundations for the Goseiha school of Japanese medicine.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 医学入门
events.title_en: Yixue Rumen
events.summary: 明代李梴撰综合性医学入门书，有明万历刻本及清代多种翻刻本。
events.summary_en: A comprehensive introductory medical text by Li Chan of the Ming; Wanli printings and many Qing reprints exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 《奇经八脉考》
events.title_en: An Exposition on the Eight Extraordinary Vessels
events.summary: 李时珍1577年著《奇经八脉考》，系统考订奇经理论，与《濒湖脉学》同为脉系重要著作。
events.summary_en: In 1577 Li Shizhen wrote the Qijing Bamai Kao, a systematic study of the theory of the extraordinary vessels. With the Binhu Maixue it is an important work on the vessel system.
works_en: Qijing Bamai Kao (Exposition of the Eight Extraordinary Vessels)

events.title: 李时珍《本草纲目》刊行
events.title_en: Li Shizhen’s Compendium of Materia Medica is published
events.summary: 李时珍《本草纲目》1578年金陵版刊行，收药1892种，按纲目分类，是药物学与博物学巨著，后入选世界记忆名录。
events.summary_en: The Jinling edition of Li Shizhen’s Bencao Gangmu was published in 1578. It records 1,892 drugs, classified by headings and entries. It is a major work of pharmacy and natural history and was later inscribed on the Memory of the World Register.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: Li Jianyuan (Ming period, 1368-1644)
image.caption: 《本草纲目》药图
image.caption_en: Li Shizhen's monumental pharmaceutical encyclopediaBencao gangmu(Systematic Materia Medica) contains entries on 1892 medicinal substances an

events.title: 本草发明
events.title_en: Bencao Faming
events.summary: 明代皇甫嵩撰本草著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A materia medica by Huangfu Song of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 幼科发挥
events.title_en: Youke Fahui
events.summary: 明代万全撰儿科著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A pediatric work by Wan Quan of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 片玉心书
events.title_en: Pianyu Xinshu
events.summary: 明代万全撰儿科著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A pediatric work by Wan Quan of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 广嗣纪要
events.title_en: Guangsi Jiyao
events.summary: 明代万全撰妇科与广嗣著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A work on gynecology and reproduction by Wan Quan of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 诊脉口诀等道三流派书
events.title_en: Pulse-Diagnosis Oral Instructions and other Dōsan-school texts
events.summary: 曲直濑一流的诊法类著作，以日本刻本及写本流传，反映曲直濑流在脉诊教学上的传承。
events.summary_en: Diagnostic texts of the Manase school circulated in Japanese prints and manuscripts, reflecting the school's pulse-diagnosis teaching.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 赤水玄珠
events.title_en: Chishui Xuanzhu
events.summary: 明代孙一奎撰综合性医书，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A comprehensive medical work by Sun Yikui of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医方考
events.title_en: Examination of Medical Formulae (Yifang Kao)
events.summary: 明代吴崑撰，成书于万历十二年（1584），以方论形式考释历代各科成方的组成、功用与配伍，是现存较早的方剂学专著。传世有明万历刻本，清代多次翻刻。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Wu Kun in 1584 (Wanli 12), this Ming work analyses the composition, indications and rationale of classical formulae across specialties, and is among the earliest dedicated studies of formula theory. Ming Wanli prints survive, with later Qing reprints.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 脉语
events.title_en: Pulse Discourse (Mai Yu)
events.summary: 吴崑撰，约成于万历十三年（1585）前后，以明刻本传世，论脉诊和脉学。
events.summary_en: By Wu Kun, c. 1585, transmitted in Ming prints; a work on pulse diagnosis.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 素问注证发微
events.title_en: Annotation and Elucidation of the Suwen (Suwen Zhuzheng Fawei)
events.summary: 马莳撰，约成于万历十四年（1586）前后，以明万历刻本传世，是较早对《素问》全文逐篇注释并加证说的明代注本。
events.summary_en: By Ma Shi, completed around 1586 and transmitted through Wanli-era Ming prints; an early Ming commentary giving chapter-by-chapter annotation and exposition of the Suwen.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 灵枢注证发微
events.title_en: Annotation and Elucidation of the Lingshu (Lingshu Zhuzheng Fawei)
events.summary: 马莳撰，与《素问注证发微》同期成书，约在万历十四年（1586）前后，以明万历刻本传世，是对《灵枢》全文作系统注释的较早注本。
events.summary_en: By Ma Shi, completed around 1586 together with his Suwen commentary and transmitted in Wanli-era Ming prints; an early systematic full-text annotation of the Lingshu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 万病回春
events.title_en: Wanbing Huichun
events.summary: 明代龚廷贤撰综合性临床医书，有明刻本及清代翻刻。
events.summary_en: A comprehensive clinical work by Gong Tingxian of the Ming; Ming printings and Qing reprints exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 药性歌括四百味
events.title_en: Yaoxing Geguo Sibai Wei
events.summary: 明代龚廷贤撰药性歌诀，多附于《寿世保元》等，另有单行本。
events.summary_en: A rhymed materia medica by Gong Tingxian of the Ming, often appended to the Shoushi Baoyuan and also circulated separately.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医旨绪余
events.title_en: Yizhi Xuyu
events.summary: 明代孙一奎撰医论，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: Medical essays by Sun Yikui of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 孙氏医案
events.title_en: Sun Shi Yi'an
events.summary: 明代孙一奎撰医案，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: Case records by Sun Yikui of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 万氏女科
events.title_en: Wan Family Gynecology (Wanshi Nüke)
events.summary: 明代万全撰，成书于万历年间，为万氏家传妇科著作，论经、带、胎、产诸证。传世有明刻本，清代及越南亦有翻刻，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Written by Wan Quan during the Wanli era, this family gynecological work covers menstruation, leucorrhea, pregnancy and childbirth. Ming prints survive, with Qing and Vietnamese reprints; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 种子类萃
events.title_en: Collected Essentials on Conception (Zhongzi Leicui)
events.summary: 明代吴正伦撰，成书于万历年间，围绕求嗣与调经种子立论，属妇科及广嗣类著作。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“妇科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Written by Wu Zhenglun during the Wanli era, this work focuses on conception, menstrual regulation and fertility, belonging to gynecology and procreation literature. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 广嗣全诀
events.title_en: Complete Instructions on Procreation (Guangsi Quanjue)
events.summary: 书目著录为万全相关系统的明代广嗣类著作，成书于万历年间，论求嗣与调养。作者归属与确切年份均待考，故可信度较低，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Catalogued as a Ming procreation work linked to Wan Quan's tradition, it dates to the Wanli era and covers conception and regimen. Authorship and exact date are unverified, so confidence is low and the year approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 寿养丛书
events.title_en: Collectanea on Longevity Nurturing (Shouyang Congshu)
events.summary: 明代胡文焕辑，成书于万历年间，汇集养生类著作，由胡氏文会堂刻印。属养生丛书，年份为大致推定，可信度中等。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“养生”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Hu Wenhuan during the Wanli era and printed by his Wenhuitang press, this collectanea gathers works on health preservation. The date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel: 明万历间学术；清初刊行
events.title: 周慎斋遗书
events.title_en: Posthumous Writings of Zhou Shenzhai (Zhou Shenzhai Yishu)
events.summary: 明代周之干撰，后人辑录，学术形成于万历年间，清初刊行，含医案与医论。今存清刻本，成书与刊行年份不一，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。
events.summary_en: Authored by Zhou Zhigan and compiled by later hands, with ideas formed in the Wanli era and printed in the early Qing, this work contains cases and discussions. The dates differ between composition and printing, so the year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 医林撮要
events.title_en: Uirim chwalyo (Essentials of the Medical Forest)
events.summary: 杨礼寿等编，朝鲜刻本，以临床实用为主，是朝鲜中期流行的医书。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Yang Ye-su and others and printed in Joseon; a practical clinical text popular in mid-Joseon.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 云林神彀
events.title_en: Yunlin Divine Verses (Yunlin Shenhou)
events.summary: 明代龚廷贤撰，约成书于万历十九年（1591）前后，以韵语歌诀形式概括各科病证与方药，便于初学者诵习。今存明刻本，越南亦有翻刻流传，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Gong Tingxian around 1591, this work summarises diseases and prescriptions in rhymed verse for beginners. A Ming print survives and Vietnamese reprints circulated; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 遵生八笺
events.title_en: Eight Discourses on Living in Accord with Life (Zunsheng Bajian)
events.summary: 明代高濂撰，成书于万历十九年（1591），分八笺论清修妙论、四时调摄、起居安乐、饮馔服食等，兼含医药卫生内容。有明万历刻本传世，国家图书馆藏雅尚斋刻本已数字化。
events.summary_en: Written by Gao Lian in 1591 (Wanli 19), this work comprises eight discourses on cultivation, seasonal regimen, daily comfort, diet and more, including medical and hygiene content. Wanli prints survive, and the National Library's Yashangzhai copy has been digitised.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
中国国家图书馆藏本（Wikimedia Commons）
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)
National Library of China copy (Wikimedia Commons)

events.title: 伤寒论条辨
events.title_en: Shanghan Lun Tiaobian
events.summary: 明代方有执撰，主张“错简重订”，对《伤寒论》条文重新编次，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: By Fang Youzhi of the Ming; rearranges the Shanghan Lun text on the basis of the misplaced-slips theory. Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.address: 帕多瓦大学博宫（Palazzo del Bo）
events.address_en: Palazzo del Bo, University of Padua
events.title: 帕多瓦永久解剖剧场建成
events.title_en: Permanent anatomical theatre at Padua
events.summary: 1594年帕多瓦大学在法布里修斯主持下建成世界首座永久性解剖剧场，椭圆形阶梯式看台环绕解剖台，供公开人体解剖教学。剧场至今保存于帕多瓦大学博宫（Palazzo del Bo），可参观。
events.summary_en: The world's first permanent anatomical theatre, built in 1594 at the University of Padua under Fabricius, survives today in the Palazzo del Bo.

events.title: 素问吴注
events.title_en: Wu's Annotations on the Suwen (Suwen Wu Zhu)
events.summary: 吴崑注解《黄帝内经素问》，成于万历二十二年（1594），以明万历刻本传世。该书为《素问》注本之一，注文简明，便于初学。
events.summary_en: Wu Kun's annotated edition of the Huangdi Neijing Suwen, completed in 1594 and transmitted through Wanli-era Ming prints; a concise commentary suited to beginners.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 鲁府禁方
events.title_en: Secret Formulae of the Lu Prince's Household (Lufu Jinfang)
events.summary: 明代龚廷贤撰，约成书于万历二十三年（1595）前后，辑录鲁王府所传禁方与验方，属明代宫廷及王府医方汇集。今存明刻本，具体成书年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Gong Tingxian around 1595, this collection gathers private and proven formulae associated with the household of the Prince of Lu, reflecting Ming princely medical practice. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 仁术便览
events.title_en: Handy Guide to the Benevolent Art (Renshu Bianlan)
events.summary: 明代张浩撰，成书于万历二十三年（1595），汇集日常取用的方药与调摄之法，属方书类著作。今存明刻本。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“方书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Zhang Hao in 1595 (Wanli 23), this formulary collects prescriptions and regimen advice for everyday use. A Ming print survives.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 塔利亚科齐《移植修复缺损外科》
events.title_en: Tagliacozzi's De curtorum chirurgia
events.summary: 博洛尼亚外科与解剖学教授塔利亚科齐于1597年出版《De curtorum chirurgia per insitionem》，系统描述以上臂皮瓣延迟转移再造鼻部的方法，被视为整形外科奠基著作，其上臂皮瓣图至今仍为美国整形外科学会标志。
events.summary_en: Bologna professor Gaspare Tagliacozzi published De curtorum chirurgia per insitionem (1597), describing delayed upper-arm flaps for nasal reconstruction; he is regarded as a founder of plastic surgery.

events.title: 莱顿解剖剧场
events.title_en: Leiden Theatrum Anatomicum
events.summary: 荷兰解剖学家彼得·鲍（Pieter Pauw）在莱顿大学建立解剖剧场并开创莱顿解剖学派，剧场兼作珍奇陈列室，是欧洲最早的解剖剧场之一。关于始建年份另有1594年之说。
events.summary_en: Pieter Pauw established the anatomical theatre of Leiden University (1597), one of Europe's first; some sources give 1594 for its opening.

events.title: 夷门广牍（医书子目）
events.title_en: Wide Tablets of Yimen (medical sub-collection)
events.summary: 明代周履靖辑，约成书于万历二十五年（1597）前后，是综合性丛书，其中收有医书子目。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“综合与丛书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Zhou Lüjing around 1597 (Wanli 25), this general collectanea includes a sub-series of medical works. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 仲景全书
events.title_en: Complete Works of Zhongjing (Zhongjing Quanshu)
events.summary: 赵开美辑刻，万历二十七年（1599），仿宋本翻刻，收《伤寒论》《金匮要略》等，具有很高的版本学价值，也是今日《伤寒论》通行底本之一。
events.summary_en: Compiled and printed by Zhao Kaimei in 1599 in imitation of Song editions, including the Shanghan Lun and Jingui Yaolue; of high bibliographic value and a key base text of the Shanghan Lun.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 张伯伦家族秘传产钳
events.title_en: Chamberlen obstetric forceps
events.summary: 英国张伯伦家族（1560—1728）于17世纪发明产科钳，作为家族秘密保守多代，直至18世纪才公开。产钳是产科学的关键技术进步，适逢佝偻病致骨盆畸形难产增多。
events.summary_en: The Chamberlen family invented obstetric forceps in the 17th century and kept them secret for generations.

events.title: 保命歌括
events.title_en: Rhymed Summary on Preserving Life (Baoming Gekuo)
events.summary: 龚廷贤撰，万历间成书，以明刻本传世，以歌诀形式归纳基础理论与临证要点，便于记诵。年份取万历中期大致值。
events.summary_en: By Gong Tingxian, Wanli era, transmitted in Ming prints; condenses basic theory and clinical essentials into memorizable verses. Year is a mid-Wanli approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 伤寒论注（王肯堂等）
events.title_en: Annotations on the Shanghan Lun (Wang Kentang et al.)
events.summary: 王肯堂等人对《伤寒论》的注文，见于《证治准绳》伤寒部分，以明万历间本传世。年份取1600年为近似值。
events.summary_en: Annotations on the Shanghan Lun by Wang Kentang and others, found in the Shanghan section of the Zhengzhi Zhunsheng and transmitted in Wanli-era prints. Year approximated to 1600.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 脉理正义
events.title_en: Correct Meaning of Pulse Principles (Maili Zhengyi)
events.summary: 赵台鼎撰，万历间成书，以明刻本传世，属脉学类著作。年份取万历中期大致值。
events.summary_en: By Zhao Taiding, Wanli era, transmitted in Ming prints; a work on pulse theory. Year is a mid-Wanli approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 小儿推拿方脉活婴秘旨全书
events.title_en: Complete Secret Principles of Pediatric Tuina, Prescriptions and Pulses (Xiaoer Tuina Fangmai Huoying Mizhi Quanshu)
events.summary: 署龚云林（龚廷贤），万历间成书，以明刻本传世，清代翻刻。属小儿推拿方书，署名归属仍待核实，年份取万历中期大致值。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Gong Yunlin (Gong Tingxian), Wanli era, transmitted in Ming prints and reprinted in the Qing; a pediatric tuina and formulary text whose attribution needs checking. Year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 本草真诠
events.title_en: True Interpretation of Materia Medica (Bencao Zhenquan)
events.summary: 杨崇魁撰，万历间成书，以明刻本传世，属本草类。年份取万历中期大致值。
events.summary_en: By Yang Chongkui, Wanli era, transmitted in Ming prints; a materia medica work. Year is a mid-Wanli approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 种杏仙方
events.title_en: Immortal Apricot-Planting Formulae (Zhongxing Xianfang)
events.summary: 明代龚廷贤撰，成书于万历年间，为方书类著作，以歌诀与方药并陈，便于记诵与临床取用。今存明刻本，确切年份不详，年代取万历中期大致推定。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Gong Tingxian during the Wanli era, this formulary presents prescriptions with verse aids for memorisation and clinical use. A Ming print survives; the exact year is unknown and the date given is an approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 医林绳墨
events.title_en: Standards of the Medical Forest (Yilin Shengmo)
events.summary: 明代方谷撰，方隅编次，成书于万历年间，论述内科常见病证的辨治规矩，为内科类著作。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“内科与临证综合”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Authored by Fang Gu and edited by Fang Yu during the Wanli era, this work sets out standards for diagnosing and treating common internal disorders. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel_en: c. Longqing era to Qing copies
events.title: 双柏彝医书等云南彝文医书
events.title_en: Shuangbai Yi medical books and other Yunnan Yi-script texts
events.summary: 云南双柏等地流传的彝文医书，作者佚名，1949年前以写本流传，具体写本年代待核，今有整理出版。
events.summary_en: Yi-script medical books circulated in Shuangbai and elsewhere in Yunnan; authorship is anonymous, they survive as pre-1949 manuscripts whose dates still need verification, and modern editions exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 杨继洲《针灸大成》
events.title_en: Yang Jizhou, Great Compendium of Acupuncture and Moxibustion
events.summary: 杨继洲《针灸大成》约1601年刊行，集明以前针灸大成，影响后世针灸教学与临床。
events.summary_en: Yang Jizhou’s Zhenjiu Dacheng was published about 1601. It gathers the pre-Ming tradition of acupuncture and moxibustion and influenced later teaching and practice.
works_en: Zhenjiu Dacheng (Great Compendium of Acupuncture and Moxibustion)
sources_en: traditional literature on the history of acupuncture

events.title: 医统正脉全书
events.title_en: Complete Orthodox Medical Lineage Collection (Yitong Zhengmai Quanshu)
events.summary: 明代王肯堂辑，约成书于万历二十九年（1601）前后，汇刻历代古医籍，是明代重要的医学丛书。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“综合与丛书”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Wang Kentang around 1601 (Wanli 29), this collection reprints classical medical texts and is a major Ming medical series. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 古今医统正脉全书（异名）
events.title_en: Alternate title of Yitong Zhengmai Quanshu
events.summary: 为《医统正脉全书》的异名，王肯堂辑，万历年间汇刻古医籍。因属同书异名，内容与《医统正脉全书》相同，年份与之相同，可信度较低。
events.summary_en: An alternate title of the Yitong Zhengmai Quanshu compiled by Wang Kentang in the Wanli era. It is the same collection under another name, so its date follows the main entry and confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 王肯堂《证治准绳》
events.title_en: Wang Kentang, Standards for Diagnosis and Treatment
events.summary: 王肯堂1602–1607年刊《证治准绳》，分科详尽，是明末重要临床全书。
events.summary_en: From 1602 to 1607 Wang Kentang published the Zhengzhi Zhunsheng. Divided in detail by specialty, it is an important late-Ming clinical compendium.
works_en: Zhengzhi Zhunsheng (Standards of Diagnosis and Treatment)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 医便
events.title_en: Convenient Medicine (Yibian)
events.summary: 明代王三才撰，约成书于万历三十年（1602）前后，汇集简便医方并重视四时调养，属方书类著作。今存明刻本，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Wang Sancai around 1602 (Wanli 30), this formulary collects convenient prescriptions with attention to seasonal regimen. A Ming print survives; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 女科证治准绳
events.title_en: Standards of Diagnosis and Treatment: Gynecology (Nüke Zhengzhi Zhunsheng)
events.summary: 明代王肯堂撰，约成书于万历三十年（1602）前后，是《证治准绳》中的妇科分册，系统论述经、带、胎、产及杂病，影响较大。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“妇科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: The gynecology volume of Wang Kentang's Zhengzhi Zhunsheng, produced around 1602 (Wanli 30), it systematically treats menstruation, leucorrhea, pregnancy, childbirth and miscellaneous women's disorders, and was highly influential.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 法布里修斯发现静脉瓣
events.title_en: Fabricius discovers the venous valves
events.summary: 吉罗拉莫·法布里齐约1603年观察下肢静脉瓣，证明血液只能向心流动，直接启发哈维。
events.summary_en: In 1603 Hieronymus Fabricius observed the valves of the leg veins and showed that blood can flow only toward the heart, a direct inspiration for Harvey.

events.title: 医学六要
events.title_en: Six Essentials of Medicine (Yixue Liuyao)
events.summary: 张三锡撰，约成于万历三十七年（1609）前后，有万历刻崇祯重修本和聚锦堂本，内容含四诊、经络、病机、本草、治法、运气，为综合性基础医书。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Sanxi, c. 1609, with a Wanli print revised in Chongzhen and a Jujin Tang edition; covers four diagnostics, meridians, pathogenesis, materia medica, therapeutics and yunqi.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.yearLabel: 明万历间（《医学六要》子目）
events.title: 四诊法
events.title_en: Methods of the Four Examinations (Sizhen Fa)
events.summary: 张三锡撰，为《医学六要》的子目，万历间成书，随母书流传。年份取母书约1609年。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Sanxi, a sub-section of the Yixue Liuyao, Wanli era, circulated with the parent work. Year follows the parent work (c. 1609).
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 经络考
events.title_en: Study of the Meridians (Jingluo Kao)
events.summary: 张三锡撰，万历间成书，收于《医学六要》，讨论经络，随母书流传。年份取母书约1609年。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Sanxi, Wanli era, included in the Yixue Liuyao and discussing the meridians. Year follows the parent work (c. 1609).
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 东医宝鉴
events.title_en: Dongui Bogam (Treasured Mirror of Eastern Medicine)
events.summary: 许浚奉敕撰，分内景、外景、杂病、汤液、针灸五篇共二十五卷，朝鲜内医院刻本，后在中国与日本多次翻刻，2009年入选联合国教科文组织《世界记忆名录》。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Heo Jun by royal order in 25 volumes covering internal, external, miscellaneous, decoction and acupuncture sections; printed at the Royal Pharmacy in 1613, reprinted in China and Japan, and inscribed in UNESCO's Memory of the World Register in 2009.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
中国哲学书电子化计划(ctext)

events.title: 小儿推拿秘诀
events.title_en: Secret Verses of Pediatric Tuina (Xiaoer Tuina Mijue)
events.summary: 周岳甫撰，约成于万历四十年（1612）前后，以明刻本传世，是明代小儿推拿的代表性著作之一。
events.summary_en: By Zhou Yuefu, c. 1612, transmitted in Ming prints; a representative Ming work on pediatric tuina.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 桑托里奥计量生理学
events.title_en: Santorio and quantitative physiology
events.summary: 桑托里奥·桑托里奥以秤测“无形出汗”等，开创计量实验生理学先河。
events.summary_en: Santorio Santorio used a balance to measure “insensible perspiration” and other quantities, opening the way to quantitative experimental physiology.

events.title: 寿世保元
events.title_en: Shoushi Baoyuan
events.summary: 明代龚廷贤撰综合性临床医书，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A comprehensive clinical work by Gong Tingxian of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医贯
events.title_en: Yiguan
events.summary: 明代赵献可撰医论，主张命门学说，有明刻本及清代翻刻。
events.summary_en: Medical essays by Zhao Xianke of the Ming advocating the doctrine of the life gate; Ming printings and Qing reprints exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 活幼心法
events.title_en: Methods for Saving Infants (Huoyou Xinfa)
events.summary: 明代聂尚恒撰，约成书于万历四十四年（1616）前后，侧重痘疹等小儿时疫的辨治。传世有明刻本，越南亦有翻刻，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Written by Nie Shangheng around 1616 (Wanli 44), this pediatric work emphasises the diagnosis and treatment of smallpox and measles. Ming prints survive and Vietnamese reprints exist; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 陈实功《外科正宗》
events.title_en: Chen Shigong, Orthodox Manual of External Medicine
events.summary: 陈实功1617年著《外科正宗》，对外科疮疡诊疗影响深远（常记为晚明刊行）。
events.summary_en: In 1617 Chen Shigong wrote the Waike Zhengzong. It had a lasting influence on the diagnosis and treatment of sores and ulcers in external medicine. It is usually dated to a late-Ming printing.
works_en: Waike Zhengzong (Orthodox Manual of External Medicine)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 针方六集
events.title_en: Six Collections of Needling Prescriptions (Zhenfang Liuji)
events.summary: 吴崑撰，万历四十六年（1618），以明刻本传世，是明代较系统的针灸专书。
events.summary_en: By Wu Kun, 1618, transmitted in Ming prints; a relatively systematic Ming acupuncture treatise.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 医藏书目
events.title_en: Bibliography of the Medical Canon Repository (Yizang Shumu)
events.summary: 明代殷仲春撰，约成书于万历四十六年（1618）前后，是中国较早的医学专题书目，著录历代医籍并加评介。今存明刻本，近代有《三三医书》等印本。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Yin Zhongchun around 1618 (Wanli 46), this is an early specialised medical bibliography listing and commenting on medical works. A Ming print survives, with modern reprints such as in the San San Yi Shu.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.yearLabel_en: Late Wanli to Tianqi era, Ming
events.title: 本草原始
events.title_en: Bencao Yuanshi
events.summary: 明代李中立撰本草著作，药图较精，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A materia medica by Li Zhongli of the Ming noted for its fine drug illustrations; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 济阴纲目
events.title_en: Jiyin Gangmu
events.summary: 明代武之望撰妇科著作，有明刻本及清代翻刻。
events.summary_en: A gynecology work by Wu Zhiwang of the Ming; Ming printings and Qing reprints exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 本草详节
events.title_en: Detailed Notes on Materia Medica (Bencao Xiangjie)
events.summary: 闵道扬撰，明末成书，以明刻本传世，版本待考，属本草类。年份取明末大致值。
events.summary_en: By Min Daoyang, late Ming, transmitted in Ming prints with editions to be verified; a materia medica work. Year is a late-Ming approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 先醒斋医学广笔记
events.title_en: Xianxingzhai Yixue Guang Biji
events.summary: 明代缪希雍撰，汇集医案、医话与方药，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: By Miao Xiyong of the Ming; gathers cases, medical notes and formulas. Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 炮炙大法
events.title_en: Paozhi Dafa
events.summary: 明代缪希雍撰炮制专书，记载药物炮制方法，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A drug-processing monograph by Miao Xiyong of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 雷公炮制药性解
events.title_en: Leigong Paozhi Yaoxing Jie
events.summary: 明代李中梓撰本草药性著作，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: A materia medica on processing and drug properties by Li Zhongzi of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 野菜博录
events.title_en: Comprehensive Record of Wild Vegetables (Yecai Bolu)
events.summary: 鲍山撰，天启二年（1622），以明天启刻本传世，记载可食野菜，为救荒本草类著作。
events.summary_en: By Bao Shan, 1622, transmitted in Tianqi-era Ming prints; records edible wild vegetables in the tradition of famine-relief herbals.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 张介宾《景岳全书》
events.title_en: Zhang Jiebin, Complete Works of Zhang Jingyue
events.summary: 张介宾1624年成《景岳全书》，倡阳非有余、温补理论，对明清临床影响巨大。
events.summary_en: In 1624 Zhang Jiebin completed the Jingyue Quanshu. He argued that yang is not in excess and developed warm-supplementation theory, with a large influence on Ming-Qing clinical practice.
works_en: Jingyue Quanshu (Complete Works of Zhang Jingyue)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 类经
events.title_en: Leijing (Classified Classic)
events.summary: 明代张介宾撰，将《内经》分类重编并作注释，为《内经》研究的重要著作，有明天启刻本。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Jiebin of the Ming; reclassifies and annotates the Neijing and is a major work in Neijing studies. A Tianqi printing exists.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 本草汇言
events.title_en: Bencao Huiyan
events.summary: 明代倪朱谟撰本草著作，有明天启刻本。
events.summary_en: A materia medica by Ni Zhumo of the Ming; a Tianqi printing exists.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 删补颐生微论
events.title_en: Shanbu Yisheng Weilun
events.summary: 明代李中梓撰医论，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: Medical essays by Li Zhongzi of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 类经图翼、类经附翼
events.title_en: Leijing Tuyi and Leijing Fuyi
events.summary: 明代张介宾撰，为《类经》附图与附论，多与《类经》合刻。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Jiebin of the Ming; the illustrations and supplementary essays to the Leijing, usually printed together with it.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 颐生微论
events.title_en: Subtle Discourse on Nurturing Life (Yisheng Weilun)
events.summary: 李中梓撰，成于天启四年（1624），以明刻本传世，结合养生与医理，阐述脏腑、病机等基础理论。
events.summary_en: By Li Zhongzi, 1624, transmitted in Ming prints; combines health cultivation with medical principles on viscera and pathogenesis.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.yearLabel: 原书明天启四年（1624）前后；清刻本单行流通
events.yearLabel_en: Parent work c. 1624 (Ming Tianqi); circulated separately in Qing prints
events.title: 景岳全书·脉神章
events.title_en: Maishen Zhang of the Jingyue Quanshu (Chapter on the Spirit of the Pulse)
events.summary: 张介宾《景岳全书》中的脉神章，论述脉学要旨与脉象辨析。原书成于明天启四年（1624）前后，清代刻本有单行本流通，对后世脉学影响较大。
events.summary_en: The pulse chapter of Zhang Jiebin's Jingyue Quanshu, setting out the essentials of pulse study; the parent work dates to about 1624 (Ming), and Qing editions circulated this chapter separately with wide influence.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: Tianqi reign, Ming; separately printed in Qing
events.title: 妇人规
events.title_en: Furen Gui (Rules for Women's Medicine)
events.summary: 原为张介宾《景岳全书》子目，清代有单行刻本，论妇科证治。
events.summary_en: Originally a sub-section of Zhang Jiebin's Jingyue Quanshu; separately printed in the Qing, on gynecological syndromes and treatment.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 神农本草经疏
events.title_en: Shennong Bencao Jing Shu
events.summary: 明代缪希雍撰，疏释《神农本草经》，有明刻本及清代翻刻。
events.summary_en: By Miao Xiyong of the Ming; a sub-commentary on the Shennong Bencao Jing. Ming printings and Qing reprints exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: Printed in the Tianqi-Chongzhen era, Ming
events.title: 食物本草
events.title_en: Materia Medica of Food (Shiwu Bencao)
events.summary: 署姚可成撰，也有题李杲、李时珍名之说，署名有争议，明天启崇祯间刊行，以明刻本传世，属食疗本草。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Yao Kecheng, with some copies naming Li Gao or Li Shizhen; authorship is disputed. Printed in the Tianqi-Chongzhen era and transmitted in Ming prints as a dietetic materia medica.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 哈维《心血运动论》
events.title_en: Harvey, De Motu Cordis
events.summary: 威廉·哈维1628年出版《心血运动论》，以定量与实验论证血液循环，彻底改变生理学。
events.summary_en: In 1628 William Harvey published De Motu Cordis. With quantitative and experimental argument he demonstrated the circulation of the blood and thoroughly changed physiology.

events.title: 质疑录
events.title_en: Zhiyi Lu
events.summary: 题张介宾撰医论，有清刻本。
events.summary_en: Medical essays attributed to Zhang Jiebin; Qing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒补天石
events.title_en: Stone for Mending Heaven in Cold Damage (Shanghan Butianshi)
events.summary: 戈维城撰，崇祯间成书，以明刻本传世，清代有翻刻，属伤寒专著。年份取崇祯中期大致值。
events.summary_en: By Ge Weicheng, Chongzhen era, transmitted in Ming prints and reprinted in the Qing; a Shanghan monograph. Year is a mid-Chongzhen approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 简明医彀
events.title_en: Concise and Clear Medical Archery Range (Jianming Yigou)
events.summary: 明代孙志宏撰，成书于崇祯三年（1630），以简明扼要的方式讲述医学入门知识与常用方药，兼有方书与入门读物性质。今存明刻本。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Sun Zhihong in 1630 (Chongzhen 3), this concise work combines introductory medical teaching with commonly used prescriptions, serving as both a formulary and a primer. A Ming print survives.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 金鸡纳树皮传入欧洲
events.title_en: Cinchona bark reaches Europe
events.summary: 约1630年秘鲁总督辖区发现金鸡纳树皮可治热病；耶稣会士萨卢姆布里诺约于1631年将其送往欧洲，“耶稣会士树皮”随后用于疟疾治疗，其有效成分奎宁于1820年分离。
events.summary_en: Cinchona bark, found effective against fevers in the Viceroyalty of Peru c.1630, was sent to Europe by Jesuit Agustino Salumbrino c.1631.

events.title: 五运六气详解
events.title_en: Detailed Explanation of Five Phases and Six Qi (Wuyun Liuqi Xiangjie)
events.summary: 董玹撰，约成于崇祯五年（1632）前后，收入《十竹斋刊袖珍本医书》，为阐释五运六气的理论著作。
events.summary_en: By Dong Xuan, c. 1632, included in the Shizhuzhai pocket medical series; an exposition of five phases and six qi.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 霉疮秘录
events.title_en: Secret Record of Syphilis (Meichuang Milu)
events.summary: 明代陈司成撰，成书于崇祯五年（1632），二卷，是中国第一部梅毒专著，首载砒剂与砷剂疗法。传世有明崇祯刻本及1936年《中国医学大成》本。
events.summary_en: Written by Chen Sicheng in 1632 (Chongzhen 5), this two-volume work is China's first monograph on syphilis and the first to record arsenical and arsenic-based therapies. Chongzhen prints and the 1936 Zhongguo Yixue Dacheng edition survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
威斯康星大学图书馆馆藏目录
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 痎疟论疏
events.title_en: Jienue Lun Shu
events.summary: 明代卢之颐撰疟疾专论，有清刻本。
events.summary_en: A monograph on malaria by Lu Zhiyi of the Ming; Qing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 折肱漫录
events.title_en: Zhegong Manlu
events.summary: 明代黄承昊撰医话，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: Medical notes by Huang Chenghao of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 病机沙篆
events.title_en: Sand Seal Notes on Pathogenesis (Bingji Shazhuan)
events.summary: 李中梓撰，崇祯间成书，以清刻本传世，讨论病机，属基础理论类著作。年份取崇祯中期大致值。
events.summary_en: By Li Zhongzi, Chongzhen era, transmitted in Qing prints; a work on pathogenesis within basic theory. Year is a mid-Chongzhen approximation.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 症因脉治
events.title_en: Symptom, Cause, Pulse and Treatment (Zheng Yin Mai Zhi)
events.summary: 明代秦景明撰，其后人秦皇士补辑，成书于天启至崇祯年间，按内伤外感分类，依症状、病因、脉象与治法四项辨析病证。清初刊行较广，今存清刻本。
events.summary_en: Authored by Qin Jingming and later supplemented by Qin Huangshi, this late-Ming work analyses internal and external disorders by symptom, cause, pulse and treatment. It circulated widely in the early Qing, and Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 医宗必读
events.title_en: Yizong Bidu
events.summary: 明代李中梓撰综合性医书，清代翻刻极多。
events.summary_en: A comprehensive medical work by Li Zhongzi of the Ming, with very many Qing reprints.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 邯郸遗稿
events.title_en: Handan Yigao
events.summary: 题赵献可撰妇科著作，有清刻本。
events.summary_en: A gynecological work attributed to Zhao Xianke; Qing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 慎柔五书
events.title_en: Shenrou Wushu
events.summary: 明代胡慎柔撰虚劳与肺痨著作，清初刊行，有清刻本。
events.summary_en: A work on consumptive and pulmonary disorders by Hu Shenrou of the Ming, printed in the early Qing; Qing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 药品化义
events.title_en: Rationale of Drug Properties (Yaopin Huayi)
events.summary: 贾所学撰，李延昰补订，明末清初刊行，以清刻本传世，属本草类，重药性与化义。年份取明末清初近似值。
events.summary_en: By Jia Suoxue and supplemented by Li Yanyu, issued in the late Ming-early Qing and transmitted in Qing prints; a materia medica stressing drug properties. Year is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 祖剂
events.title_en: Ancestral Formulae (Zuji)
events.summary: 明代施沛撰，成书于崇祯十三年（1640），追溯各类方剂的源流与祖方，将后世衍化方归于少数基础方，是方剂溯源类著作。今存明刻本。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Shi Pei in 1640 (Chongzhen 13), this work traces later formulae back to a small set of ancestral base formulae, serving as a study of formula genealogy. A Ming print survives.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 士材三书
events.title_en: Three Books of Shicai (Shicai Sanshu)
events.summary: 明代李中梓撰，成书于崇祯年间，清初合刻，包括《诊家正眼》《本草图解》《病机沙篆》等，属综合性临证著作。今存清刻本，年份为大致推定。
events.summary_en: Written by Li Zhongzi in the Chongzhen era and issued together in the early Qing, this set includes the Zhenjia Zhengyan, Bencao Tujie and Bingji Shazhuan, forming a comprehensive clinical corpus. Qing prints survive; the date is approximate.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 幼科指南
events.title_en: Guide to Pediatrics (Youke Zhinan)
events.summary: 明代周震撰，成书于明末，属儿科著作。书目注明版本待考，具体成书年份与内容细节均不详，年份为大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“儿科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Zhou Zhen in the late Ming, this pediatric work has an unverified edition history. Its exact date and details are uncertain, so the year given is approximate and confidence is low.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 一草亭目科全书
events.title_en: Complete Ophthalmology of the One-Grass Pavilion (Yicaoting Muke Quanshu)
events.summary: 明代邓苑撰，约成书于明末清初，为眼科专著，今存清刻本。成书年份不详，年份取明末大致推定，可信度较低。本条据《中医药古籍初步编目》归入明代“五官科”类，供检索与版本比对参考。
events.summary_en: Written by Deng Yuan around the Ming–Qing transition, this ophthalmology monograph survives in Qing prints. The exact date is unknown and the year given is an approximation from the late Ming.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided bibliography)

events.title: 吴又可《温疫论》
events.title_en: Wu Youke, Treatise on Warm Epidemics
events.summary: 吴有性（又可）1642年著《温疫论》，提出“疠气”自口鼻而入，突破伤寒框架解释瘟疫，是温病学先声。
events.summary_en: In 1642 Wu Youxing (Youke) wrote the Wenyi Lun. He proposed that pestilential qi enters through the mouth and nose, breaking the cold-damage frame as an explanation of epidemics. It is a forerunner of warm-disease studies.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 诊家正眼
events.title_en: Zhenjia Zhengyan
events.summary: 明代李中梓撰诊法著作，清初刊行，有清刻本。
events.summary_en: A diagnostic work by Li Zhongzi of the Ming, printed in the early Qing; Qing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 内经知要
events.title_en: Essentials of the Inner Classic (Neijing Zhiyao)
events.summary: 李中梓摘编《内经》要义而成，约成于崇祯十五年（1642）前后，以明末清初刻本传世，清代翻刻极多，是流传最广的《内经》节要读本之一。
events.summary_en: Li Zhongzi's digest of the essentials of the Neijing, c. 1642; transmitted through late-Ming and early-Qing prints and reprinted extensively in the Qing as a widely used abridged reader.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 邓玉函《泰西人身说概》经毕拱辰润定
events.title_en: Johann Schreck's Taixi renshen shuogai edited by Bi Gongchen
events.summary: 耶稣会士邓玉函口授的西方解剖学著作《泰西人身说概》由山东文人毕拱辰整理润色，是最早用汉文系统介绍欧洲人体解剖知识的文献之一。毕拱辰卒于1644年，润定不会晚于明亡。
events.summary_en: Taixi renshen shuogai, a Western anatomical text dictated by the Jesuit Johann Schreck (Deng Yuhan), was edited by the Shandong scholar Bi Gongchen. It is among the earliest Chinese-language accounts of European anatomy; Bi died in 1644.

events.title: 伤寒括要
events.title_en: Essentials of Cold Damage (Shanghan Kuoyao)
events.summary: 李中梓撰，约成于崇祯十六年（1643）前后，以清刻本传世，概括伤寒辨治要点。
events.summary_en: By Li Zhongzi, c. 1643, transmitted in Qing prints; summarizes the essentials of Shanghan diagnosis and treatment.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 审视瑶函
events.title_en: Shenshi Yaohan
events.summary: 明代傅仁宇撰眼科专著，有明末清初刻本。
events.summary_en: An ophthalmology monograph by Fu Renyu of the Ming; late Ming–early Qing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 轩岐救正论
events.title_en: Xuanqi Jiuzheng Lun
events.summary: 明代萧京撰医论，有明刻本。
events.summary_en: Medical essays by Xiao Jing of the Ming; Ming printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 循经考穴编
events.title_en: Compilation on Point Study Along the Meridians (Xunjing Kaoxue Bian)
events.summary: 严振撰，明末清初抄本系统，以清抄本传世，版本待考，属针灸与腧穴文献。年份取1644年近似。
events.summary_en: By Yan Zhen, late Ming-early Qing, transmitted in Qing manuscripts with editions to be verified; an acupuncture and point text. Year approximated to 1644.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided list)

events.title: 四部医典蒙文译本（那木海扎木苏译本）
events.title_en: Mongolian translation of the Four Tantras (Namhai Jamsu)
events.summary: 据藏文《四部医典》翻译的蒙古文本，译者为那木海扎木苏，以写本与刻本系统流传，是蒙医吸收藏医理论的重要环节。
events.summary_en: A Mongolian translation of the Tibetan Four Tantras by Namhai Jamsu, transmitted in manuscripts and woodblock prints; a key channel through which Mongolian medicine absorbed Tibetan medical theory.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 本草乘雅半偈
events.title_en: Bencao Chengya Banji
events.summary: 明末清初卢之颐撰本草著作，有清刻本。
events.summary_en: A materia medica by Lu Zhiyi of the late Ming–early Qing; Qing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 理虚元鉴
events.title_en: Li Xu Yuanjian
events.summary: 明末清初绮石（汪绮石）撰虚劳专著，有清刻本。
events.summary_en: A monograph on consumptive disorders by Qishi (Wang Qishi) of the late Ming–early Qing; Qing printings exist.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: reprinted repeatedly from the early Edo period
events.title: 和刻本草纲目
events.title_en: Japanese reprints of Bencao gangmu
events.summary: 大阪、京都书林刻印的《本草纲目》和刻本，推动江户日本本草学研究，是中国本草在日本传播的重要载体。
events.summary_en: Osaka and Kyoto publishers' Japanese reprints of the Bencao gangmu stimulated Edo-period honzōgaku and were a major vehicle for the spread of Chinese materia medica in Japan.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 马尔皮基发现毛细血管
events.title_en: Malpighi discovers the capillaries
events.summary: 马尔切洛·马尔皮基约1661年用显微镜观察毛细血管，填补哈维循环理论中动脉与静脉的连接环节。
events.summary_en: About 1661 Marcello Malpighi observed capillaries with a microscope, filling the missing link between arteries and veins in Harvey’s circulation.

events.title: 医灯续焰
events.title_en: Yideng Xuyan (Continuing the Medical Lamp)
events.summary: 潘楫著，以脉学为入门并论内科诸证，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Pan Ji; takes pulse study as an entry point and discusses internal-medicine syndromes. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 威利斯《脑解剖》
events.title_en: Willis's Cerebri anatome
events.summary: 牛津医生托马斯·威利斯1664年出版《脑解剖》，系统描述脑与神经（含脑底动脉环“威利斯环”），对此后两个世纪的神经学影响深远。
events.summary_en: Thomas Willis published Cerebri anatome (1664), a text on the brain and nerves deeply influential for two centuries.

events.title: 胡克命名“细胞”
events.title_en: Hooke names the “cell”
events.summary: 罗伯特·胡克1665年在显微镜下观察软木薄片并命名cells，虽未理解其生命意义，却开启显微形态学。
events.summary_en: In 1665 Robert Hooke observed thin slices of cork under a microscope and named cells. He did not yet understand their significance for life, but the observation opened microscopic morphology.

image.caption_en:
Robert Hooke, Micrographia, cork.
