Keywords: Microscopy

events.title: 洛尔犬间直接输血
events.title_en: Lower's dog-to-dog transfusion
events.summary: 英国医生理查德·洛尔自1665年起进行动物输血实验，首次实现两犬之间的直接输血，为人体输血尝试奠定基础。
events.summary_en: From 1665 Richard Lower performed the first direct blood transfusion between two dogs.

events.title: 脉诀汇辨
events.title_en: Maijue Huibian (Compiled Analysis of Pulse Verses)
events.summary: 李延昰撰于清康熙四年（1665），汇辨历代脉诀，纠正伪托《脉诀》中的错误，是清初脉学考订著作。现存清刻本，对后世脉学的规范化有一定推动作用。
events.summary_en: Written by Li Yanyu in 1665, it collates and critiques pulse verses through the ages and corrects errors of the pseudonymous Maijue, an early-Qing text-critical pulse study; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 德尼斯首例有记录的人体输血
events.title_en: Denys's xenotransfusion
events.summary: 1667年6月15日，路易十四御医让-巴蒂斯特·德尼斯将羊血输入一名少年体内，被视为首例完整记录的人体输血（异种输血）。后续患者死亡引发诉讼，法国随后禁止输血。
events.summary_en: On 15 June 1667 Jean-Baptiste Denys transfused sheep blood into a human; after later deaths the procedure was banned.

events.title: 寿世青编
events.title_en: Shoushi Qingbian (Green Compilation for Longevity)
events.summary: 尤乘著，兼论养生与内科调护，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By You Cheng; discusses health preservation together with internal-medicine regimen. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 伤寒缵论
events.title_en: Continued Discourse on Cold Damage (Shanghan Zuanlun)
events.summary: 《伤寒缵论》，作者张璐，成书时间记为清康熙六年（1667）。传世版本与流传：清康熙间刻本；《张氏医通》本。补充信息：2卷，重订伤寒条文，与《绪论》并行。
events.summary_en: Continued Discourse on Cold Damage (Shanghan Zuanlun): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Zhang Lu, dated around 1667. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒舌鉴
events.title_en: Shanghan Shejian (Mirror of Tongue Diagnosis in Cold Damage)
events.summary: 张登撰于清康熙七年（1668），在《敖氏伤寒金镜录》基础上扩充，辨伤寒舌苔变化与证治，是舌诊专书。现存清刻本，对后世舌诊发展有较大影响。
events.summary_en: Written by Zhang Deng in 1668, it expands the Ao-family Gold Mirror tongue manual to differentiate tongue coatings and treatments in cold damage, a specialist book on tongue diagnosis; Qing prints survive with lasting influence.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 同仁堂创建
events.title_en: Founding of Tongrentang
events.summary: 1669年同仁堂创立，成为著名中药老字号，象征清代成药商业与品质传统。
events.summary_en: Tongrentang was founded in 1669 and became a famous old firm of Chinese medicine, a symbol of Qing commercial prepared medicines and of a tradition of quality.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: Gisling
image.caption: 北京大栅栏同仁堂药店
image.caption_en: Beijing Dashala Tongrentang herbal medicine store

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 10th year of Kangxi, Qing (1671)
events.title: 伤寒论印
events.title_en: Shanghanlun Yin (Verification of the Shanghan Lun)
events.summary: 程应旄所撰《伤寒论》注本，成书于清康熙十年（1671）前后，主张按六经重新编次《伤寒论》条文并作评注。现存清刻本，反映清初“错简重订”一派的研究思路。
events.summary_en: Cheng Yingmao's Shanghan Lun commentary, written around 1671, re-arranged the clauses under the six channels with annotation; Qing prints survive, reflecting the early-Qing 'rearranged text' approach to the classic.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒论后条辨
events.title_en: Later Clause Analysis of the Shanghan Lun
events.summary: 程应旄撰于清康熙十年（1671），是对《伤寒论》的条辨体注释，逐条辨析条文意义，反映其对仲景学说的理解。现存清刻本，与《伤寒论印》为同一作者的伤寒学研究成果。
events.summary_en: Written by Cheng Yingmao in 1671, this clause-by-clause analysis of the Shanghan Lun reflects his understanding of Zhongjing's teaching; Qing prints survive, and it belongs with his Shanghanlun Yin among his Shanghan studies.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清康熙间（《来苏集》组成部分）
events.yearLabel_en: Kangxi era, Qing (part of Laisu Ji)
events.title: 伤寒论翼
events.title_en: Shanghanlun Yi (Wings of the Shanghan Lun)
events.summary: 柯琴《伤寒来苏集》的组成部分，成书于清康熙年间，从总体上阐述六经辨证和《伤寒论》的理论体系，主张六经为百病立法。现存《伤寒来苏集》本及后世点校本。
events.summary_en: Part of Ke Qin's Shanghan Laisu Ji from the Kangxi era, this book expounds the six-channel framework and overall theory of the Shanghan Lun, arguing that the six channels set rules for all diseases; preserved in the Laisu Ji editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒附翼
events.title_en: Shanghan Fuyi (Appended Wings on Cold Damage)
events.summary: 柯琴《伤寒来苏集》的组成部分之一，成书于清康熙年间，专论《伤寒论》方剂及其组方意义，与《伤寒论注》《伤寒论翼》合为一书。现存《伤寒来苏集》本。
events.summary_en: One part of Ke Qin's Shanghan Laisu Ji from the Kangxi era, devoted to the formulas of the Shanghan Lun and their rationale and bound with his commentary and Shanghanlun Yi; preserved in the Laisu Ji editions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 痧胀玉衡
events.title_en: Shazhang Yuheng (Jade Scale on Sha-Distension)
events.summary: 郭志邃著，为痧证专著，论痧胀的病因、诊治与刮放等疗法，有清刻本多种传世。
events.summary_en: By Guo Zhisui; a monograph on sha-distension syndromes covering etiology, diagnosis, scraping and bloodletting therapies. Several Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 列文虎克观察微生物
events.title_en: Leeuwenhoek observes microorganisms
events.summary: 安东尼·范·列文虎克1670年代用自制显微镜观察“微小动物”，为微生物学提供视觉证据。
events.summary_en: In the 1670s Antonie van Leeuwenhoek used microscopes he had made himself to observe “little animals,” providing visual evidence for microbiology.

image.author: Jeroen Rouwkema
image.caption: 列文虎克显微镜复制品
image.caption_en: Leeuwenhoek_Microscope_Replica

events.title: 西德纳姆临床观察医学
events.title_en: Sydenham and clinical observation
events.summary: 托马斯·西德纳姆强调床边观察与疾病自然史，被誉为“英格兰希波克拉底”，影响经验临床医学。
events.summary_en: Thomas Sydenham emphasized bedside observation and the natural history of disease. He was called the “English Hippocrates” and influenced empirical clinical medicine.

events.title: 素问经注节解
events.title_en: Condensed Explanation of Suwen Text and Commentary (Suwen Jingzhu Jiejie)
events.summary: 清初医家姚止庵撰于康熙十六年（1677），对《素问》经文及王冰等旧注加以节录并作简明解说，意在使经义清晰易晓。现存清刻本，属清代医经注释著作。
events.summary_en: Written by the early-Qing physician Yao Zhi'an in 1677, this work abridges the Suwen text with earlier commentaries such as Wang Bing's and adds concise explanations to clarify the classic; Qing printed editions survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒论三注
events.title_en: Three Annotations on the Shanghan Lun
events.summary: 周扬俊撰于清康熙十六年（1677），汇集方有执、喻昌等诸家对《伤寒论》的注释并加评议，故名“三注”，属清初伤寒学研究的代表著作之一。现存清刻本。
events.summary_en: Written by Zhou Yangjun in 1677, this compilation and critique of Shanghan Lun commentaries by Fang Youzhi, Yu Chang and others gives the work its 'three annotations' name; a representative early-Qing Shanghan study with Qing prints.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 17th year of Kangxi, Qing (1678)
events.title: 小儿推拿广意
events.title_en: Xiaoer Tuina Guangyi (Broad Notions on Paediatric Massage)
events.summary: 熊应雄撰，约成于清康熙十七年（1678），汇集小儿推拿的手法与穴位，清代流传甚广并多次翻刻，是小儿推拿重要文献。现存清刻本及后世翻刻本。
events.summary_en: Written by Xiong Yingxiong around 1678, it compiles paediatric tuina techniques and points, was widely circulated and repeatedly reprinted in the Qing, and is an important source on paediatric massage; Qing and later reprints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清康熙间（一作《伤寒论辨证广注》）
events.yearLabel_en: Kangxi era, Qing (also titled Extended Annotations on Pattern Differentiation)
events.title: 伤寒论辑义
events.title_en: Compiled Meanings of the Shanghan Lun (Shanghanlun Jiyi)
events.summary: 清代医家汪琥所撰，成书于康熙年间，汇集诸家对《伤寒论》的注释并加案语，一作《伤寒论辨证广注》之别称。现存清刻本，是清初《伤寒论》研究的重要参考。
events.summary_en: Written by the Qing physician Wang Hu in the Kangxi era, this work gathers various commentaries on the Shanghan Lun with his own remarks and is also known as the Extended Annotations; Qing prints survive as an important early-Qing reference.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 19th year of Kangxi, Qing (1680)
events.title: 伤寒论辨证广注
events.title_en: Extended Annotations on Pattern Differentiation in the Shanghan Lun
events.summary: 汪琥撰于康熙十九年（1680）前后，对《伤寒论》逐条注释，引述诸家并加辨证分析，是清代主要的《伤寒论》注本之一。现存清刻本，对后世伤寒学研究影响较大。
events.summary_en: Written by Wang Hu around 1680, this clause-by-clause commentary on the Shanghan Lun cites earlier scholars and adds pattern analysis; it is one of the main Qing commentaries and influenced later Shanghan studies; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 四明心法
events.title_en: Siming Xinfa (Heart-Method of Siming)
events.summary: 高鼓峰著，论内科证治，有清刻本传世，亦收入《医宗已任编》。
events.summary_en: By Gao Gufeng; discusses internal-medicine syndromes and treatments; also included in Yizong Yiren Bian. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 四明医案
events.title_en: Siming Yi'an (Siming Case Records)
events.summary: 高鼓峰医案，与《四明心法》同属《医宗已任编》系统，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Case records of Gao Gufeng, belonging to the same Yizong Yiren Bian tradition as Siming Xinfa. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 尤氏喉科秘书
events.title_en: Mr. You's Secret Book of Laryngology (Youshi Houke Mishu)
events.summary: 《尤氏喉科秘书》，作者尤乘，成书时间记为清康熙间。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：咽喉。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Mr. You's Secret Book of Laryngology (Youshi Houke Mishu): Qing-dynasty work attributed to You Cheng, dated around 1680. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 女科经纶
events.title_en: Nuke Jinglun (Warp and Weft of Gynecology)
events.summary: 萧埙著，汇辑历代妇科论说并加按语，系统梳理妇科理论，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Xiao Xun; compiles and annotates earlier gynecological discussions to systematize theory. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 金匮玉函经二注
events.title_en: Two Annotations on the Jingui Yuhan Jing
events.summary: 周扬俊撰于清康熙二十六年（1687），在赵以德《金匮方论衍义》基础上增补注释，对《金匮要略》条文作较详细的阐发，故称“二注”。现存清刻本，是清初金匮学研究的参考著作。
events.summary_en: Written by Zhou Yangjun in 1687, it expands Zhao Yide's Jingui commentary and explains the Jingui Yaolue clauses in more detail, hence 'two annotations'; Qing prints survive as a reference of early-Qing Jingui studies.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 证治汇补
events.title_en: Zhengzhi Huibu (Compendium of Syndromes and Treatments)
events.summary: 李用粹著，系统汇集内科证治，翻刻多种，影响较广。
events.summary_en: By Li Yongcui; systematically compiles internal-medicine syndromes and treatments; reprinted many times and widely influential.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.yearLabel: 藏历约1688年（清康熙二十七年前后）
events.title: 蓝琉璃
events.title_en: Blue Beryl (Vaidurya sngon po)
events.summary: 《四部医典》的权威注释本，由第司·桑结嘉措（桑杰嘉措）撰成，以藏文木刻流传，并在寺院曼巴扎仓长期用于教学。其内容后来成为曼唐医学挂图的基础。
events.summary_en: The authoritative commentary on the Four Tantras, written by Desi Sangye Gyatso and circulated in Tibetan woodblock editions used for teaching in monastic medical colleges (menpa dratsang). Its content later underpinned the Sman thang medical thangka series.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: PubMed: Four genres of Sman Thang

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 28th year of Kangxi, Qing (1689)
events.title: 素问灵枢类纂约注
events.title_en: Concise Annotations on the Classified Compilation of Suwen and Lingshu (Suwen Lingshu Leizuan Yuezhu)
events.summary: 清初医家汪昂对《素问》《灵枢》分类摘编并加简要注释的医经类著作，便于初学者研读《内经》要旨。现存清刻本流传，成书年代为康熙二十八年前后。
events.summary_en: A Qing-dynasty classified and abridged annotation of the Suwen and Lingshu by Wang Ang, intended to help beginners study the essentials of the Neijing; preserved in Qing printed editions and dated to around 1689.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 本草新编
events.title_en: New Compilation of Materia Medica (Bencao Xinbian)
events.summary: 《本草新编》，作者陈士铎，成书时间记为清康熙二十八年（1689）。传世版本与流传：清康熙间刻本；《陈士铎医学全书》本。补充信息：5卷，载药272种，独抒己见。
events.summary_en: New Compilation of Materia Medica (Bencao Xinbian): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Chen Shiduo, dated around 1689. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清康熙间（多附《本草备要》）
events.title: 勿药元诠
events.title_en: Original Exposition on Needing No Medicine (Wuyao Yuanquan)
events.summary: 《勿药元诠》，作者汪昂，成书时间记为清康熙间（多附《本草备要》）。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：养生。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Original Exposition on Needing No Medicine (Wuyao Yuanquan): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Wang Ang, dated around 1690. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 法国耶稣会士以金鸡纳治愈康熙疟疾
events.title_en: French Jesuits cure the Kangxi Emperor's malaria with cinchona bark
events.summary: 1693年，法国耶稣会士洪若翰、刘应等用金鸡纳树皮治好了康熙帝的疟疾。康熙此前已对欧洲科学和药物感兴趣，此事提高了传教士在清宫中的地位，是中西医药交流的标志性事件。
events.summary_en: In 1693 the French Jesuits Jean de Fontaney and Claude de Visdelou cured the Kangxi Emperor's malaria with cinchona ("Jesuit's bark"). The emperor already took an interest in European science and medicine, and the cure strengthened the Jesuits' standing at court.

events.title: 汪昂《本草备要》
events.title_en: Wang Ang's Bencao beiyao
events.summary: 清初新安医家汪昂著《本草备要》，选取常用药物，简明扼要地讲解药性和功用，是清代流传最广的本草普及读本之一。至今在中国大陆、台湾和日本仍作为古典被广泛阅读。
events.summary_en: Wang Ang's Bencao beiyao (1694) concisely explains common medicinals and became one of the most widely read Qing materia medica primers. It is still read as a classic in China, Taiwan and Japan.

events.yearLabel: 约清康熙三十三年至三十七年（1694–1698）；嘉庆二十年静乐堂抄本系统
events.title: 外经微言
events.title_en: Subtle Words of the Outer Classic (Waijing Weiyan)
events.summary: 《外经微言》，署名旧题岐伯传、陈士铎述（托名《外经》；实陈氏著作），成书时间记为约清康熙三十三年至三十七年（1694–1698）；嘉庆二十年静乐堂抄本系统。传世版本与流传：清抄本（天津图书馆等藏著录）；版本待核牌记。补充信息：九卷八十一篇；公私书目旧多未载。学界考证非古《外经》而属陈士铎托名阐发。医砭电子书库著录。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Subtle Words of the Outer Classic (Waijing Weiyan): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Chen Shiduo, dated around 1694. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 素问直解
events.title_en: Suwen Zhijie (Direct Explanation of the Suwen)
events.summary: 高世栻为张志聪弟子，撰此书直解《素问》，文字平易，常与张志聪《素问集注》并称，反映清初钱塘医派对《内经》的注释风格。现存清刻本。
events.summary_en: Gao Shishi, a disciple of Zhang Zhicong, wrote this plain-language commentary on the Suwen, often paired with Zhang's Suwen Collected Annotations and reflecting the Qiantang school's approach to the Neijing; Qing printed editions survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 幼科铁镜
events.title_en: Youke Tiejing (Iron Mirror of Pediatrics)
events.summary: 夏鼎著，重视小儿望诊与指纹，批评时弊，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Xia Ding; emphasizes inspection and finger-vein observation in children and criticizes contemporary practice. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 拉马齐尼《论手工业者的疾病》
events.title_en: Ramazzini's De morbis artificum
events.summary: 意大利医生拉马齐尼1700年出版《De morbis artificum diatriba》，为首部专论职业病与工作风险预防的著作，涉及数十种行业，被尊为职业医学奠基之作。
events.summary_en: Bernardino Ramazzini's De morbis artificum diatriba (1700) was the first book on occupational diseases.

events.title: 金匮要略方论本义
events.title_en: Original Meaning of the Jingui Yaolue Formulas and Discussions
events.summary: 魏荔彤所撰《金匮要略》注本，成书于清康熙年间，逐条阐释条文并结合临床体会，是清初金匮学研究的代表之一。现存清刻本，对后世《金匮》注释有一定影响。
events.summary_en: Wei Litong's Jingui Yaolue commentary from the Kangxi era explains the clauses one by one with clinical remarks, a representative of early-Qing Jingui studies; Qing prints survive and influenced later annotations.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清康熙间（存疑）；乾隆刊行系统
events.title: 胎产指南
events.title_en: Taichan Zhinan (Guide to Pregnancy and Childbirth)
events.summary: 单南山著，论胎产调治，成书年代与刊行系统存疑，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Shan Nanshan; on prenatal and obstetric care. Date and printing lineage are uncertain. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.yearLabel: 约明清以来贝叶写本递传
events.title: 傣医《档哈雅》系统（贝叶经医书）
events.title_en: Dai medicine Dangaya (palm-leaf medical manuscripts)
events.summary: 傣医以傣文贝叶经写本传承的医药文献，由僧俗医者世代传抄，方药与理论混编，专书定名多据整理者，具体题名待考。
events.summary_en: Dai-language palm-leaf manuscripts transmitted by monastic and lay healers, mixing formulas and theory; individual titles are often assigned by modern editors and need further verification.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 嘎牙山哈雅等傣医典籍
events.title_en: Gayashan Haya and other Dai medical texts
events.summary: 傣文写本医籍，作者佚名，约明清写本传统，成书与定名有待与现代整理报告互核。
events.summary_en: Dai-language manuscript medical texts of anonymous authorship from the Ming–Qing manuscript tradition; dating and naming await cross-checking with modern editorial reports.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 朝鲜翻刻《医学入门》《医学正传》《东垣十书》等
events.title_en: Joseon reprints of Yixue rumen, Yixue zhengchuan, Dongyuan shishu and others
events.summary: 朝鲜官刻与坊刻翻印中国明医书，使明代医学在朝鲜广泛流传，是中国医书域外刊本的重要部分。
events.summary_en: Joseon government and commercial presses reprinted Ming-era Chinese medical books, spreading Ming medicine in Korea; an important body of foreign-printed editions of Chinese works.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 皮拉里尼在欧洲实施人痘接种
events.title_en: Pylarini performs variolation in Europe
events.summary: 1701年雅各莫·皮拉里尼在欧洲施行人痘接种；该术此前已在中国与奥斯曼等地流行，经蒙塔古夫人等传入英国。
events.summary_en: In 1701 Giacomo Pylarini performed variolation in Europe. The practice was already current in China and the Ottoman Empire and reached Britain through Lady Mary Wortley Montagu and others.

events.title: 冯氏锦囊秘录
events.title_en: Mr. Feng's Secret Brocade Bag Records (Fengshi Jinnang Milu)
events.summary: 《冯氏锦囊秘录》，作者冯兆张，成书时间记为清康熙四十一年（1702）。传世版本与流传：清康熙间刻本；中国中医药出版社1996年点校。补充信息：50卷，综合性医学丛书，重小儿与痘疹。
events.summary_en: Mr. Feng's Secret Brocade Bag Records (Fengshi Jinnang Milu): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Feng Zhaozhang, dated around 1702. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 黄元御与尊经派及其传人
events.title_en: Huang Yuanyu and his disciples
events.summary: 黄元御（1705—1758）是清代名医，尊经派的代表人物，推崇《内经》、仲景之学。研究者根据地方志、档案记录等资料，考察了他门人的生平、行医经历和成就，说明他的学术在后世有一条传承脉络。
events.summary_en: Huang Yuanyu (1705–1758), a representative of the classical school, was a renowned Qing physician. Research using local gazetteers traces the careers of his disciples.

events.title: 布尔哈弗莱顿临床教学
events.title_en: Boerhaave’s clinical teaching at Leiden
events.summary: 赫尔曼·布尔哈弗在莱顿将床边教学与化学、解剖结合，培养全欧医师，代表18世纪初临床医学。
events.summary_en: Herman Boerhaave at Leiden joined bedside teaching to chemistry and anatomy and trained physicians from across Europe. He represents clinical medicine in the early 18th century.

events.yearLabel: 清康熙间成书；雍正刊行
events.yearLabel_en: Completed in Kangxi, published in Yongzheng, Qing
events.title: 伤寒溯源集
events.title_en: Shanghan Suyuan Ji (Tracing the Origins of Cold Damage)
events.summary: 钱潢撰，康熙年间成书，雍正年间刊行，对《伤寒论》逐条注解，重视三阴三阳与六经辨证，并探究仲景立论源流。现存清雍正刻本等，是清代重要的《伤寒论》注本。
events.summary_en: Written by Qian Huang in the Kangxi era and printed in the Yongzheng reign, this clause-by-clause commentary on the Shanghan Lun stresses the six-channel framework and traces its sources; Qing editions survive as an important commentary.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 巴多明为康熙编译满文解剖学
events.title_en: Dominique Parrenin's Manchu anatomy for the Kangxi Emperor
events.summary: 法国耶稣会士白晋、巴多明先后为康熙讲授欧洲解剖学。巴多明的讲授编成满文解剖图谱，其中包含哈维的血液循环学说，约成于1710至1722年间；他还奉旨撰写满文医书，结合中医理论与西方医学概念，后译为蒙古文。
events.summary_en: Joachim Bouvet and Dominique Parrenin taught European anatomy to the Kangxi Emperor. Parrenin's teaching produced a Manchu anatomical atlas, compiled c. 1710–1722, that included Harvey's circulation of the blood. He also wrote a Manchu medical work combining Chinese and Western concepts, later translated into Mongolian.

events.title: 痘疹定论
events.title_en: Douzhen Dinglun (Definitive Discussion of Pox)
events.summary: 朱巽著，论痘疹辨治，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Zhu Xun; discusses differentiation and treatment of pox. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 达生篇
events.title_en: Dasheng Pian (Treatise on Easy Delivery)
events.summary: 亟斋居士著，通俗介绍临产调护与顺产要诀，翻刻极多，是清代流传最广的产科普及读物之一。
events.summary_en: By Jizhai Jushi; a popular guide to childbirth care and easy delivery, reprinted extremely often and among the most widely circulated Qing obstetric primers.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 蒙塔古夫人引入人痘至英国
events.title_en: Lady Mary Wortley Montagu introduces variolation to Britain
events.summary: 玛丽·沃特利·蒙塔古夫人基于奥斯曼观察，约1721年推动人痘接种在英国贵族中试验推广。
events.summary_en: Drawing on Ottoman observation, Lady Mary Wortley Montagu about 1721 promoted trials of variolation among the British aristocracy.

events.yearLabel: 约清康熙末至雍正前（约1722前后）
events.yearLabel_en: Late Kangxi to early Yongzheng, Qing (c. 1722)
events.title: 广瘟疫论
events.title_en: Guang Wenyi Lun (Expanded Treatise on Pestilence)
events.summary: 戴天章著，在吴有性《温疫论》基础上辨析瘟疫与伤寒之别，后有陆懋修《广温热论》、何廉臣重订本，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Dai Tianzhang; builds on Wu Youxing's Wenyi Lun to distinguish pestilence from cold damage. Later revised by Lu Maoxiu and He Lianchen; Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 四诊抉微
events.title_en: Sizhen Juewei (Exposition of the Four Diagnostic Methods)
events.summary: 林之翰撰于清雍正元年（1723），汇集望闻问切四诊的资料，旁征博引诸家论述并加评议，是清代较有影响的诊法专著。现存清刻本，对后世诊断学教学参考较多。
events.summary_en: Written by Lin Zhihan in 1723, this compendium collects material on inspection, listening and smelling, inquiry and palpation with extensive citation and commentary, an influential Qing monograph on diagnostics; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 幼幼指掌集成
events.title_en: Youyou Zhizhang Jicheng (Pediatric Handbook Compendium)
events.summary: 题孟河撰，一说作者待考，论小儿证治，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Meng He; authorship uncertain. Discusses pediatric syndromes and treatment. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 难经经释
events.title_en: Nanjing Jingshi (Explanation of the Classic of Difficult Issues)
events.summary: 徐大椿撰，逐难注释《难经》，并以《内经》为据驳正旧说，是清代较有影响的《难经》注本。徐氏后收入《徐灵胎医书》系列，现存清刻本。
events.summary_en: Xu Dachun's commentary on the Nanjing, annotating each issue and correcting earlier views against the Neijing; one of the more influential Qing Nanjing commentaries, later included in his collected medical works.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 痧痘集解
events.title_en: Shadou Jijie (Collected Explanations on Sha and Pox)
events.summary: 俞茂鲲著，论痧症与痘症，有清松荫堂刻本等传世。
events.summary_en: By Yu Maokun; discusses sha and pox disorders. Songyintang and other Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 启谷蜀
events.title_en: Qigushu (Yi-script medical text)
events.summary: 彝医传统文献，以彝文写本传承，约形成于清雍正年间，内容属彝医药传抄系统。
events.summary_en: A Yi medical text transmitted in Yi-script manuscripts, taking shape around the Yongzheng era within the Yi medical manuscript tradition.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 古本难经阐注
events.title_en: Annotated Explication of the Ancient Edition of the Nanjing (Guben Nanjing Chanzhu)
events.summary: 清代医家丁锦撰于雍正年间，依据《难经》古本作阐释和注解，属清代《难经》研究著作之一，意在恢复古本面貌并发挥经义。现存清刻本，具体版本待考。
events.summary_en: Written by the Qing physician Ding Jin in the Yongzheng era, this work explicates and annotates an ancient edition of the Nanjing, aiming to restore the old text and expound its meaning; Qing prints survive, with details to be verified.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 集验良方
events.title_en: Jiyan Liangfang (Collected Tested Formulas)
events.summary: 题年希尧辑，汇编各科验方，刊行于雍正年间，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Attributed to Nian Xiyao; a multi-specialty collection of tested formulas published in the Yongzheng reign. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 胎产心法
events.title_en: Taichan Xinfa (Heart-Method of Pregnancy and Childbirth)
events.summary: 阎纯玺著，论妊娠与产育证治，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Yan Chunxi; discusses syndromes and treatments of pregnancy and childbirth. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 外科十法
events.title_en: Ten Methods of Surgery (Waike Shifa)
events.summary: 《外科十法》，作者程国彭，成书时间记为清雍正间（《医学心悟》附）。传世版本与流传：《医学心悟》本。补充信息：外科。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Ten Methods of Surgery (Waike Shifa): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Cheng Guopeng, dated around 1730. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 程国彭《医学心悟》
events.title_en: Cheng Guopeng, Awakening of the Mind in Medicine
events.summary: 程国彭1732年著《医学心悟》，以八纲与汗吐下和消清温补概括治法，影响临床教学。
events.summary_en: In 1732 Cheng Guopeng wrote the Yixue Xinwu. It sums up methods of treatment with the eight principles and with sweating, vomiting, purging, harmonizing, dispersing, clearing, warming, and supplementing, and it influenced clinical teaching.
works_en: Yixue Xinwu (Awakening of the Mind in Medicine)

events.title: 黑尔斯首次直接测量动脉血压
events.title_en: Hales measures arterial pressure
events.summary: 英国牧师科学家斯蒂芬·黑尔斯在1733年《血液静力学》中记载：将铜管插入马腿动脉连接玻璃管，血柱升至约8英尺3英寸，为首次直接测量动脉血压。
events.summary_en: In Haemastaticks (1733) Stephen Hales recorded the first direct measurement of arterial blood pressure in a horse.

events.title: 艾曼首例成功阑尾切除
events.title_en: Amyand’s early successful appendectomy
events.summary: 克劳迪乌斯·艾曼1736年完成文献记载较早的成功阑尾切除术。
events.summary_en: In 1736 Claudius Amyand completed a successful appendectomy that is among the earlier ones recorded in the literature.

events.title: 神农本草经百种录
events.title_en: Record of One Hundred Drugs in Shennong's Classic (Shennong Bencao Jing Baizhonglu)
events.summary: 《神农本草经百种录》，作者徐大椿，成书时间记为清乾隆元年（1736）。传世版本与流传：清乾隆间刻本；《徐灵胎医书全集》本。补充信息：1卷，选《本经》100种药逐条疏解。
events.summary_en: Record of One Hundred Drugs in Shennong's Classic (Shennong Bencao Jing Baizhonglu): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Xu Dachun, dated around 1736. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清乾隆前原稿；民国印本
events.title: 未刻本叶氏医案
events.title_en: Unpublished Medical Cases of Ye Gui (Weikeben Yeshi Yi'an)
events.summary: 《未刻本叶氏医案》，作者叶桂；后世发现印行，成书时间记为清乾隆前原稿；民国印本。传世版本与流传：民国印本为主。补充信息：医案。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Unpublished Medical Cases of Ye Gui (Weikeben Yeshi Yi'an): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Ye Gui, dated around 1740. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清乾隆六年（1741）前后成书；嘉庆刊行较广
events.title: 目经大成
events.title_en: Great Compendium of Ophthalmology (Mujing Dacheng)
events.summary: 《目经大成》，作者黄庭镜，成书时间记为清乾隆六年（1741）前后成书；嘉庆刊行较广。传世版本与流传：清嘉庆刻本等。补充信息：眼科。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Great Compendium of Ophthalmology (Mujing Dacheng): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Huang Tingjing, dated around 1741. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 《医宗金鉴》刊印
events.title_en: The Golden Mirror of the Medical Tradition is printed
events.summary: 乾隆朝官修《医宗金鉴》1742年刊印，作为太医院教材，规范临床与考核。
events.summary_en: The official Yizong Jinjian of the Qianlong reign was printed in 1742. Used as a textbook of the Imperial Medical Academy, it standardized clinical practice and examinations.
works_en: Yizong Jinjian (Golden Mirror of the Medical Tradition)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 医宗金鉴·刺灸心法要诀
events.title_en: Yizong Jinjian: Essential Verses on Acupuncture and Moxibustion Methods
events.summary: 乾隆七年（1742）官修《医宗金鉴》的分卷，以歌诀和图示形式讲解经穴取穴与刺灸方法，通行于太医院教学，后世影响较大。该书整体由吴谦等奉敕编纂。
events.summary_en: A volume of the imperially commissioned Yizong Jinjian (1742) presenting acupoint location and needling and moxibustion methods in verse and diagrams, used in imperial-medical teaching and widely influential; compiled by Wu Qian and others by decree.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
中国哲学书电子化计划/公开书目著录
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医宗金鉴·删补名医方论
events.title_en: Revised Discourses on Famous Physicians' Formulas (Yizong Jinjian)
events.summary: 吴谦等奉敕编纂《医宗金鉴》时收入的方论分册，对历代名医方剂加以删补论述，现存武英殿本，属官修医学教科书体系的一部分。
events.summary_en: A formula-discussion volume within the imperially commissioned Yizong Jinjian compiled under Wu Qian; it revises and comments on formulas of earlier famous physicians. Extant in the Wuyingdian edition.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 医宗金鉴·外科心法要诀
events.title_en: Yizong Jinjian: Essential Verses on Surgery (Waike Xinfa Yaojue)
events.summary: 《医宗金鉴·外科心法要诀》，作者吴谦等，成书时间记为清乾隆七年（1742）。传世版本与流传：武英殿本。补充信息：外科。
events.summary_en: Yizong Jinjian: Essential Verses on Surgery (Waike Xinfa Yaojue): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Wu Qian, dated around 1742. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.

events.summary: 《眼科心法要诀》（《医宗金鉴》子目），作者吴谦等，成书时间记为1742。传世版本与流传：武英殿本。补充信息：眼科。

events.title_en: Essential Verses on Gynecology (Fuke Xinfa Yaojue)
events.summary: 《妇科心法要诀》，作者吴谦等（《医宗金鉴》子目），成书时间记为清乾隆七年（1742）。传世版本与流传：武英殿《医宗金鉴》本；单行清刻本、石印本。补充信息：《医宗金鉴》妇科歌括心法；医砭作专科单列，本编补子目专条以便检索。

events.title_en: Essential Verses on Miscellaneous Diseases (Zabing Xinfa Yaojue)
events.summary: 《杂病心法要诀》，作者吴谦等（《医宗金鉴》子目），成书时间记为清乾隆七年（1742）。传世版本与流传：武英殿《医宗金鉴》本；单行清刻/石印。补充信息：《医宗金鉴》杂病歌括；医砭专科栏著录。

events.title: 叶天士《温热论》
events.title_en: Ye Tianshi, Treatise on Warm-Heat Diseases
events.summary: 叶桂（天士）温热病经验约1746年整理为《温热论》，创立卫气营血辨证，标志温病学派成熟。
events.summary_en: Ye Gui’s (Tianshi) experience of warm-heat disease was arranged about 1746 as the Wenre Lun. It established four-level pattern differentiation—wei, qi, ying, and blood—and marks the maturity of the warm-disease school.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 惠直堂经验方
events.title_en: Huizhitang Jingyanfang (Tested Formulas of the Huizhi Hall)
events.summary: 陶承熹辑，汇编经验方，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Tao Chengxi; a collection of tested formulas. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 林德柑橘防治坏血病试验
events.title_en: Lind’s trial of citrus against scurvy
events.summary: 詹姆斯·林德1747年在舰上进行对照试验，证明柑橘类可防治坏血病，是早期临床对照研究范例。
events.summary_en: In 1747 James Lind ran a controlled trial on a ship and showed that citrus could prevent and treat scurvy. It is an early example of a controlled clinical study.

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 13th year of Qianlong, Qing (1748)
events.title: 素问悬解
events.title_en: Suwen Xuanjie (Suspended Elucidation of the Suwen)
events.summary: 黄元御对《素问》的注解之作，属其《黄氏医书八种》系列。黄氏崇尚尊经，以阴阳升降理论重新编次并解释《素问》原文，现存清刻本及《黄氏医书八种》本。
events.summary_en: Huang Yuanyu's commentary on the Suwen, part of his Eight Medical Works. He re-arranged and interpreted the text through yin-yang ascending-descending theory; preserved in Qing printed editions and the collected Eight Works.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 麻科活人全书
events.title_en: Make Huoren Quanshu (Complete Book on Measles for Saving Lives)
events.summary: 谢玉琼著，为麻疹专著，系统论述麻疹的诊治，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Xie Yuqiong; a monograph on measles with systematic diagnosis and treatment. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 灵枢悬解
events.title_en: Lingshu Xuanjie (Suspended Elucidation of the Lingshu)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰《灵枢》注解，与《素问悬解》《难经悬解》相配套，同收于《黄氏医书八种》。以尊经复古为宗，对《灵枢》篇次与经文作了重订和阐释。
events.summary_en: Huang Yuanyu's commentary on the Lingshu, companion to his Suwen and Nanjing commentaries and included in his Eight Medical Works. It follows a classicist approach and re-orders and explains the Lingshu text.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 难经悬解
events.title_en: Nanjing Xuanjie (Suspended Elucidation of the Classic of Difficult Issues)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰《难经》注解，收于《黄氏医书八种》。书中以阴阳升降、土枢四象等观点解释《难经》八十一难，是清代《难经》注本之一。
events.summary_en: Huang Yuanyu's commentary on the Nanjing, included in his Eight Medical Works; it reads the 81 difficult issues through his yin-yang and central-earth pivot theory, one of the Qing-era Nanjing annotations.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 四圣悬枢
events.title_en: Sisheng Xuanshu (Pivot of the Four Sages)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰，论述伤寒与温疫的理论，属《黄氏医书八种》，成书于清乾隆年间。书中分析六经病机和温疫病机，体现其以阴阳升降学说统摄外感病的主张。
events.summary_en: By Huang Yuanyu in the Qianlong era and part of his Eight Medical Works, this treatise discusses cold-damage and pestilence theory, analysing six-channel and pestilence pathology within his ascent-descent framework for exogenous disease.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 长沙药解
events.title_en: Changsha Yaojie (Explanation of Drugs in Zhang Zhongjing's Formulas)
events.summary: 黄元御以《伤寒论》《金匮要略》所用药物为对象撰写的药解，收于《黄氏医书八种》。书中依据仲景用药配伍阐发药性，是尊经派本草理论的代表之作。
events.summary_en: Huang Yuanyu's explanation of the drugs used in the Shanghan Lun and Jingui Yaolue, collected in his Eight Medical Works; it interprets drug properties through Zhongjing's formulations.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 玉楸药解
events.title_en: Yuqiu Yaojie (Yuqiu's Explanation of Drugs)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰药物学著作，收于《黄氏医书八种》，成书于清乾隆年间。书中对数百味常用药物的性味与功用逐一阐述，与《长沙药解》互为补充，体现尊经派的药物理论。
events.summary_en: A materia-medica work by Huang Yuanyu in his Eight Medical Works, from the Qianlong era; it explains the nature and use of several hundred common drugs and complements his Changsha Yaojie, reflecting the classicist drug theory.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 素灵微蕴
events.title_en: Suling Weiyun (Subtle Principles of the Suwen and Lingshu)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰，对胎化、藏象、经脉、脉法及诸病作专题论述，成书于清乾隆年间，收于《黄氏医书八种》。该书集中体现了作者的理论思想，是理解其学术体系的重要读物。
events.summary_en: By Huang Yuanyu in the Qianlong era and included in his Eight Medical Works, this book offers thematic essays on fetal formation, visceral manifestation, channels, pulse and diseases, concentrating his theoretical thought.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒悬解
events.title_en: Shanghan Xuanjie (Suspended Elucidation of Cold Damage)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰《伤寒论》注本，成书于清乾隆年间，收于《黄氏医书八种》，以尊经和阴阳升降学说重新阐释六经病证，是尊经派伤寒学的代表作品。
events.summary_en: Huang Yuanyu's Shanghan Lun commentary from the Qianlong era, collected in his Eight Medical Works; it re-interprets the six-channel patterns through classicism and ascent-descent theory and represents the classicist school of Shanghan studies.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 金匮悬解
events.title_en: Jingui Xuanjie (Suspended Elucidation of the Jingui)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰《金匮要略》注本，成书于清乾隆年间，收于《黄氏医书八种》，对杂病条文作解释并重订次序，与《伤寒悬解》相配套，体现其尊经思想。
events.summary_en: Huang Yuanyu's commentary on the Jingui Yaolue from the Qianlong era, in his Eight Medical Works; it interprets the miscellaneous-disease clauses and re-orders them as a companion to his Shanghan Xuanjie, reflecting his classicism.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒说意
events.title_en: Shanghan Shuoyi (Meaning of Cold Damage Explained)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰，成书于清乾隆年间，用通俗文字概述《伤寒论》要旨，可视为《伤寒悬解》的简明本，便于初学者掌握六经辨证。现存清刻本。
events.summary_en: By Huang Yuanyu in the Qianlong era, this plain-language summary of the Shanghan Lun serves as a condensed version of the Shanghan Xuanjie for beginners learning six-channel differentiation; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清康熙至乾隆间传本；乾隆刊行
events.title: 太乙神针心法
events.title_en: Taiyi Shenzhen Xinfa (Essential Methods of the Taiyi Magic Needle)
events.summary: 范毓馪传，周雍和刊，传本于清康熙至乾隆间，乾隆年间刊行，讲述太乙神针（药艾条灸）的操作方法与主治，属灸法专书。现存清刻本，对后世艾灸疗法影响较大。
events.summary_en: Transmitted by Fan Yuqi and published by Zhou Yonghe, with manuscripts from Kangxi to Qianlong and printing in the Qianlong era, it describes the Taiyi Magic Needle (medicated moxa roll) and its indications; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: Reedited around the Qianlong reign, Qing
events.title: 瘟疫明辨
events.title_en: Wenyi Mingbian (Clear Differentiation of Pestilence)
events.summary: 以戴天章《广瘟疫论》为基础，经郑奠一重编而成，辨瘟疫证治，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Reedited by Zheng Dianyi on the basis of Dai Tianzhang's Guang Wenyi Lun; discusses differentiation and treatment of pestilence. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 医宗已任编
events.title_en: Yizong Yiren Bian (Compilation of Medical Duties)
events.summary: 高鼓峰等撰，王琦辑，汇编吕留良、董废翁等诸家内科论述，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Wang Qi from works by Gao Gufeng and others, bringing together internal-medicine discussions by several authors. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 幼幼集成
events.title_en: Youyou Jicheng (Compendium on Pediatrics)
events.summary: 陈复正著，系统论述小儿诊法、常见病与痘疹，翻刻多种，是清代影响较大的儿科专著。
events.summary_en: By Chen Fuzheng; systematically covers pediatric diagnosis, common diseases and pox; reprinted widely and influential in Qing pediatrics.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 和刻《千金方》《外台秘要》等影宋本
events.title_en: Edo reproductions of Song-edition Qianjin fang and Waitai miyao
events.summary: 江户医学馆、幕府医官等据宋本影刻中国医籍，保存了《千金方》《外台秘要》等宋本面貌，版本学价值很高。
events.summary_en: Edo-period Medical Academy (Igakukan) and shogunal physicians made facsimile reprints of Song-edition Chinese medical classics such as the Qianjin fang and Waitai miyao, preserving their Song forms and giving them high bibliographic value.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.yearLabel_en: after the 1742 first printing, spread to Japan and Korea
events.title: 医宗金鉴日本、朝鲜传本
events.title_en: Japanese and Korean transmissions of Yizong jinjian
events.summary: 清官修《医宗金鉴》刊行后，传入日本与朝鲜，出现和刻本、朝鲜翻刻本或写本，版本待细考，反映清代官修医书的域外传播。
events.summary_en: After the Qing imperial compilation Yizong jinjian was issued in 1742, it spread to Japan and Korea in Japanese reprints, Korean reprints and manuscripts; details remain to be studied, reflecting overseas dissemination of Qing official medical books.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 喉科指掌
events.title_en: Palm Guide to Laryngology (Houke Zhizhang)
events.summary: 《喉科指掌》，作者张宗良，成书时间记为清乾隆十六年（1751）。传世版本与流传：清乾隆间刻本；《中国医学大成》本（1936）。补充信息：3卷，咽喉病证治与吹药方。
events.summary_en: Palm Guide to Laryngology (Houke Zhizhang): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Zhang Zongliang, dated around 1751. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 哈勒“应激性”与《生理学纲要》
events.title_en: Haller's irritability and Elementa physiologiae
events.summary: 瑞士学者冯·哈勒基于567次动物实验（亲做190次）证明应激性（收缩性）为肌肉特有，感受性属神经，并编成八卷《人体生理学纲要》（1757—1766），使生理学成为独立实验科学。
events.summary_en: Albrecht von Haller showed by 567 experiments that irritability belongs to muscle and sensibility to nerves; his Elementa physiologiae established physiology.

events.title: 四圣心源
events.title_en: Origins of the Four Sages' Heart-Teaching (Sisheng Xinyuan)
events.summary: 黄元御所撰的基础理论著作，收入《黄氏医书八种》。书中以阴阳、五行与脾升胃降的一气周流理论阐释人体生理病机，是尊经派理论的代表作。
events.summary_en: A foundational theory book by Huang Yuanyu, included in his Eight Medical Works; it explains physiology and pathology through yin-yang, five phases and the ascending spleen / descending stomach cycle, a representative text of the classicist school.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 徐大椿批评温补流弊并称针灸为"失传"
events.title_en: Xu Dachun's critiques of warming-tonification and of acupuncture as a "lost tradition"
events.summary: 吴江医家徐大椿（1693—1771）是乾隆朝名医，猛烈抨击赵献可《医贯》一系的温补学说，反映明清之际人们对药物安全性和疗效看法的分歧。1757年他又称针灸已成"失传"之学，研究者视其为后来清廷废止针灸科的先声。
events.summary_en: Xu Dachun (1693–1771) attacked Zhao Xianke's warming-tonification doctrine. In 1757 he called acupuncture a "lost tradition", which scholars see as foreshadowing its later removal from the Imperial Academy.

events.title: 伤寒论类方
events.title_en: Classified Formulas of the Shanghan Lun
events.summary: 徐大椿撰于清乾隆二十四年（1759），以方类证，将《伤寒论》方剂分为桂枝汤类、麻黄汤类等十二类，是方证研究的重要著作。现存清刻本及《徐灵胎医书》本。
events.summary_en: Written by Xu Dachun in 1759, it classifies Shanghan Lun formulas into twelve groups such as the Guizhi and Mahuang decoction families, an important work on formula-pattern correspondence; Qing prints and his collected works survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel_en: Published in the Qianlong reign, Qing
events.title: 种福堂公选良方
events.title_en: Zhongfutang Gongxuan Liangfang (Publicly Selected Formulas of the Zhongfu Hall)
events.summary: 托名叶天士名下辑成的方书系统，实际编者待考，题名与托名关系宜谨慎对待，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: A formulary compiled under the name of Ye Tianshi; the actual compiler is uncertain and the attribution should be treated with caution. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.yearLabel: 清乾隆间原著；民国笺正本
events.yearLabel_en: Original in Qianlong reign, Qing; Republican annotated edition
events.title: 沈氏女科辑要
events.title_en: Shenshi Nuke Jiyao (Shen's Essentials of Gynecology)
events.summary: 沈尧封原著，民初张山雷笺正，为妇科名著，有清刻本与民国笺正本传世。
events.summary_en: Original by Shen Yaofeng, annotated by Zhang Shanlei in the early Republic; a noted gynecology text. Qing printings and the Republican annotated edition survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 扫叶庄医案
events.title_en: Medical Cases from Saoye Manor (Saoyezhuang Yi'an)
events.summary: 《扫叶庄医案》，作者薛雪；后人辑，成书时间记为清乾隆间；后世刊行。传世版本与流传：清刻本、近代印本。补充信息：医案。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Medical Cases from Saoye Manor (Saoyezhuang Yi'an): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Xue Xue, dated around 1760. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清乾隆间成书；同治咸丰间合刻通行
events.title: 黄氏医书八种
events.title_en: Eight Medical Works of Huang (Huangshi Yishu Bazhong)
events.summary: 《黄氏医书八种》，作者黄元御，成书时间记为清乾隆间成书；同治咸丰间合刻通行。传世版本与流传：清刻本多种。补充信息：丛书。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Eight Medical Works of Huang (Huangshi Yishu Bazhong): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Huang Yuanyu, dated around 1760. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 莫尔加尼《疾病的位置与原因》
events.title_en: Morgagni's De sedibus
events.summary: 帕多瓦解剖学教授莫尔加尼1761年出版《论疾病的位置与原因》，以尸检对照临床症状，确立“疾病位于器官”的观念，使病理解剖学成为重要医学学科。
events.summary_en: Morgagni's De sedibus et causis morborum (1761) established the organ concept of disease and pathological anatomy.

events.title: 奥恩布鲁格胸部叩诊法
events.title_en: Auenbrugger's percussion
events.summary: 奥地利医生奥恩布鲁格经七年研究，于1761年出版《新发明》，提出叩击胸壁、依声音判断胸腔内隐匿疾病的叩诊法，成为物理诊断基础。
events.summary_en: After seven years' study Leopold Auenbrugger described chest percussion in Inventum novum (1761).

events.title: 得配本草
events.title_en: Depei Bencao (Materia Medica of Drug Pairings)
events.summary: 严西亭、施澹宁、洪缉庵合编，以药物配伍为纲，介绍各药与他药相配后的功效变化，兼具本草与方论性质，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Yan Xiting, Shi Danning and Hong Jian'an; organizes materia medica by drug pairings and their effects, bridging materia medica and formulary. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 大生要旨
events.title_en: Dasheng Yaozhi (Essentials of Obstetrics)
events.summary: 唐千顷著，论妇产要旨，有清刻本传世，越南亦有翻刻。
events.summary_en: By Tang Qianqing; essentials of women's and obstetric care. Qing printings survive, with Vietnamese reprints.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 万方集验
events.title_en: Vạn phương tập nghiệm
events.summary: 吴靖（Ngô Tĩnh）撰，越南写本或刻本，属方书，奉敕编撰性质。
events.summary_en: By Ngô Tĩnh, Vietnamese manuscripts or prints, a formulary compiled in an official context.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 赵学敏《本草纲目拾遗》
events.title_en: Zhao Xuemin, Supplement to the Compendium of Materia Medica
events.summary: 赵学敏1765年著《本草纲目拾遗》，增补《纲目》未收药物与民间药，并有《串雅》记铃医经验。
events.summary_en: In 1765 Zhao Xuemin wrote the Bencao Gangmu Shiyi, adding drugs and folk medicines omitted from the Compendium. His Chuan Ya also records the experience of itinerant folk healers.
works_en: Bencao Gangmu Shiyi (Supplement to the Compendium of Materia Medica)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 贝克证明德文郡绞痛为铅中毒
events.title_en: Baker on Devonshire colic
events.summary: 1767年6月29日乔治·贝克在伦敦皇家内科医师学院宣读论文，指出德文郡流行的绞痛源于苹果酒压榨与储存设备中的铅，是环境流行病学早期范例。
events.summary_en: George Baker (1767) showed Devonshire colic was lead poisoning from cider-making equipment.

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 33rd year of Qianlong, Qing (1768)
events.title: 脉理求真
events.title_en: Maili Qiuzhen (Seeking Truth in Pulse Principles)
events.summary: 黄宫绣撰，成书约在清乾隆三十三年（1768）前后，论述脉理与脉象鉴别，与其《本草求真》为同一作者的药物与诊法著作。现存清刻本，是清代脉学著作之一。
events.summary_en: Written by Huang Gongxiu around 1768, this work discusses pulse principles and the differentiation of pulse images and is a diagnostic companion to his Bencao Qiuzhen; Qing prints survive as one of the Qing pulse studies.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医林指月
events.title_en: Pointing at the Moon in the Forest of Medicine (Yilin Zhiyue)
events.summary: 《医林指月》，作者王琦辑，成书时间记为清乾隆三十三年（1768）。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：丛书。
events.summary_en: Pointing at the Moon in the Forest of Medicine (Yilin Zhiyue): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Wang Qi, dated around 1768. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 约翰·亨特实验外科学
events.title_en: John Hunter and experimental surgery
events.summary: 约翰·亨特（1728–1793）以比较解剖与实验推动外科科学化，对动脉瘤等手术与病理学影响深远。
events.summary_en: John Hunter (1728–1793) used comparative anatomy and experiment to make surgery more scientific. His influence on operations such as those for aneurysm, and on pathology, was lasting.

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 35th year of Qianlong, Qing (1770)
events.title: 本草求真
events.title_en: Bencao Qiuzhen (Seeking Truth in Materia Medica)
events.summary: 黄宫绣撰，约成于清乾隆三十五年（1770），以药物功用分类，与其脉学著作配套，是清代较实用的本草著作。现存清刻本，今有席与民、朱肇和点校本。
events.summary_en: Written by Huang Gongxiu around 1770, this materia medica organises drugs by function and pairs with his pulse studies, a practical Qing work; Qing prints survive, and a modern punctuated edition exists by Xi Yumin and Zhu Zhaohe.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
中国哲学书电子化计划/公开书目著录
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 徐灵胎医书合刻
events.title_en: Collected Medical Works of Xu Lingtai
events.summary: 《徐灵胎医书》合刻，作者徐大椿，成书时间记为清乾隆以后合刻。传世版本与流传：半松斋等刻本系统。补充信息：丛书。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Collected Medical Works of Xu Lingtai: Qing-dynasty work attributed to Xu Dachun, dated around 1770. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 续名医类案
events.title_en: Continued Classified Cases of Famous Physicians (Xu Mingyi Leian)
events.summary: 《续名医类案》，作者魏之琇，成书时间记为清乾隆三十五年（1770）。传世版本与流传：清乾隆间刻本；人民卫生出版社1957年影印。补充信息：36卷，续江瓘《名医类案》，辑清初以前医案尤富。
events.summary_en: Continued Classified Cases of Famous Physicians (Xu Mingyi Leian): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Wei Zhixiu, Jiang Guan, dated around 1770. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 医宗心领（海上懒翁医宗心领）
events.title_en: Hải Thượng y tông tâm lĩnh
events.summary: 黎有晫（海上懒翁）所著越南医学全书，约二十七集，18世纪后期写成，19世纪晚期部分刻印，是越南医学史上最具影响的著作之一。
events.summary_en: A Vietnamese medical compendium by Lê Hữu Trác (Hải Thượng Lãn Ông), written in the later 18th century and partly printed in the late 19th; among the most influential works in Vietnamese medical history.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 女科切要
events.title_en: Nuke Qieyao (Essentials of Gynecology)
events.summary: 吴道源著，论妇科要点，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Wu Daoyuan; key points of gynecology. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 脉象统类
events.title_en: Maixiang Tonglei (Classification of Pulse Images)
events.summary: 沈金鳌撰，成书于清乾隆年间，将各种脉象分类汇总，收入《沈氏尊生书》，是脉学入门参考。现存清刻本，与同书系的《杂病源流犀烛》等相互配合。
events.summary_en: Written by Shen Jin'ao in the Qianlong era, this classified summary of pulse images is included in the Shen Zunsheng Shu as an introductory pulse reference and complements the Zabing Yuanliu Xizhu; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 老老恒言
events.title_en: Constant Words for the Elderly (Laolao Hengyan)
events.summary: 《老老恒言》，作者曹庭栋，成书时间记为清乾隆三十八年（1773）。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：养生；含医药调护，择要。
events.summary_en: Constant Words for the Elderly (Laolao Hengyan): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Cao Tingdong, dated around 1773. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 养生随笔即老老恒言异名
events.title_en: Notes on Health Preservation (Yangsheng Suibi, alternate title of Laolao Hengyan)
events.summary: 《养生随笔》即《老老恒言》异名，作者曹庭栋，成书时间记为1773。传世版本与流传：同上。补充信息：养生。
events.summary_en: Notes on Health Preservation (Yangsheng Suibi, alternate title of Laolao Hengyan): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Cao Tingdong, dated around 1773. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 普里斯特利发现氧化亚氮
events.title_en: Priestley discovers nitrous oxide
events.summary: 约瑟夫·普里斯特利1774年发现氧化亚氮等气体；后被戴维注意其麻醉潜能。
events.summary_en: In 1774 Joseph Priestley discovered nitrous oxide and other gases. Davy later noticed its anesthetic potential.

events.title: 威廉·亨特《妊娠子宫解剖图谱》
events.title_en: Hunter's Gravid Uterus
events.summary: 苏格兰解剖学家威廉·亨特1774年在伯明翰巴斯克维尔印刷出版《人类妊娠子宫解剖图谱》，以大型铜版图客观呈现妊娠各期解剖，适逢英格兰助产与产科兴起。
events.summary_en: William Hunter's Anatomia uteri humani gravidi (1774) gave an objective anatomical depiction of pregnancy.

events.title: 波特发现扫烟囱工阴囊癌
events.title_en: Pott and chimney sweeps' cancer
events.summary: 1775年伦敦外科医生珀西瓦尔·波特描述幼年从事扫烟囱者的阴囊癌，归因于长期接触烟灰，为首个与职业暴露相关联的癌症，开启化学致癌研究。
events.summary_en: In 1775 Percivall Pott linked scrotal cancer in chimney sweeps to soot—the first occupational cancer.

events.title: 松峰说疫
events.title_en: Songfeng Shuoyi (Songfeng on Epidemics)
events.summary: 刘奎著，系统论述瘟疫病因、辨证与治法，并收录大量防治方药，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Liu Kui; systematically discusses causes, differentiation and treatment of epidemics with many preventive and therapeutic formulas. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 古今医案按
events.title_en: Annotated Medical Cases Past and Present (Gujin Yi'an An)
events.summary: 《古今医案按》，作者俞震，成书时间记为清乾隆四十三年（1778）。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：医案。
events.summary_en: Annotated Medical Cases Past and Present (Gujin Yi'an An): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Yu Zhen, dated around 1778. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 弗兰克《完整医学警察体系》
events.title_en: Frank's Medicinische Polizey
events.summary: 德意志医生约翰·彼得·弗兰克自1779年起出版多卷《完整医学警察体系》，主张国家以法规管理卫生、生育、食品与环境，是“医学警察”概念与近代公共卫生的奠基文献。
events.summary_en: Johann Peter Frank's multi-volume System einer vollständigen medicinischen Polizey (from 1779) founded state public-health policy.

events.title: 遂生编
events.title_en: Suisheng Bian (Compilation on Smooth Growth)
events.summary: 庄一夔著，论小儿痘疹证治，常与《福幼编》合刊，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Zhuang Yikui; discusses smallpox and pox in children, often printed together with Fuyou Bian. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 痘疹会通
events.title_en: Douzhen Huitong (Synthesis on Pox)
events.summary: 曾鼎著，汇通诸家痘疹之说，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Zeng Ding; synthesizes various schools' views on pox. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 威瑟林洋地黄治疗水肿
events.title_en: Withering uses foxglove for dropsy
events.summary: 威廉·威瑟林1785年发表《关于洋地黄的记述》，系统描述洋地黄治疗水肿（心衰相关）的用法与毒性。
events.summary_en: In 1785 William Withering published An Account of the Foxglove, a systematic description of the use and toxicity of digitalis in dropsy related to heart failure.

events.title: 福幼编
events.title_en: Fuyou Bian (Compilation on Blessing the Young)
events.summary: 庄一夔著，论小儿慢惊风证治，常与《遂生编》合刊，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Zhuang Yikui; discusses chronic convulsions in children, often printed together with Suisheng Bian. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 回生集
events.title_en: Huisheng Ji (Collection for Reviving the Sick)
events.summary: 陈杰辑，汇集急救与各科验方，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: Compiled by Chen Jie; a collection of emergency and multi-specialty formulas. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 哈尼曼创立顺势疗法
events.title_en: Hahnemann founds homeopathy
events.summary: 塞缪尔·哈尼曼约1790年起反对放血等主流疗法并创立顺势疗法，成为近代另类医学重要流派（疗效争议大）。
events.summary_en: From about 1790 Samuel Hahnemann opposed mainstream treatments such as bloodletting and founded homeopathy. It became an important current of modern alternative medicine. Its efficacy is heavily disputed.

events.title: 吴医汇讲
events.title_en: Collected Lectures of Wu Physicians (Wuyi Huijiang)
events.summary: 《吴医汇讲》，作者唐大烈，成书时间记为清乾隆五十七年（1792）。传世版本与流传：清乾隆五十七年起陆续刻印（1792—1801）。补充信息：11卷，中国最早的医学期刊式连续出版物，载吴中醫家论文。
events.summary_en: Collected Lectures of Wu Physicians (Wuyi Huijiang): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Tang Dalie, dated around 1792. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 皮内尔解除精神病人锁链
events.title_en: Pinel unchains the insane
events.summary: 法国医生皮内尔任巴黎比塞特尔医院主任医师后解除被锁三四十年的病人锁链，1795年又在萨尔佩特里耶尔推行，倡导“道德疗法”，被视为现代精神病学开端（年份有1792/1793之说）。
events.summary_en: Philippe Pinel removed chains from patients at Bicêtre (c.1793) and later Salpêtrière, introducing moral treatment.

events.title: 詹纳牛痘接种
events.title_en: Jenner’s cowpox vaccination
events.summary: 爱德华·詹纳1796年用牛痘接种预防天花，开创安全疫苗接种，为后世消灭天花奠基。
events.summary_en: In 1796 Edward Jenner used cowpox inoculation to prevent smallpox, opening safer vaccination and laying a foundation for the later eradication of smallpox.

image.caption: 詹纳油画像
image.caption_en:
Edward Jenner. Oil painting.

Iconographic Collections

events.title: 瘟证羊毛论
events.title_en: Wenzheng Yangmao Lun (On the Wool-Type Pestilential Syndrome)
events.summary: 随霖著，论“羊毛瘟”一类疫证的辨治，有清嘉庆慈善堂刻本等传世。
events.summary_en: By Sui Lin; discusses the 'wool-type' epidemic syndrome. Jiaqing-era Cishan Hall printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 拉雷飞骑救护与战伤外科
events.title_en: Larrey’s flying ambulance and war surgery
events.summary: 拿破仑军医多米尼克·拉雷改进战地救护（飞骑救护车）与截肢时机，推动军事外科学。
events.summary_en: Napoleon’s surgeon Dominique Jean Larrey improved battlefield evacuation with the flying ambulance and the timing of amputation, and he advanced military surgery.

events.title: 吴鞠通《温病条辨》
events.title_en: Wu Jutong, Systematic Differentiation of Warm Diseases
events.summary: 吴瑭（鞠通）1798年著《温病条辨》，创立三焦辨证，与叶天士并称温病学高峰。
events.summary_en: In 1798 Wu Tang (Jutong) wrote the Wenbing Tiaobian. He established triple-burner pattern differentiation and, with Ye Tianshi, marks a high point of warm-disease studies.
works_en: Wenbing Tiaobian (Systematic Differentiation of Warm Diseases)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 针灸易学
events.title_en: Zhenjiu Yixue (Easy Study of Acupuncture and Moxibustion)
events.summary: 李守先撰于清嘉庆三年（1798），用通俗文字概述针灸取穴与治疗，便于初学者学习，是清代针灸入门读物之一。现存清刻本，流传较广。
events.summary_en: Written by Li Shouxian in 1798, this plain-language overview of acupoint selection and treatment helps beginners and is one of the Qing introductory acupuncture texts; Qing prints survive and circulated fairly widely.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 俞根初《通俗伤寒论》
events.title_en: Yu Genchu, Popular Treatise on Cold Damage
events.summary: 俞根初约1799年《通俗伤寒论》倡导寒温融合，反映明清伤寒与温病对话。
events.summary_en: About 1799 Yu Genchu’s Tongsu Shanghan Lun advocated joining cold-damage and warm-disease approaches, reflecting the Ming-Qing conversation between the two.
works_en: Tongsu Shanghan Lun (Popular Treatise on Cold Damage)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 戴维指出氧化亚氮麻醉性
events.title_en: Davy notes that nitrous oxide is anesthetic
events.summary: 汉弗莱·戴维1799–1800年记述氧化亚氮可缓解疼痛，为吸入麻醉史提供早期线索。
events.summary_en: In 1799–1800 Humphry Davy recorded that nitrous oxide can relieve pain, an early clue in the history of inhalation anesthesia.

events.title: 温证指归
events.title_en: Wenzheng Zhigui (Guide to Warm Syndromes)
events.summary: 周魁著，论温证辨治，有清抄本流传，后收入《三三医书》及《中国医学大成》铅印本。
events.summary_en: By Zhou Kui; discusses differentiation and treatment of warm syndromes. Circulated in Qing manuscripts and later in the Sansan Yishu and Zhongguo Yixue Dacheng.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 眼科奇书
events.title_en: Marvelous Book of Ophthalmology (Yanke Qishu)
events.summary: 《眼科奇书》，署名旧题；清刊行，成书时间记为清中后期。传世版本与流传：清刻本；真伪待考。补充信息：眼科。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Marvelous Book of Ophthalmology (Yanke Qishu): Qing-dynasty work attributed to an unnamed or attributed author, dated around 1800. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 喉症全科紫珍集
events.title_en: Purple Treasure Collection of Throat Disorders (Houzheng Quanke Zizhen Ji)
events.summary: 《喉症全科紫珍集》，署名旧题朱翔宇；郑梅涧相关系统，成书时间记为清中叶以后刊行。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：咽喉。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Purple Treasure Collection of Throat Disorders (Houzheng Quanke Zizhen Ji): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Zhu Xiangyu, Zheng Meijian, dated around 1800. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 四部医典蒙文译本（明珠道尔吉译本）
events.title_en: Mongolian translation of the Four Tantras (Mingjur Dorji)
events.summary: 清代蒙文木刻译本，译刻者为明珠道尔吉，扩大了《四部医典》在蒙古地区的传播与教学使用。
events.summary_en: A Qing-era Mongolian woodblock translation by Mingjur Dorji, broadening the circulation and teaching use of the Four Tantras in Mongol regions.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 塞尔蒂纳纳分离吗啡
events.title_en: Sertürner isolates morphine
events.summary: 弗里德里希·塞尔蒂纳纳约1804年自鸦片分离吗啡，是植物活性成分分离的里程碑，开启生物碱化学。
events.summary_en: About 1804 Friedrich Sertürner isolated morphine from opium. It was a milestone in separating active plant constituents and opened alkaloid chemistry.

events.title: 牛痘法传入广州
events.title_en: Cowpox vaccination reaches Guangzhou
events.summary: 1805年牛痘接种经澳门/广州传入中国，逐渐替代人痘，是免疫史与中西医交流的重要节点。
events.summary_en: In 1805 cowpox vaccination reached China through Macao and Guangzhou and gradually replaced variolation. It is an important point in the history of immunity and of exchange between Chinese and Western medicine.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 银海指南
events.title_en: Guide to the Silver Sea (Yinhai Zhinan)
events.summary: 《银海指南》，作者顾锡，成书时间记为清嘉庆十六年（1811）。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：眼科。
events.summary_en: Guide to the Silver Sea (Yinhai Zhinan): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Gu Xi, dated around 1811. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤科汇纂
events.title_en: Compendium of Traumatology (Shangke Huizuan)
events.summary: 《伤科汇纂》，作者胡廷光，成书时间记为清嘉庆十七年（1812）。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：伤科。
events.summary_en: Compendium of Traumatology (Shangke Huizuan): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Hu Tingguang, dated around 1812. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 调疾饮食辩
events.title_en: Tiaoji Yinshi Bian (Discussion on Diet for Recuperation)
events.summary: 章穆撰于清嘉庆十八年（1813），论述疾病调养中的饮食宜忌，兼涉药食关系，是清代食疗类著作。现存清刻本，对后世饮食调养研究有参考价值。
events.summary_en: Written by Zhang Mu in 1813, it discusses dietary rules during recuperation and the relationship between food and drugs, a Qing dietary-therapy work; Qing prints survive and remain useful for diet-based care studies.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 保婴易知录
events.title_en: Baoying Yizhi Lu (Easy Guide to Infant Care)
events.summary: 吴宁澜著，面向大众的保育与小儿常见病指南，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Wu Ninglan; a lay-oriented guide to infant care and common pediatric ailments. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 伤寒论歌括
events.title_en: Shanghan Lun in Verse (Shanghanlun Gekuo)
events.summary: 陈念祖将《伤寒论》编成歌诀，成书于清嘉庆道光年间，便于初学者记诵，属其《南雅堂医书》系列。现存清刻本，是清代伤寒入门常用读物。
events.summary_en: Chen Nianzu's verse version of the Shanghan Lun from the Jiaqing-Daoguang era, easy to memorise for beginners and part of the Nanyatang Medical Works; Qing prints survive as a common introductory text.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 雷奈克发明听诊器
events.title_en: Laennec invents the stethoscope
events.summary: 勒内·雷奈克1816年发明听诊器，使心肺体征可客观听诊，革新诊断学。
events.summary_en: In 1816 René Laennec invented the stethoscope, making heart and lung signs objectively audible and transforming diagnosis.

events.title: 帕金森《论震颤麻痹》
events.title_en: Parkinson's An Essay on the Shaking Palsy
events.summary: 1817年英国医生詹姆斯·帕金森出版《论震颤麻痹》，依据街头及门诊观察，细致描述一种进行性、致残的震颤与运动障碍，被视为神经病学经典，后世以其名命名帕金森病。
events.summary_en: In 1817 James Parkinson published a closely observed clinical account of a progressive, disabling tremor disorder, later named Parkinson's disease.
works_en: An Essay on the Shaking Palsy

events.title: 布兰德尔成功人体输血
events.title_en: Blundell’s successful human transfusion
events.summary: 詹姆斯·布兰德尔1818年完成早期成功的人体输血尝试，为输血医学开辟道路（血型发现前风险极高）。
events.summary_en: In 1818 James Blundell completed an early successful attempt at human transfusion, opening a path for transfusion medicine. Before blood groups were known, the risk was extremely high.

events.title: 伤科补要
events.title_en: Supplement to Orthopaedics and Traumatology (Shangke Buyao)
events.summary: 《伤科补要》，作者钱秀昌，成书时间记为清嘉庆二十三年（1818）。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：伤科。
events.summary_en: Supplement to Orthopaedics and Traumatology (Shangke Buyao): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Qian Xiuchang, dated around 1818. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清嘉道间医案；同治光绪刊行
events.title: 吴鞠通医案
events.title_en: Medical Cases of Wu Jutong (Wu Jutong Yi'an)
events.summary: 《吴鞠通医案》，作者吴瑭；后人整理，成书时间记为清嘉道间医案；同治光绪刊行。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：医案。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Medical Cases of Wu Jutong (Wu Jutong Yi'an): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Wu Tang, dated around 1820. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 清道光以后书坊合刻极多
events.title: 南雅堂医书全集（陈修园医书）
events.title_en: Complete Medical Works of Nanyatang (Chen Xiuyuan's Medical Works)
events.summary: 《南雅堂医书全集》（《陈修园医书》），作者陈念祖等，成书时间记为清道光以后书坊合刻极多。传世版本与流传：善成堂、校经山房等书坊刻本。补充信息：丛书。其作者或年代存在不确定性，年份为大致取值。
events.summary_en: Complete Medical Works of Nanyatang (Chen Xiuyuan's Medical Works): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Chen Nianzu, dated around 1820. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue. Dating and authorship carry some uncertainty.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 程杏轩医案
events.title_en: Medical Cases of Cheng Xingxuan (Cheng Xingxuan Yi'an)
events.summary: 《程杏轩医案》，作者程文囿，成书时间记为清道光元年（1821）前后。传世版本与流传：清刻本。补充信息：医案。
events.summary_en: Medical Cases of Cheng Xingxuan (Cheng Xingxuan Yi'an): Qing-dynasty work attributed to Cheng Wenyou, dated around 1821. Its circulation is recorded through Qing and later printed editions listed in the user-provided catalogue.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 太医院废止针灸科
events.title_en: Acupuncture and moxibustion abolished at the Imperial Academy of Medicine
events.summary: 道光二年（1822），清廷下令太医院永远停止针灸科。研究者认为，在徐大椿称针灸"失传"之后，这是一项激进但顺理成章的举措。此后针灸退出官方医学教育，但在民间继续流传。
events.summary_en: In 1822 the Qing court abolished acupuncture and moxibustion at the Imperial Academy of Medicine, a "radical, but consequent act" after Xu Dachun's 1757 remark.

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 5th year of Daoguang, Qing (1825)
events.title: 医门棒喝
events.title_en: Yimen Banghe (A Rebuke to the Medical Profession)
events.summary: 章楠所撰，成书约在清道光五年（1825）前后，以《内经》《伤寒论》理论为本评议诸家学说，并阐发温病学理论，是清代融合伤寒与温病思想的理论著作，现存清刻本。
events.summary_en: Written by Zhang Nan around 1825, it critiques various schools on the basis of the Neijing and Shanghan Lun while expounding warm-disease theory, an attempt to integrate cold-damage and warm-disease thought; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 傅青主妇科传本
events.title_en: The transmitted text of Fu Qingzhu’s gynecology
events.summary: 托名或传自傅山的《傅青主女科》清中后期广泛刊行，对妇科辨证处方影响极大。
events.summary_en: Fu Qingzhu’s Gynecology, attributed to or transmitted from Fu Shan, circulated widely in the middle and later Qing and strongly influenced gynecological pattern differentiation and prescribing.

events.title: 布莱特描述肾病（布莱特病）
events.title_en: Richard Bright describes renal disease (Bright's disease)
events.summary: 1827年英国医生理查德·布莱特出版《医学病例报告》，将水肿、蛋白尿与尸检所见肾脏病变联系起来，奠定临床—病理相关的肾脏病学基础，此类肾炎长期被称为“布莱特病”。
events.summary_en: Bright's Reports of Medical Cases (1827) linked dropsy and albuminous urine with diseased kidneys at autopsy, founding clinical nephrology.

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 9th year of Daoguang, Qing (1829)
events.title: 医门棒喝二集
events.title_en: Yimen Banghe, Second Collection
events.summary: 章楠《医门棒喝》的续集，约成于清道光九年（1829）前后，进一步讨论医理并对《伤寒论》作注释，与初集配套流通。现存清刻本，体现作者调和伤寒与温病的学术取向。
events.summary_en: The sequel to Zhang Nan's Yimen Banghe, written around 1829, it further discusses medical principles and annotates the Shanghan Lun, circulating with the first collection; Qing prints survive, reflecting his reconciliation of cold-damage and warm-disease views.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 麻疹阐注
events.title_en: Mazhen Chanzhu (Annotated Elucidation on Measles)
events.summary: 张霞溪著，阐注麻疹证治，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Xiaxi; elucidates and annotates measles diagnosis and treatment. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 王清任《医林改错》
events.title_en: Wang Qingren, Correction of Errors in Medical Works
events.summary: 王清任1830年刊《医林改错》，强调尸体脏器观察并创活血化瘀诸方，对血瘀证研究影响深远。
events.summary_en: In 1830 Wang Qingren published the Yilin Gaicuo. He emphasized observation of organs in corpses and created formulas for invigorating blood and transforming stasis. His influence on the study of blood-stasis patterns was lasting.
works_en: Yilin Gaicuo (Correction of Errors in Medical Works)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.yearLabel_en: Around the 10th year of Daoguang, Qing (1830)
events.title: 素问释义
events.title_en: Suwen Shiyi (Explanation of the Suwen)
events.summary: 清代医家张琦撰，以注释方式阐明《素问》经义，成书约在道光十年（1830）前后。现存清刻本，属清代《内经》注释类医经著作，具体版本源流有待进一步考订。
events.summary_en: Written by the Qing physician Zhang Qi around 1830, this commentary explains the meaning of the Suwen by annotation; Qing printed editions survive, though the exact edition history still awaits verification.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 伤寒医诀串解
events.title_en: Verse Explanations of Cold Damage Rules (Shanghan Yijue Chuanjie)
events.summary: 陈念祖（陈修园）撰于清道光年间，以歌诀形式串解《伤寒论》，便于初学者记诵，收入《南雅堂医书》。现存清刻本，属清代通俗医学入门读物。
events.summary_en: Written by Chen Nianzu (Chen Xiuyuan) in the Daoguang era, this verse-form explanation of the Shanghan Lun aids memorisation by beginners and is included in the Nanyatang Medical Works; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.yearLabel: 日本文政—天保年间（19世纪前半）
events.yearLabel_en: Bunsei–Tenpō era (first half of the 19th c.)
events.title: 素问识、素问绍识
events.title_en: Somon shiki and Somon shōshiki
events.summary: 丹波元简、丹波元坚父子所撰《素问》考证著作，日本刻本，在中国也有翻刻与影印，是日本考证学派的代表成果。
events.summary_en: Philological studies of the Suwen by the father and son Tamba Mototane and Tamba Mototaka, printed in Japan and also reprinted and photo-reproduced in China; representative of the Japanese kōshōgaku school.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 霍奇金描述淋巴结与脾病变
events.title_en: Thomas Hodgkin describes Hodgkin's disease
events.summary: 1832年托马斯·霍奇金发表《论吸收腺与脾的某些病态表现》，描述七例无痛性淋巴结肿大伴脾肿大的患者，后经威尔克斯推崇命名为霍奇金病，即今霍奇金淋巴瘤。
events.summary_en: In 1832 Hodgkin's paper "On some morbid appearances of the absorbent glands and spleen" described seven patients with painless lymphadenopathy; Wilks later named it Hodgkin's disease.
works: On some morbid appearances of the absorbent glands and spleen
works_en: On some morbid appearances of the absorbent glands and spleen

events.title: 吊脚痧方论
events.title_en: Diaojiaosha Fanglun (Formulas for Cramp-Sha / Cholera)
events.summary: 徐子默著，论霍乱类吊脚痧的辨治与方药，有清刻本传世；书目另列《霍乱燃犀说》条，署名与归属存疑。
events.summary_en: By Xu Zimo; discusses differentiation and treatment of cholera-like cramp-sha. The catalogue also lists Huoluan Ranxi Shuo with unresolved authorship. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 类证治裁
events.title_en: Leizheng Zhicai (Classified Syndromes and Treatments)
events.summary: 林珮琴著，按病证分类论述内科杂病辨治，翻刻多种，为清代内科临证名著。
events.summary_en: By Lin Peiqin; classifies and discusses internal disorders by syndrome; reprinted many times and a notable Qing clinical work.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 产孕集
events.title_en: Chanyun Ji (Collection on Childbirth and Pregnancy)
events.summary: 张曜孙著，论产育孕养，有清刻本传世。
events.summary_en: By Zhang Yaosun; on childbirth and pregnancy care. Qing printings survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 伯驾广州眼科医局（博济前身）
events.title_en: Peter Parker’s Ophthalmic Hospital in Guangzhou (forerunner of Boji Hospital)
events.summary: 美国传教士医生伯驾1835年在广州开设眼科医局，后发展为博济医院，是中国近代西医院先驱。
events.summary_en: In 1835 the American missionary physician Peter Parker opened an ophthalmic hospital in Guangzhou. It later developed into Boji Hospital and was a pioneer of modern Western hospitals in China.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

image.author: 佚名
image.caption: 伯驾像
image.caption_en: Photo from his biography by George B. Stevens and W. Fisher Markwick. "The Life, Letters, and Journals of the Rev. and Hon. Peter Parker, M.

events.title: 晶珠本草
events.title_en: Shel gong shel phreng (Crystal Pearl Materia Medica)
events.summary: 藏药本草名著，作者帝玛尔·丹增彭措，又称《药物学广论》《无垢晶串》，收药两千余种，1840年木刻刊行。
events.summary_en: A major Tibetan materia medica by Deumar Tenzin Phuntsok, also known as Extensive Treatise on Pharmacology; it records over 2,000 medicinals and was printed from woodblocks in 1840.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)

events.title: 本经疏证
events.title_en: Benjing Shuzheng (Annotated Evidence on the Divine Farmer's Classic)
events.summary: 邹澍撰于清道光十七年（1837），以《伤寒论》《金匮要略》方药印证《神农本草经》药性，是清代本经研究的重要著作。现存清刻本，对后世药性研究影响较大。
events.summary_en: Written by Zou Shu in 1837, it tests the Shennong Bencao Jing's drug properties against formulas of the Shanghan Lun and Jingui Yaolue, an important Qing study of the classic; Qing prints survive with lasting influence.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 本经续疏
events.title_en: Benjing Xushu (Sequel to the Benjing Annotations)
events.summary: 邹澍《本经疏证》的续作，成书于清道光年间，继续以仲景方证疏释《神农本草经》药物，与《本经疏证》并为一系。现存清刻本，具体年代待考。
events.summary_en: The sequel to Zou Shu's Benjing Shuzheng from the Daoguang era, continuing to explain Bencao Jing drugs through Zhongjing's formula patterns and forming a group with the first work; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 本经序疏要
events.title_en: Benjing Xu Shuyao (Essentials of the Benjing Prefaces)
events.summary: 邹澍撰，成书于清道光年间，对《神农本草经》序例作要点式疏解，与《本经疏证》《本经续疏》并为一系，便于理解本经凡例。现存清刻本。
events.summary_en: Written by Zou Shu in the Daoguang era, it gives a concise explanation of the introductory rules of the Shennong Bencao Jing and forms a group with his Benjing Shuzheng and Xushu; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 神农本草经赞
events.title_en: Shennong Bencaojing Zan (Eulogies on the Divine Farmer's Classic)
events.summary: 叶志诜撰，成书于清道光年间，以赞体形式概述《神农本草经》药物，是清代本经辑注著作之一，便于记诵与查阅。现存清刻本，作者生平待考。
events.summary_en: Written by Ye Zhishen in the Daoguang era, it summarises drugs of the Shennong Bencao Jing in verse eulogies, one of the Qing compilations and commentaries on the classic, easy to memorise and consult; Qing prints survive.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 本草分经
events.title_en: Bencao Fenjing (Materia Medica by Channels)
events.summary: 姚澜撰于清道光二十一年（1841），按药物归经分类，是清代归经药物学的代表之一，便于按经络选药。现存清刻本，对后世药物归经研究有参考价值。
events.summary_en: Written by Yao Lan in 1841, it classifies drugs by channel affiliation, a representative of Qing channel-based pharmacology that helps select drugs by channel; Qing prints survive and remain useful for later study.
sources: 中医药古籍初步编目(用户提供书目)
sources_en: Preliminary Catalogue of TCM Ancient Books (user-provided)

events.title: 查德威克《卫生状况报告》
events.title_en: Chadwick’s report on sanitary conditions
events.summary: 埃德温·查德威克1842年报告推动英国卫生改革立法，将清洁供水与排污纳入国家责任。
events.summary_en: Edwin Chadwick’s 1842 report pushed sanitary-reform legislation in Britain and brought clean water and sewage into the responsibilities of the state.

events.title: 克劳福德·朗乙醚麻醉手术
events.title_en: Crawford Long operates under ether
events.summary: 克劳福德·朗1842年用乙醚施行无痛手术，但未及时发表；乙醚麻醉的公开示范稍后由莫顿完成。
events.summary_en: In 1842 Crawford Long used ether for painless surgery, but he did not publish in time. The public demonstration of ether anesthesia was given a little later by Morton.

events.title: 雒魏林在上海创办仁济医院
events.title_en: William Lockhart founds Renji Hospital in Shanghai
events.summary: 伦敦会医学传教士雒魏林在上海县城大东门附近租屋开设医馆，这就是上海第一所西式医院，即今天的仁济医院。他还在上海向中国人推广种牛痘，本地医生在种痘推广中也发挥了重要作用。
events.summary_en: William Lockhart of the London Missionary Society opened Shanghai's first Western-style hospital (today's Renji Hospital) and introduced vaccination in Shanghai.

events.title: 莫顿公开乙醚麻醉示范
events.title_en: Morton’s public demonstration of ether anesthesia
events.summary: 1846年10月威廉·莫顿在麻省总医院公开乙醚麻醉手术，全麻迅速传播，外科进入无痛时代。
events.summary_en: In October 1846 William Morton publicly demonstrated surgery under ether at Massachusetts General Hospital. General anesthesia spread quickly, and surgery entered an era without operative pain.
